CLASS zcl_url_parser IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_domain.
    " Nutze find_regex zur Extraktion des Domain-Teils (einfache Logik)
    FINAL(lv_domain_part) = match_regex( val = iv_url
                                           regex = '(?:https?://)?(?:www\.)?([^/]+)' ).

Instructions: Write a method that pads a string with leading zeros until it reaches a total length of 10 characters.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_padder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_padded) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_padder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD pad_with_zeros.
    " Die Funktion CONCAT_LINES_OF ist ein effizienter Weg zur String-Padding in ABAP, 
    " aber für einfache Padding ist die MOVE-Anweisung oder WRITE-TO gängiger (hier: C-Typ-Zuweisung)
    FINAL(lv_c10_input) = iv_input.
    DATA(lv_c10) TYPE c LENGTH 10 VALUE IS INITIAL.

    " Zuweisung zu einem C-Typ mit MOVE-CAST (in modernen Systemen wird dies besser unterstützt)
    MOVE lv_c10_input TO lv_c10.

    rv_padded = lv_c10.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implement a method that replaces the second word in a sentence with 'REPLACED'. Use `split` and `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_word_replacer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS replace_second_word
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_word_replacer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD replace_second_word.
    FINAL(lt_words) = split( val = iv_input sep = ` ` ).

    IF lines( lt_words ) > 1.
      " Verwende REDUCE, um die Wörter zu iterieren und den zweiten Index zu ersetzen
      rv_result = REDUCE string(
        INIT r = ``
             i = 0
        FOR word IN lt_words
        NEXT r = COND string( WHEN r IS INITIAL THEN COND string( WHEN i = 1 THEN 'REPLACED' ELSE word ) 
                             ELSE r && ' ' && COND string( WHEN i = 1 THEN 'REPLACED' ELSE word ) )
             i = i + 1 ).
    ELSE.
      rv_result = iv_input.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Write a method that removes the first 5 characters and the last 3 characters of a string, if the string is long enough (>= 8 chars). Use `COND` and `SUBSTRING`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_trimmer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS trim_ends
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_trimmed) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_trimmer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD trim_ends.
    FINAL(lv_length) = strlen( iv_input ).
    FINAL(lv_offset) = 5.
    FINAL(lv_trim_end) = 3.

    rv_trimmed = COND string(
      WHEN lv_length >= ( lv_offset + lv_trim_end )
        THEN substring( val = iv_input
                        off = lv_offset
                        len = lv_length - lv_offset - lv_trim_end )
      ELSE iv_input ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implement a method that repeats a given string exactly 5 times, concatenated without a separator. Use `REDUCE` with a `FOR` Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_repeater DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS repeat_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_repeated) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_repeater IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD repeat_string.
    " Nutze REDUCE mit einer FOR-Schleife über eine feste Anzahl von Wiederholungen
    rv_repeated = REDUCE string( INIT r = ``
                                 FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 WHILE i <= 5
                                 NEXT r = r && iv_input ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Write a method that replaces occurrences of 'ä', 'ö', 'ü', and 'ß' with 'ae', 'oe', 'ue', and 'ss' respectively. Use chained `REPLACE` functions.
solution:
CLASS zcl_umlaut_replacer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_umlaut_replacer IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Implement a method that checks if a string is a valid UUID (z.B. 'a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-1234-567890abcdef'). Use regular expressions.

Instructions: Write a method that tokenizes a string based on a given delimiter (e.g., ','), only returning tokens (Wortteile), die nicht leer sind. Use `split` und `FILTER`.

Instructions: Implement a method that formats a given phone number (z.B. '49123456789') in ein international übliches Format '+XX XXX XX XXX'. Entferne alle nicht-numerischen Zeichen vorher.
solution:
CLASS zcl_phone_formatter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS format_phone_number
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_formatted) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_phone_formatter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_phone_number.
    " 1. Entferne alle nicht-numerischen Zeichen
    FINAL(lv_digits_only) = replace_regex( val = iv_input regex = '[^0-9]' with = '' occ = 0 ).

    " 2. Wende das Format nur an, wenn genügend Ziffern vorhanden sind (z.B. 11 für +XX XXX XX XXX)
    IF strlen( lv_digits_only ) >= 11.
      rv_formatted = |+{ substring( val = lv_digits_only len = 2 ) } |
                   && |{ substring( val = lv_digits_only off = 2 len = 3 ) } |
                   && |{ substring( val = lv_digits_only off = 5 len = 2 ) } |
                   && |{ substring( val = lv_digits_only off = 7 ) }|.
    ELSE.
      rv_formatted = lv_digits_only. " Gib unformatierten Wert zurück
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Write a method that converts a boolean flag (ABAP_BOOL) into a string ('TRUE' or 'FALSE'). Use the `SWITCH` operator.

CLASS zcl_bool_to_string DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Implement a method that extracts all numbers (Ganze Zahlen) from a string and returns them as a table of strings. Use `FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX`.

CLASS zcl_number_extractor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_number_extractor IMPLEMENTATION.

    FINAL(lv_regex) = '\d+'.

Instructions: Write a method that checks if a string is composed entirely of lowercase letters. Use regular expressions.

Instructions: Implement a method that splits a string at the first colon (':') and returns the part before the colon (the key). Use the `FIND` und `SUBSTRING` functions.

Instructions: Write a method that takes a table of strings and checks if any of the strings contain the substring 'error'. Return the count of strings containing the error.
solution:
CLASS zcl_error_counter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_strings TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS count_errors
      IMPORTING
        it_strings TYPE tt_strings
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_error_counter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_errors.
    " Verwende REDUCE, um die Zeilen zu zählen, die 'error' enthalten (case-insensitive)
    rv_count = REDUCE i( INIT count = 0
                          FOR line IN it_strings
                          NEXT count = count + COND i(
                            WHEN find_any_of( val = to_lower( line ) sub = 'error' ) >= 0 THEN 1
                            ELSE 0 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Write a method that extracts the content of a custom attribute in a simple XML string, e.g., `<data key='value'>` -> extracts 'value' for key 'key'. Use regular expressions.

CLASS zcl_xml_attribute_extractor IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Implement a method that wraps a string in double quotes if it is not already wrapped in double quotes. Use `COND` and string functions.

CLASS zcl_double_quote_wrapper IMPLEMENTATION.

    rv_wrapped = COND string(

Instructions: Write a method that converts a number string (e.g., '1234567.89') to a formatted currency string in German format (e.g., '1.234.567,89'). Use the `WRITE TO` statement with `CURRENCY` formatting.
solution:
CLASS zcl_currency_formatter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS format_to_german_currency
      IMPORTING
        iv_amount_str TYPE string " Input as a string representation of a number
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_formatted) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_currency_formatter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_to_german_currency.
    DATA(lv_amount) TYPE p DECIMALS 2.
    
    " 1. Konvertiere den String in den numerischen Typ P (unter Annahme des US-Formats im String)
    TRY.
        lv_amount = replace( val = iv_amount_str sub = '.' with = ',' occ = 0 ).
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
        rv_formatted = 'Conversion Error'.
        RETURN.
    ENDTRY.

    " 2. Verwende WRITE TO für die formatierte Ausgabe (nimmt Standard-Systemeinstellungen/DE-Format an)
    WRITE lv_amount TO rv_formatted CURRENCY 'EUR'.
    
    " Entferne unnötige Leerzeichen, die durch WRITE TO entstehen können
    rv_formatted = condense( rv_formatted ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implement a method that splits a string containing key-value pairs separated by commas (',') and an equals sign ('=') into a HASHED table. E.g., 'key1=value1,key2=value2'. Use `SPLIT` and `FOR` expressions.
solution:
CLASS zcl_key_value_parser DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_pair,
             key TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_pair,
           tt_pair TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_pair WITH UNIQUE KEY key.

    METHODS parse_key_value_pairs
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_pairs) TYPE tt_pair.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_key_value_parser IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_key_value_pairs.
    FINAL(lt_raw_pairs) = split( val = iv_input sep = ',' ).

    " Verwende FOR-Ausdruck und SPLIT innerhalb der Schleife zur Befüllung der HASHED TABLE
    rt_pairs = VALUE tt_pair( FOR raw_pair IN lt_raw_pairs
                               WHERE ( raw_pair IS NOT INITIAL )
                               LET lv_equal_pos = find( val = raw_pair sub = '=' )
                                   lv_key   = condense( substring( val = raw_pair len = lv_equal_pos ) )
                                   lv_value = condense( substring( val = raw_pair off = lv_equal_pos + 1 ) ) IN
                                 ( key = lv_key value = lv_value ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Write a method that extracts the content between square brackets '[...]' from a string. Return an empty string if no brackets are found. Use regular expressions.

CLASS zcl_bracket_extractor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_bracket_extractor IMPLEMENTATION.

    " Regex: '[' gefolgt von beliebigen Zeichen (non-greedy, '[^]]*?') bis zum ']'
    FINAL(lv_regex) = '\[(.*?)\]'.

    FINAL(lv_match) = match_regex( val = iv_input regex = lv_regex ).

    IF lv_match-submatches IS NOT INITIAL.
      " Die erste Capture Group (1) enthält den Inhalt innerhalb der Klammern
      rv_content = lv_match-submatches[ 1 ].
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implement a method that inserts a specific character (e.g., a hyphen '-') after every 4th character in a string (z.B. '12345678' -> '1234-5678'). Use `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_inserter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS insert_delimiter
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
        iv_delimiter TYPE char1
        iv_interval TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_inserter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD insert_delimiter.
    FINAL(lv_length) = strlen( iv_input ).

    " REDUCE iteriert über die Indizes der Eingabe und baut den String schrittweise auf
    rv_result = REDUCE string( INIT r = ``
                                    i = 0
                               FOR i = 0 THEN i + iv_interval WHILE i < lv_length
                               LET lv_segment = substring( val = iv_input off = i len = iv_interval ) IN
                               NEXT r = COND string(
                                  WHEN r IS INITIAL THEN lv_segment
                                  ELSE r && iv_delimiter && lv_segment ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Write a method that capitalizes the first letter of every word in a sentence (Word Capitalization). Use `SPLIT`, `REDUCE` und `TO_UPPER`/`TO_LOWER`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sentence_capitalizer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS capitalize_words
      IMPORTING
        iv_sentence TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sentence_capitalizer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD capitalize_words.
    FINAL(lt_words) = split( val = iv_sentence sep = ` ` ).

    rv_result = REDUCE string(
      INIT r = ``
      FOR word IN lt_words
      WHERE ( word IS NOT INITIAL )
      LET lv_capitalized_word = COND string(
                                  WHEN strlen( word ) > 0
                                    THEN to_upper( substring( val = word len = 1 ) ) 
                                       && to_lower( substring( val = word off = 1 ) )
                                  ELSE '' ) IN
      NEXT r = COND string(
        WHEN r IS INITIAL THEN lv_capitalized_word
        ELSE r && ' ' && lv_capitalized_word ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implement a method that masks the central part of a sensitive string (e.g., credit card number) to display only the first 4 and last 4 characters. The rest should be replaced by asterisks ('*').
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_masker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS mask_sensitive_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_masked) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_masker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD mask_sensitive_data.
    FINAL(lv_len) = strlen( iv_input ).
    FINAL(lv_show_start) = 4.
    FINAL(lv_show_end) = 4.

    IF lv_len <= lv_show_start + lv_show_end.
      rv_masked = iv_input. " Keine Maskierung, wenn zu kurz
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    FINAL(lv_mask_len) = lv_len - lv_show_start - lv_show_end.

    " String-Templates und String-Funktionen für die Maskierung
    rv_masked = |{ substring( val = iv_input len = lv_show_start ) }|
              && |{ repeat( val = '*' occ = lv_mask_len ) }|
              && |{ substring( val = iv_input off = lv_len - lv_show_end ) }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Write a method that replaces the value of a specific placeholder (z.B. '${placeholder}') in a template string with a given replacement value. Use regular expressions.

Instructions: Implement a method that removes all occurrences of a list of stop words (e.g., 'the', 'a', 'is') from an input string. Use `REDUCE` and `REPLACE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_stop_word_remover DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_stop_words TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS remove_stop_words
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
        it_stop_words TYPE tt_stop_words
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_stop_word_remover IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD remove_stop_words.
    FINAL(lv_input_lower) = to_lower( iv_input ).
    
    rv_result = REDUCE string( INIT result = lv_input_lower
                                 FOR stop_word IN it_stop_words
                                 LET lv_padded_word = | { stop_word } | IN
                                 NEXT result = replace( val = result 
                                                       sub = lv_padded_word
                                                       with = ' '
                                                       occ = 0 ) ).
                                                       
    " Entferne führende/nachfolgende und doppelte Leerzeichen
    rv_result = condense( val = rv_result no-gaps = abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Write a method that checks if two strings are anagrams of each other (sie bestehen aus den gleichen Buchstaben in unterschiedlicher Reihenfolge).
solution:
CLASS zcl_anagram_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS are_anagrams
      IMPORTING
        iv_str1 TYPE string
        iv_str2 TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_anagram) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_anagram_checker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD are_anagrams.
    " 1. Hilfsfunktion: String normalisieren (Kleinbuchstaben, Leerzeichen entfernen)
    FINAL(lv_clean1) = to_lower( replace_regex( val = iv_str1 regex = '[^a-zA-Z]' with = '' occ = 0 ) ).
    FINAL(lv_clean2) = to_lower( replace_regex( val = iv_str2 regex = '[^a-zA-Z]' with = '' occ = 0 ) ).
    
    " 2. Prüfe auf gleiche Länge
    IF strlen( lv_clean1 ) <> strlen( lv_clean2 ).
      rv_is_anagram = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " 3. Sortiere die Charaktere und vergleiche
    FINAL(lv_sorted1) = sort( lv_clean1 ).
    FINAL(lv_sorted2) = sort( lv_clean2 ).

    rv_is_anagram = xsdbool( lv_sorted1 = lv_sorted2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implement a method that generates a unique 8-character ID string composed of random uppercase letters and digits. Use `CL_ABAP_RANDOM` und `REPEAT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_id_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_random_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_id) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_id_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_random_id.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random=>create( ).
    DATA(lv_char_pool) TYPE string VALUE 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789'.
    FINAL(lv_pool_len) = strlen( lv_char_pool ).
    rv_id = ``.

    " Schleife 8 mal, um 8 zufällige Zeichen zu generieren
    rv_id = REDUCE string( INIT r = ``
                           FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 WHILE i <= 8
                           LET lv_rand_num = lo_random->int4( min = 0 max = lv_pool_len - 1 )
                           IN
                           NEXT r = r && substring( val = lv_char_pool off = lv_rand_num len = 1 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Write a method that reverses the characters of a string only for the second half of the string. The first half remains unchanged.
solution:
CLASS zcl_half_reverse DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS reverse_second_half
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_half_reverse IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD reverse_second_half.
    FINAL(lv_len) = strlen( iv_input ).
    FINAL(lv_half_len) = lv_len DIV 2.

    FINAL(lv_first_half) = substring( val = iv_input len = lv_half_len ).
    FINAL(lv_second_half) = substring( val = iv_input off = lv_half_len ).

    FINAL(lv_reversed_second) = reverse( lv_second_half ).

    rv_result = lv_first_half && lv_reversed_second.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implement a method that counts the number of times a specific word (case-insensitive) appears in a longer text.

CLASS zcl_word_frequency DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
        iv_word TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_word_frequency IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_word.
    " Um Case-Insensitive zu suchen, konvertiere sowohl den Text als auch das Wort
    FINAL(lv_text_lower) = to_lower( iv_text ).
    FINAL(lv_word_lower) = to_lower( iv_word ).
    
    " Füge Leerzeichen hinzu, um sicherzustellen, dass nur ganze Wörter gezählt werden (' the ')
    FINAL(lv_search_term) = | { lv_word_lower } |.
    FINAL(lv_text_padded) = | { lv_text_lower } |.

    " Verwende COUNT für die Anzahl der Vorkommen des Wortes
    rv_count = count( val = lv_text_padded sub = lv_search_term ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implement a method that generates a random password string of a specified length, including special characters from a predefined set.
solution:
CLASS zcl_pwd_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    METHODS generate_password
      IMPORTING
        iv_length TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_password) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_pwd_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_password.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random=>create( ).
    DATA(lv_char_pool) TYPE string VALUE 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789!@#$%^&*()'.
    FINAL(lv_pool_len) = strlen( lv_char_pool ).

    IF iv_length <= 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " REDUCE zur sequenziellen Generierung
    rv_password = REDUCE string( INIT r = ``
                                 FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 WHILE i <= iv_length
                                 LET lv_rand_num = lo_random->int4( min = 0 max = lv_pool_len - 1 )
                                 IN
                                 NEXT r = r && substring( val = lv_char_pool off = lv_rand_num len = 1 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_valid_date_format.
    " Regex für YYYYMMDD: 4 Ziffern, gefolgt von 2 Ziffern, gefolgt von 2 Ziffern. Prüft nur das Format, nicht die logische Gültigkeit (z.B. 30. Feb)
    FINAL(lv_regex) = '^\d{8}$'.
    
    IF match( val = iv_input regex = lv_regex ) = abap_true.
      " Zusätzliche logische Prüfung: Versuche, den String in DATS zu konvertieren
      DATA(lv_date) TYPE dats.
      TRY.
          lv_date = iv_input.
          rv_is_valid = abap_true.
        CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
          rv_is_valid = abap_false.
      ENDTRY.
    ELSE.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Write a method that generates a hash (SHA-256) for a given input string using the ABAP hashing classes.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hash_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_sha256
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_hash_hex) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hash_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_sha256.
    " 1. Instanziierung des SHA-256-Algorithmus
    DATA(lo_hash) = cl_abap_message_digest=>create( algorithm = 'SHA256' ).
    
    " 2. String in XSTRING (Raw Data) konvertieren
    DATA(lv_xstring) = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_out( codepage = 'UTF-8' )->convert_to( iv_input ).
    
    " 3. Hash berechnen
    lo_hash->update( lv_xstring ).
    FINAL(lv_hash_raw) = lo_hash->get_hash( ).
    
    " 4. Hash (XSTRING) in HEX-String konvertieren
    rv_hash_hex = cl_abap_conv_x2x_ce=>create_hex( )->convert( lv_hash_raw ).
    
    " Optional: Kleinbuchstaben für Standard-Hash-Ausgabe
    rv_hash_hex = to_lower( rv_hash_hex ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_leading_zero_remover IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD remove_leading_zeros.
    " Regex: Ersetze alle führenden Nullen ('^0+') durch nichts. Nutze ^ für String-Anfang.
    " Vorsicht: Das würde '0' zu '' machen, daher nur anwenden, wenn der String länger als 1 ist oder nicht nur Nullen enthält.
    IF iv_input <> '0' AND match( val = iv_input regex = '^0+$' ) = abap_false.

                                     regex = '^0+'
                                     with = ''
                                     occ = 1 ).

    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_word_reverser IMPLEMENTATION.

    " Regex: '^(\w+)\s+(\w+)' erfasst Wort 1 ($1) und Wort 2 ($2) am Anfang ('^') der Zeile.
    FINAL(lv_regex) = '^(\w+)\s+(\w+)'.
    FINAL(lv_replacement) = '$2 $1'.

CLASS zcl_regex_quote_extractor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_quoted_content.
    " Regex: Findet , erfasst den Inhalt (.*?), und prüft auf das schließende . 
    " Nutzt NON-GREEDY Matcher (*?)
    FINAL(lv_regex) = '"(.*?)"'.

    FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX lv_regex IN iv_input
      RESULTS DATA(lt_results) SUBMATCHES DATA(lt_submatches).

    " Finde alle Matches. Die gesuchten Inhalte sind in der ersten Subgruppe (Index 1)
    rt_content = VALUE tt_content( FOR submatch IN lt_submatches
                                    WHERE ( table_line IS NOT INITIAL ) 
                                    ( submatch[ 1 ] ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Write a method that extracts all unique words from a string into a sorted table of strings (case-insensitive). Use `FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX` und einen HASHED TABLE.
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_unique_words DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_unique_words TYPE SORTED TABLE OF string WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.
    METHODS extract_unique_words
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_words) TYPE tt_unique_words.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_unique_words IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_unique_words.
    TYPES tt_hashed TYPE HASHED TABLE OF string WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.
    DATA(lt_unique_hashed) TYPE tt_hashed.

    " Regex für Wörter (an Wortgrenzen \b, mindestens ein Zeichen \w+)
    FINAL(lv_regex) = '\b\w+\b'.
    FINAL(lv_input_lower) = to_lower( iv_input ).

    FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX lv_regex IN lv_input_lower RESULTS DATA(lt_results).

    " Verwende FOR-Ausdruck zur Extraktion und direkten Befüllung der HASHED TABLE, um Duplikate zu vermeiden
    lt_unique_hashed = VALUE tt_hashed( FOR result IN lt_results
                                         ( substring( val = lv_input_lower off = result-offset len = result-length ) ) ).

    " Kopiere in SORTED TABLE für die sortierte Ausgabe
    rt_words = CORRESPONDING #( lt_unique_hashed ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    FINAL(lv_regex) = '#(\w+)'.

      RESULTS DATA(lt_results) SUBMATCHES DATA(lt_submatches).

Instructions: Implement a method to replace all non-breaking spaces (HTML ` ` oder Unicode `\u00A0`) with a standard space ' '. Use `REPLACE_REGEX`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_nbsp_replacer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS normalize_spaces
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_nbsp_replacer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD normalize_spaces.
    " Regex: Ersetze das Unicode-Non-Breaking Space (A0 in Hex) durch ein Leerzeichen.
    " Hinweis: In ABAP-Quelltexten muss man den Unicode-Wert oft als XSTRING und dann als String darstellen, hier simulieren wir den String-Literal.
    DATA(lv_nbsp_char) TYPE string VALUE cl_abap_char_utilities=>char_h00a0.
    DATA(lv_temp_result) TYPE string.

    " 1. Ersetze das Unicode-Zeichen
    lv_temp_result = replace( val = iv_input sub = lv_nbsp_char with = ' ' occ = 0 ).

    " 2. Ersetze ' ' (falls als String vorhanden) mit einem Leerzeichen (zusätzliche Bereinigung)
    rv_result = replace_regex( val = lv_temp_result
                                 regex = ' '
                                 with = ' '
                                 occ = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Write a method that checks if a string is a valid, simple password: at least 8 characters long and contains at least one digit and one uppercase letter. Use `MATCH` und Lookarounds (simuliert durch mehrere `MATCH`s).

CLASS zcl_regex_pwd_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_pwd_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_valid_password.
    " 1. Länge prüfen: >= 8 Zeichen
    FINAL(lv_min_length) = match( val = iv_input regex = '.{8,}' ).
    
    " 2. Mindestens eine Ziffer prüfen
    FINAL(lv_has_digit) = match( val = iv_input regex = '\d' ).
    
    " 3. Mindestens einen Großbuchstaben prüfen
    FINAL(lv_has_upper) = match( val = iv_input regex = '[A-Z]' ).

    rv_is_valid = xsdbool( lv_min_length AND lv_has_digit AND lv_has_upper ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

             name TYPE string,

CLASS zcl_regex_attribute_extractor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_attributes.
    " Regex: Findet (1) Attributname (\w+), gefolgt von '=' und dem Wert in Anführungszeichen (2) (.*?) 
    FINAL(lv_regex) = '(\w+) *?= *?"(.*?)"'.

    FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX lv_regex IN iv_input
      RESULTS DATA(lt_results) SUBMATCHES DATA(lt_submatches).

    rt_attributes = VALUE tt_attributes( FOR submatch IN lt_submatches
                                        WHERE ( lines( submatch ) > 1 AND submatch[ 1 ] IS NOT INITIAL )
                                        ( name = submatch[ 1 ] value = submatch[ 2 ] ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Write a method that removes all characters from a string that are repeated consecutively more than three times (z.B. 'AAAAB' -> 'AAAB'). Use `REPLACE_REGEX`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_repetition_remover DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS reduce_repetition
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_repetition_remover IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD reduce_repetition.
    DATA(lv_result) = iv_input.

    " Regex: Findet ein beliebiges Zeichen ('.') gefolgt von einer Wiederholung von 4 oder mehr Malen (\4,). 
    " Ersetze das Muster durch die ersten drei Zeichen ($1$1$1) des Musters. WIEDERHOLT. 
    " ACHTUNG: ABAP REPLACES nur die gefundene Gruppe, daher muss man es iterativ machen.
    DO 10 TIMES. " max 10 Durchläufe, um die Kette zu brechen
      FINAL(lv_temp) = lv_result.
      
      " Regex: Findet 4 oder mehr aufeinanderfolgende gleiche Zeichen. Ersetze durch 3 davon.
      " Nutze einen Backreference: (\S) findet ein Zeichen, \1{3,} findet es 3x wiederholt.
      FINAL(lv_regex) = '(\S)\1{3,}'.
      FINAL(lv_replacement) = '$1$1$1'. 
      
      lv_result = replace_regex( val = lv_result
                                   regex = lv_regex
                                   with = lv_replacement
                                   occ = 0 ).
      
      IF lv_temp = lv_result. " Ende der Reduktion erreicht
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Write a method that replaces all occurrences of a word **only if** it is preceded by 'PREFIX:'. Use `REPLACE_REGEX` mit Lookbehind (simuliert).
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_conditional_replacer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS replace_if_prefixed
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
        iv_word TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_conditional_replacer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD replace_if_prefixed.
    " Regex: Sucht 'PREFIX:' gefolgt von dem zu ersetzenden Wort. Wir ersetzen nur das Wort.
    " Der Lookbehind wird in ABAP über die Capture Group $1 simuliert, d.h. wir erfassen den Präfix $1 und ersetzen dann nur das Wort.
    FINAL(lv_regex) = |(PREFIX: *?){ iv_word }|.
    FINAL(lv_replacement) = |$1REPLACED|.
    
    rv_result = replace_regex( val = iv_input
                                 regex = lv_regex
                                 with = lv_replacement
                                 occ = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_comment_extractor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      IMPORTING
        iv_code TYPE string

CLASS zcl_regex_comment_extractor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_single_line_comment.
    " Regex: Sucht '//' gefolgt von beliebigen Zeichen, die keine Zeilenumbrüche sind ('[^\r\n]*').
    FINAL(lv_regex) = '//([^\r\n]*)'.

    FINAL(lv_match) = match_regex( val = iv_code regex = lv_regex ).

    IF lv_match-submatches IS NOT INITIAL.
      " Die Submatch-Gruppe (1) enthält den Kommentartext ohne '//'
      rv_comment = condense( lv_match-submatches[ 1 ] ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_num_converter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF p DECIMALS 2 WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS extract_and_convert
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_numbers_p) TYPE tt_numbers.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_num_converter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_and_convert.
    " Regex: Findet ganze Zahlen, optional gefolgt von '.' und Ziffern
    FINAL(lv_regex) = '\d+(\.\d+)?'.

    FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX lv_regex IN iv_input RESULTS DATA(lt_results).

    rt_numbers_p = VALUE tt_numbers( FOR result IN lt_results
                                      LET lv_num_str = substring( val = iv_input off = result-offset len = result-length ) IN
                                      ( COND p DECIMALS 2(
                                          WHEN lv_num_str IS INITIAL THEN 0
                                          ELSE lv_num_str ) ) ).

Instructions: Implement a method that checks if a string is a palindrome (liest sich vorwärts und rückwärts gleich), ignoring case and non-alphanumeric characters.
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_palindrome_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_palindrome
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_palindrome) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_palindrome_checker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_palindrome.
    " 1. String normalisieren: Kleinbuchstaben und nur Alphanumerische Zeichen beibehalten
    FINAL(lv_clean_temp) = replace_regex( val = iv_input regex = '[^a-zA-Z0-9]' with = '' occ = 0 ).
    FINAL(lv_clean_normalized) = to_lower( lv_clean_temp ).
    
    " 2. String umkehren
    FINAL(lv_reversed) = reverse( lv_clean_normalized ).

    " 3. Vergleichen
    rv_is_palindrome = xsdbool( lv_clean_normalized = lv_reversed ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_underscore_trimmer IMPLEMENTATION.

    " 1. Führende Unterstriche entfernen (Start des Strings ^, gefolgt von einem oder mehr '_')
    lv_result = replace_regex( val = lv_result regex = '^_+' with = '' occ = 1 ).
    
    " 2. Nachfolgende Unterstriche entfernen (Ende des Strings $, gefolgt von einem oder mehr '_')
    rv_result = replace_regex( val = lv_result regex = '_+$' with = '' occ = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_negative_lookaround IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD replace_non_critical_error.
    " Da ABAP keine echten Negativ-Lookbehinds hat, müssen wir positiv erfassen und dann selektiv ersetzen.
    " 1. Ersetze 'critical error' durch einen Platzhalter, um es zu schützen.
    DATA(lv_protected) = replace_regex( val = iv_input regex = '(?i)critical error' with = '$$$CRITICAL_ERROR$$$' occ = 0 ).

    " 2. Ersetze alle übrigen 'error' (case-insensitive) durch 'SUCCESS'
    FINAL(lv_temp_result) = replace_regex( val = lv_protected regex = '(?i)error' with = 'SUCCESS' occ = 0 ).
    
    " 3. Setze den Platzhalter zurück
    rv_result = replace_regex( val = lv_temp_result regex = '$$$CRITICAL_ERROR$$$' with = 'critical error' occ = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Write a method that extracts all key names (Wörter vor dem Doppelpunkt) aus einem Konfigurationsstring im Format 'key1:value1, key2:value2, ...'.
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_key_extractor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_keys TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS extract_keys
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_keys) TYPE tt_keys.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_key_extractor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_keys.
    " Regex: Findet eine Wortgruppe (\w+), gefolgt von einem Doppelpunkt. Die Capture Group (1) erfasst nur das Wort.
    FINAL(lv_regex) = '(\w+):'.

    FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX lv_regex IN iv_input
      RESULTS DATA(lt_results) SUBMATCHES DATA(lt_submatches).

    " Die Submatches (Index 1) enthalten den Schlüssel ohne den Doppelpunkt.
    rt_keys = VALUE tt_keys( FOR submatch IN lt_submatches
                             WHERE ( table_line IS NOT INITIAL ) 
                             ( submatch[ 1 ] ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    FINAL(lv_regex) = '(?i)\b([a-z])\w*\1\b'.

Instructions: Write a method that inserts a comma (',') as a thousands separator in a number string (z.B. '1234567' -> '1,234,567'). Use `REPLACE_REGEX` mit Lookarounds (simuliert).
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_thousand_separator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS format_thousands
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_thousand_separator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_thousands.
    " Regex: Sucht nach einer Ziffer (\d) NUR WENN ihr DREI weitere Ziffern folgen, gefolgt von einer Wortgrenze (oder Ende).
    " Die Klammern erfassen die Ziffer, die ersetzt werden soll ($1).
    FINAL(lv_regex) = '(\d)(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))'.
    FINAL(lv_replacement) = '$1,'.
    
    " ACHTUNG: ABAP unterstützt negative Lookaheads ((?!\d)) nicht zuverlässig; die effizienteste ABAP-Lösung wäre WRITE TO, aber wir folgen der Regex-Vorgabe (mit einfacherem Lookahead)
    " Wir verwenden einen vereinfachten Regex-Ansatz, der oft bei der Simulation funktioniert:
    FINAL(lv_simple_regex) = '(\d)(\d{3}\b)'. " Findet eine Ziffer gefolgt von 3 Ziffern am Ende oder vor Wortgrenze (sehr vereinfacht)
    
    DATA(lv_result) = iv_input.
    
    " Muss iterativ von rechts nach links ersetzen
    DO 10 TIMES. 
      FINAL(lv_temp) = lv_result.
      
      " Sucht eine Ziffer, gefolgt von 3 Ziffern, die am Ende oder vor einer Trennung stehen.
      FINAL(lv_iterative_regex) = '(\d)(\d{3})(?:\b|$)'.
      FINAL(lv_iterative_replacement) = '$1,$2'.
      
      lv_result = replace_regex( val = lv_result
                                   regex = lv_iterative_regex
                                   with = lv_iterative_replacement
                                   occ = 0 ).
                                   
      IF lv_temp = lv_result.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.
    rv_result = lv_result.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implement a method that uses a `LEFT OUTER JOIN` between `SPFLI` and `SFLIGHT` to list all connections, and display a `FLIGHT_STATUS` using `COALESCE`: 'No Flights Scheduled' if no flight exists, otherwise 'Flights Available'.
solution:
CLASS zcl_select_coalesce_join DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_connection_status,
             carrid TYPE spfli-carrid,
             connid TYPE spfli-connid,
             flight_status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_connection_status,
           tt_connection_status TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_connection_status WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS get_connection_status
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_status) TYPE tt_connection_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_select_coalesce_join IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_connection_status.
    SELECT p~carrid, p~connid,
           COALESCE( f~fldate, 'No Flights Scheduled' ) AS status_check
      FROM spfli AS p
      LEFT OUTER JOIN sflight AS f ON p~carrid = f~carrid AND p~connid = f~connid
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_raw_status) BYPASSING BUFFER.

    " Post-processing using REDUCE to get one status per connection
    rt_status = VALUE #( FOR raw IN lt_raw_status
                         ( carrid = raw-carrid 
                           connid = raw-connid 
                           flight_status = COND string( WHEN raw-status_check = 'No Flights Scheduled' THEN 'No Flights Scheduled' ELSE 'Flights Available' ) ) ).

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_select_date_diff DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_date_diff,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             days_ago TYPE i,
           END OF ty_date_diff,
           tt_date_diff TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_date_diff WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_days_ago
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_diffs) TYPE tt_date_diff.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_select_date_diff IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_days_ago.
    " DATS_DAYS_BETWEEN( date1, date2 ) -> date1 - date2
    SELECT carrid, fldate,
           DATS_DAYS_BETWEEN( @sy-datum, fldate ) AS days_ago
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @rt_diffs
      WHERE fldate < @sy-datum
      ORDER BY fldate DESCENDING.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Write a method to retrieve all flight prices from SFLIGHT that are within 10% of the average price of all flights, using a subquery and basic arithmetic operators.
solution:
CLASS zcl_select_price_range DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_sflight_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_mid_range_price_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_select_price_range IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_mid_range_price_flights.
    DATA(lv_avg_price) TYPE sflight-price.

    SELECT SINGLE AVG( price ) INTO @lv_avg_price FROM sflight.

    IF lv_avg_price IS NOT INITIAL.
      FINAL(lv_lower_bound) = lv_avg_price * 0.9.
      FINAL(lv_upper_bound) = lv_avg_price * 1.1.

      SELECT * FROM sflight
        INTO TABLE @rt_flights
        WHERE price BETWEEN @lv_lower_bound AND @lv_upper_bound.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implement a method that uses `UNION` (implicit `DISTINCT`) to combine all departure and arrival cities from SPFLI into a single list of unique cities, ordered alphabetically.
solution:
CLASS zcl_select_union_cities DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_city_list TYPE SORTED TABLE OF spfli-cityfrom WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.
    METHODS get_unique_cities
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_cities) TYPE tt_city_list.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_select_union_cities IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_unique_cities.
    DATA: lt_city_from TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF spfli-cityfrom WITH EMPTY KEY,
          lt_city_to TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF spfli-cityto WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT cityfrom FROM spfli INTO TABLE @lt_city_from.
    SELECT cityto FROM spfli INTO TABLE @lt_city_to.

    " Combine lists and remove duplicates using an internal sorted table
    rt_cities = VALUE #( FOR city IN lt_city_from ( city ) ).
    LOOP AT lt_city_to INTO DATA(lv_city).
      INSERT lv_city INTO TABLE rt_cities.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_select_time_calc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_time,
             connid TYPE spfli-connid,
             deptime TYPE spfli-deptime,
             fltime TYPE spfli-fltime,

    METHODS calculate_arrival_time
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_times) TYPE tt_flight_time.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_select_time_calc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_arrival_time.
    SELECT connid, deptime, fltime,
           TIMS_ADD( deptime, fltime * 60 ) AS arrival_time " FLTIME is in minutes, TIMS_ADD expects seconds

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Check if an input string is a valid **UUID** format (8-4-4-4-12 hexadecimal digits, case-insensitive). Use `MATCH_REGEX`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_uuid_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_valid_uuid
      IMPORTING iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_uuid_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_valid_uuid.
    " Regex: {8}-{4}-{4}-{4}-{12} Hex-Zahlen. (?i) für case-insensitive.
    FINAL(lv_regex) = '(?i)^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'.
    rv_is_valid = match( val = iv_input regex = lv_regex ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Check if a string contains **only** uppercase letters (A-Z) and spaces, from start to end.
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_uppercase_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      IMPORTING iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_only_upper) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_uppercase_checker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD contains_only_uppercase.
    " Regex: Beginnt (^) und Endet ($) mit 0 oder mehr Großbuchstaben oder Leerzeichen.
    FINAL(lv_regex) = '^[A-Z ]*$'.
    rv_only_upper = match( val = iv_input regex = lv_regex ).

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_z_finder IMPLEMENTATION.

CLASS zcl_regex_num_extractor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_regex_num_extractor IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Extract the **key and value** from all URL query parameters in the format `key=value&` (non-greedy).

CLASS zcl_regex_query_extractor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             key TYPE string,

    METHODS extract_params
      IMPORTING iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_params) TYPE tt_params.

CLASS zcl_regex_query_extractor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_params.
    " Regex: Erfasst Key (1) und Value (2) aus 'key=value'. Nutzt [^&] um '&' zu vermeiden.
    FINAL(lv_regex) = '([^=]+?)=([^&]*)'.

    FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX lv_regex IN iv_input SUBMATCHES DATA(lt_submatches).

    rt_params = VALUE tt_params( FOR submatch IN lt_submatches
                                    WHERE ( lines( submatch ) > 1 AND submatch[ 1 ] IS NOT INITIAL )
                                    ( key = submatch[ 1 ] value = submatch[ 2 ] ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Extract the date (1), time (2), and message (3) from a simple log line: `[YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS] Message Text`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_log_extractor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_log_entry,
             date TYPE string,
             time TYPE string,
             message TYPE string,
           END OF ty_log_entry.

    METHODS extract_log_details
      IMPORTING iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rs_entry) TYPE ty_log_entry.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_log_extractor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_log_details.
    " Regex: [Datum (1) Uhrzeit (2)] Nachricht (3)
    FINAL(lv_regex) = '\[(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}) (\d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2})\] (.*)'.

    FINAL(lv_match) = match_regex( val = iv_input regex = lv_regex ).

    IF lv_match-submatches IS NOT INITIAL AND lines( lv_match-submatches ) >= 3.
      rs_entry-date = lv_match-submatches[ 1 ].
      rs_entry-time = lv_match-submatches[ 2 ].
      rs_entry-message = lv_match-submatches[ 3 ].

ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Remove **all leading and trailing whitespace** (spaces, tabs, newlines) from a string.
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_full_trimmer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS trim_all_whitespace
      IMPORTING iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_full_trimmer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD trim_all_whitespace.
    DATA(lv_result) = iv_input.
    
    " 1. Führende Whitespace entfernen: Start des Strings ('^'), gefolgt von einem oder mehr Whitespace-Zeichen ('\s+')
    lv_result = replace_regex( val = lv_result regex = '^\s+' with = '' occ = 1 ).
    
    " 2. Nachfolgende Whitespace entfernen: Ende des Strings ('$'), gefolgt von einem oder mehr Whitespace-Zeichen ('\s+')
    rv_result = replace_regex( val = lv_result regex = '\s+$' with = '' occ = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_unpad_zeros DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

  METHOD unpad_up_to_three_zeros.
    " Regex: Start der Zeile (^), gefolgt von 1 bis 3 Nullen ('0{1,3}').
    FINAL(lv_regex) = '^0{1,3}'.
    
    " OCC = 1, da nur am Anfang ersetzt werden soll
    rv_result = replace_regex( val = iv_input
                                 regex = lv_regex
                                 with = ''
                                 occ = 1 ).

Instructions: Replace all **hyphens** (`-`) that are **NOT** immediately preceded by a digit (Lookbehind simulation).
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_conditional_hyphen DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS replace_non_numeric_hyphens
      IMPORTING iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_conditional_hyphen IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD replace_non_numeric_hyphens.
    " Regex: Sucht nach Bindestrich, der nicht von einer Ziffer ([^\d]) gefolgt wird, ODER am Zeilenanfang.
    FINAL(lv_regex) = '([^\d-])-'.
    
    " Ersetze das Muster durch Gruppe 1 (das davorstehende Zeichen) gefolgt von Leerzeichen. Dadurch werden nur Bindestriche entfernt, die NICHT von einer Ziffer umgeben sind.
    DATA(lv_result) = replace_regex( val = iv_input
                                       regex = lv_regex
                                       with = '$1 '
                                       occ = 0 ).
                                       
    " Zusätzliche Behandlung für führende Bindestriche
    rv_result = replace_regex( val = lv_result regex = '^-' with = '' occ = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Replace the word 'INFO' with 'DEBUG' only if it is **NOT followed** by 'CRITICAL' (Negative Lookahead simulation).
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_negative_lookahead DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS replace_info_if_not_critical
      IMPORTING iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_negative_lookahead IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD replace_info_if_not_critical.
    " Da ABAP keine echten Negativ-Lookaheads hat, schützen wir den negativen Fall und ersetzen dann den Rest.
    
    " 1. Schütze 'INFO CRITICAL' mit einem Platzhalter
    DATA(lv_protected) = replace_regex( val = iv_input regex = 'INFO\s+CRITICAL' with = '$$$INFO_CRITICAL$$$' occ = 0 ).

    " 2. Ersetze die restlichen 'INFO'
    FINAL(lv_temp_result) = replace_regex( val = lv_protected regex = '\bINFO\b' with = 'DEBUG' occ = 0 ).
    
    " 3. Setze den Platzhalter zurück
    rv_result = replace_regex( val = lv_temp_result regex = '\$\$\$INFO_CRITICAL\$\$\$' with = 'INFO CRITICAL' occ = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Insert a space before every **uppercase letter** that is not at the start of the string (splitting CamelCase).
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_camelcase_splitter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS split_camel_case
      IMPORTING iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_camelcase_splitter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD split_camel_case.
    " Regex: Findet einen Großbuchstaben ([A-Z]) (Gruppe 1), NUR WENN ihm ein Kleinbuchstabe vorausgeht (simulierter Lookbehind).
    " Simuliere: Finde ein Kleinzeichen (1) gefolgt von einem Großzeichen (2) und ersetze durch $1 Leerzeichen $2.
    FINAL(lv_regex) = '([a-z])([A-Z])'.
    FINAL(lv_replacement) = '$1 $2'.
    
    rv_result = replace_regex( val = iv_input
                                 regex = lv_regex
                                 with = lv_replacement
                                 occ = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Validate that a string consists of exactly **three alphanumeric words separated by hyphens** (e.g., 'CODE-TEST-123').
solution:

Instructions: Extract all text that is **NOT inside parentheses** (inkl. der Klammern selbst).
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_outside_paren_extractor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_outside_content TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS extract_outside_parentheses
      IMPORTING iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_content) TYPE tt_outside_content.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_outside_paren_extractor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_outside_parentheses.
    DATA(lv_temp_input) = iv_input.
    DATA: lt_content TYPE tt_outside_content, lv_pos TYPE i = 0.

    " Regex: Findet den gesamten Inhalt der Klammern.
    FINAL(lv_regex) = '\(.*?\)'.

    FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX lv_regex IN iv_input RESULTS DATA(lt_results).

    " Manuelles Extrahieren der Zwischenräume
    LOOP AT lt_results INTO DATA(ls_result).
      DATA(lv_segment) = substring( val = iv_input off = lv_pos len = ls_result-offset - lv_pos ).
      IF lv_segment IS NOT INITIAL.
        APPEND lv_segment TO lt_content.
      ENDIF.
      lv_pos = ls_result-offset + ls_result-length.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Letztes Segment nach der letzten Klammer
    DATA(lv_last_segment) = substring( val = iv_input off = lv_pos ).
    IF lv_last_segment IS NOT INITIAL.
      APPEND lv_last_segment TO lt_content.
    ENDIF.

    rt_content = lt_content.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_conditional_hide IMPLEMENTATION.

    rv_result = iv_input.

    " 1. Prüfe auf die Bedingung 'SECRET'
    IF match( val = iv_input regex = '\bSECRET\b' ).
      " 2. Wenn Bedingung erfüllt, ersetze alle Ziffernsequenzen (\d+)
      rv_result = replace_regex( val = iv_input

Instructions: Remove the surrounding quotes from a quoted string, handling both **single and double quotes**.
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_unquote DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      IMPORTING iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_unquote IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD unquote_string.
    " Regex: Findet entweder ' oder " (1), gefolgt von Inhalt (2), gefolgt vom Rückverweis auf das Quote-Zeichen (\1).
    FINAL(lv_regex) = '^(["'])(.*?)\1$'.
    FINAL(lv_match) = match_regex( val = iv_input regex = lv_regex ).

    IF lv_match-submatches IS NOT INITIAL AND lines( lv_match-submatches ) >= 2.
      rv_result = lv_match-submatches[ 2 ].
    ELSE.
      rv_result = iv_input. " Wenn keine passenden Quotes gefunden werden, gib den Originalstring zurück
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Extract all words from a string, **excluding** a predefined set of common words (simuliert durch OR-Logik im Regex).
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_word_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_words TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS extract_non_stop_words
      IMPORTING iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_words) TYPE tt_words.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_word_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_non_stop_words.
    DATA(lv_clean_input) = iv_input.
    
    " 1. Wörter, die ausgeschlossen werden sollen (AND, OR, THE, IS, OF, A)
    FINAL(lv_stop_words_regex) = '(?i)\b(and|or|the|is|of|a)\b'.
    
    " 2. Ersetze Stop Words durch Leerzeichen, um sie später zu ignorieren
    lv_clean_input = replace_regex( val = lv_clean_input regex = lv_stop_words_regex with = ' ' occ = 0 ).
    
    " 3. Extrahiere alle verbleibenden Wörter
    FINAL(lv_word_regex) = '\b\w+\b'.

    FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX lv_word_regex IN lv_clean_input RESULTS DATA(lt_results).

    rt_words = VALUE tt_words( FOR result IN lt_results
                                    ( substring( val = lv_clean_input off = result-offset len = result-length ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_identical_delimiter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_regex_identical_delimiter IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Remove all leading **zeros** from a string, regardless of Länge, aber behalte die letzte Ziffer (e.g., '000123' -> '123', '0' -> '0').
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_remove_leading_zeros DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS remove_leading_zeros
      IMPORTING iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_remove_leading_zeros IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD remove_leading_zeros.
    " Regex: ^0+ (eine oder mehr Nullen am Anfang). Verwende $1, um die letzte Ziffer zu behalten, aber erst nach TRUNCATION der Nullen
    DATA(lv_result) = iv_input.
    
    " Einfachste Methode: CL_ABAP_CONV_UTIL=>STRING_TO_INT_NO_SIGN und zurück. Aber wir müssen Regex verwenden:
    " Regex: Findet eine oder mehr Nullen am Anfang, gefolgt von einer Ziffer (1).
    FINAL(lv_regex) = '^0+(.)'.
    FINAL(lv_replacement) = '$1'.
    
    " Ersetze, bis keine Nullen mehr am Anfang stehen (z.B. '00123' -> '0123' -> '123')
    DO 10 TIMES. 
      FINAL(lv_temp) = lv_result.
      lv_result = replace_regex( val = lv_result regex = lv_regex with = lv_replacement occ = 1 ).
      IF lv_temp = lv_result. EXIT. ENDIF.
    ENDDO.
    
    " Behandle den Fall '0'
    IF lv_result IS INITIAL AND iv_input = '0'.
      rv_result = '0'.
    ELSE.
      rv_result = lv_result.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Check if a string contains at least **one lowercase letter** and at least **one uppercase letter** (Mixed Case Check).
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_mixed_case_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS contains_mixed_case
      IMPORTING iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_is_mixed) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_mixed_case_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD contains_mixed_case.
    " 1. Prüfe auf mindestens einen Großbuchstaben
    FINAL(lv_has_upper) = match( val = iv_input regex = '[A-Z]' ).
    " 2. Prüfe auf mindestens einen Kleinbuchstaben
    FINAL(lv_has_lower) = match( val = iv_input regex = '[a-z]' ).

    rv_is_mixed = xsdbool( lv_has_upper AND lv_has_lower ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Replace all consecutive occurrences of the **same character** (außer Leerzeichen) with only **two** of that character (e.g., 'AABBCDDD' -> 'AABBCDD').
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_consecutive_reducer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS reduce_consecutive
      IMPORTING iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_consecutive_reducer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD reduce_consecutive.
    " Regex: Findet ein Nicht-Whitespace-Zeichen (1) gefolgt von sich selbst 2 oder mehr Mal (\1{2,}).
    FINAL(lv_regex) = '([^\s])\1{2,}'.
    FINAL(lv_replacement) = '$1$1'. " Ersetzt durch die Gruppe 1, 2x wiederholt.

    DATA(lv_result) = iv_input.

    " Muss iterativ reduziert werden, da das Ersetzen die Indexe ändert
    DO 10 TIMES. 
      FINAL(lv_temp) = lv_result.
      lv_result = replace_regex( val = lv_result
                                   regex = lv_regex
                                   with = lv_replacement
                                   occ = 0 ).
      IF lv_temp = lv_result. EXIT. ENDIF.
    ENDDO.
    rv_result = lv_result.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Replace all **leading and trailing hyphens** ('-') from a string.

CLASS zcl_regex_hyphen_trimmer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Remove all characters from a string that are repeated **more than three times** consecutively (e.g., 'AAAAA' -> 'AAA').
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_repetition_limit DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_regex_repetition_limit IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lv_result) = iv_input.

    " Regex: Findet ein Zeichen (1) gefolgt von sich selbst 3 oder mehr Mal (\1{3,}).
    FINAL(lv_regex) = '(. )\1{3,}'.

                                   regex = lv_regex
                                   with = lv_replacement

ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Calculate the sum of all elements in an integer table (it_numbers) using the REDUCE expression.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS calculate_sum
      IMPORTING it_numbers TYPE tt_numbers
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sum.
    rv_sum = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0 FOR num IN it_numbers NEXT s = s + num ).

Instructions: Find the minimum non-zero value in an integer table (it_numbers) using REDUCE, ensuring the initial value handles the comparison correctly.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_min_nonzero DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS find_min_nonzero
      IMPORTING it_numbers TYPE tt_numbers
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_min) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_min_nonzero IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_min_nonzero.
    " Max value of I is 2,147,483,647. Use this as initial value.
    FINAL(lv_max_i) = 2147483647.

    rv_min = REDUCE i( INIT m = lv_max_i 
                      FOR num IN it_numbers WHERE ( num > 0 ) 
                      NEXT m = MIN( m, num ) 
                      FINAL = COND #( WHEN m = lv_max_i THEN 0 ELSE m ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implement a basic Fibonacci sequence generation up to a maximum number of steps (iv_max_steps) using REDUCE for state management.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_fibonacci DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS generate_fibonacci
      IMPORTING iv_max_steps TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_fib) TYPE tt_numbers.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_fibonacci IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_fibonacci.
    IF iv_max_steps <= 0. RETURN. ENDIF.
    
    " Initial Sequence: (0, 1)
    rt_fib = REDUCE tt_numbers( INIT t = VALUE tt_numbers( ( 0 ) ( 1 ) ) 
                             FOR step = 3 UP TO iv_max_steps 
                             NEXT t = VALUE #( BASE t ( t[ step - 2 ] + t[ step - 1 ] ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      IMPORTING it_data TYPE tt_currency_in
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_text) TYPE tt_text_out.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_string_template IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_to_text.
    rt_text = VALUE #( FOR <l> IN it_data ( text = |{ <l>-amount ALPHA = IN }| ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Collect all error messages (MESSAGE_TEXT) from an error table (it_errors) into a single string (rv_errors), separated by newlines, using REDUCE.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_error_agg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_error,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_error,
           tt_error TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_error WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS aggregate_errors
      IMPORTING it_errors TYPE tt_error
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_errors) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_error_agg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD aggregate_errors.
    FINAL(lv_cr_lf) = cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf.
    rv_errors = REDUCE string( INIT s = '' 
      FOR <e> IN it_errors 
      NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN <e>-text ELSE s && lv_cr_lf && <e>-text ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Iterate through a sorted table of sales (it_sales) and calculate the subtotal for each new CUSTOMER_ID, storing the results (rt_subtotals), using AT NEW/AT END OF.
solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_at_new_end DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sale,
             customer_id TYPE c LENGTH 10,
             amount TYPE p DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_sale,
           tt_sale TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sale WITH UNIQUE KEY customer_id,
           BEGIN OF ty_subtotal,
             customer_id TYPE c LENGTH 10,
             subtotal TYPE p DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_subtotal,
           tt_subtotal TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_subtotal WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS calculate_subtotals
      IMPORTING it_sales TYPE tt_sale
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_subtotals) TYPE tt_subtotal.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_at_new_end IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_subtotals.
    DATA lv_subtotal TYPE p DECIMALS 2.
    LOOP AT it_sales ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sale>).
      AT NEW customer_id.
        CLEAR lv_subtotal.
      ENDAT.

      lv_subtotal = lv_subtotal + <fs_sale>-amount.

      AT END OF customer_id.
        APPEND VALUE ty_subtotal( customer_id = <fs_sale>-customer_id subtotal = lv_subtotal ) TO rt_subtotals.
      ENDAT.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Combine two separate tables (it_a with ID/Name, it_b with ID/Value) into a new combined table (rt_combined) using FOR and LET/VALUE to perform a lookup in a single expression.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_let_lookup DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_a,
             id TYPE i,
             name TYPE string,
           END OF ty_a,
           tt_a TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_a WITH EMPTY KEY,
           BEGIN OF ty_b,
             id TYPE i,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_b,
           tt_b TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_b WITH UNIQUE KEY id,
           BEGIN OF ty_combined,
             id TYPE i,
             name TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_combined,
           tt_combined TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_combined WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS combine_tables
      IMPORTING it_a TYPE tt_a
                it_b TYPE tt_b
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_combined) TYPE tt_combined.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_let_lookup IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD combine_tables.
    FINAL(ls_default_b) = VALUE ty_b( value = 'N/A' ).
    
    rt_combined = VALUE #( FOR <a_line> IN it_a 
      LET v = VALUE #( it_b[ id = <a_line>-id ] DEFAULT ls_default_b )
      IN ( id = <a_line>-id name = <a_line>-name value = v-value ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Check if ALL entries in a table (it_data) have the VALID flag set ('X'), returning a boolean (rv_all_valid), using REDUCE.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_check_all DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flag_item,
             valid TYPE c LENGTH 1,
           END OF ty_flag_item,
           tt_flag_item TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flag_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

      IMPORTING it_data TYPE tt_flag_item

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_check_all IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_all_valid.
    rv_all_valid = REDUCE abap_bool( INIT v = abap_true 
                                   FOR <line> IN it_data 
                                   NEXT v = COND abap_bool( WHEN <line>-valid <> 'X' THEN abap_false ELSE v ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Read the index of the first entry in a table (it_data) where FLAG = 'Y' and store it (rv_index), using LOOP AT ... INTO and sy-tabix.
solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_into_index DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Group items by CATEGORY and count how many items are in each group, using FOR GROUPS and the GROUP SIZE aggregation function.

Instructions: Create an internal table containing the sequence of numbers from 1 to 10, using REDUCE and an iterative loop (FOR i = 1 WHILE i <= 10).
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sequence DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

  METHOD generate_sequence.
    rt_sequence = REDUCE tt_numbers( INIT t = VALUE tt_numbers( )

Instructions: Create a new table (rt_modified) by copying all entries from the source (it_source) and prefixing the TEXT field with 'MODIFIED: ' where the ID is even, using FOR and COND.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_cond_modify DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

             id TYPE i,

  METHOD conditionally_prefix_text.
    rt_modified = VALUE #( FOR <l> IN it_source (

Instructions: Calculate the sum of the square of all even numbers in a table (it_numbers), using REDUCE with a WHERE clause.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_square_even_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS sum_square_even
      IMPORTING it_numbers TYPE tt_numbers
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_square_even_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sum_square_even.
    rv_sum = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0 
                      FOR num IN it_numbers WHERE ( num MOD 2 = 0 ) 
                      NEXT s = s + ( num ** 2 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Create a temporary internal table (lt_temp) with all entries where the amount is greater than 500, and then assign the first entry of this temporary table to a field symbol (<fs_first>).

CLASS zcl_for_assign_first DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Berechne die Gesamtsumme aller Bestellwerte (amount) in der Tabelle (it_orders) mithilfe des REDUCE-Ausdrucks.

Instructions: Finde das früheste Buchungsdatum (booking_date) in der Flugtabelle (it_flights) mithilfe von REDUCE und der MIN-Funktion.

CLASS zcl_reduce_min_date DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Iteriere über eine nach `CUSTOMER` sortierte Tabelle (ct_sales) und setze das Feld `IS_FIRST` auf 'X' für den ersten Eintrag jedes Kunden, in-place, mithilfe von LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING und AT NEW.

Instructions: Berechne eine laufende Summe der Mengen (quantity) in der Tabelle (it_items) und speichere sie in einer neuen Spalte (`running_total`) in einer neuen Tabelle mithilfe von REDUCE.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_running_total DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item_in,
             id TYPE i,
             quantity TYPE i,
           END OF ty_item_in,
           tt_item_in TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item_in WITH EMPTY KEY,
           BEGIN OF ty_item_out,
             id TYPE i,
             quantity TYPE i,
             running_total TYPE i,
           END OF ty_item_out,
           tt_item_out TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item_out WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS calculate_running_total
      IMPORTING it_items TYPE tt_item_in
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_running) TYPE tt_item_out.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_running_total IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_running_total.
    rt_running = REDUCE tt_item_out( 
      INIT rt = VALUE tt_item_out( ) total = 0 
      FOR <l> IN it_items

CLASS zcl_for_let_value_lookup DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_average_positive DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS calculate_average_positive
      IMPORTING it_numbers TYPE tt_numbers
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_avg) TYPE decfloat16.

CLASS zcl_reduce_average_positive IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_average_positive.
    rv_avg = REDUCE decfloat16( INIT s = 0.0 idx = 0 
                              FOR num IN it_numbers WHERE ( num > 0 )

                              FINAL = COND #( WHEN idx > 0 THEN s / idx ELSE 0 ) ).

ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Iteriere über eine nach `YEAR` sortierte Tabelle (it_data) und sammle in einer Zieltabelle die Zeile mit dem höchsten `REVENUE` für jedes Jahr, mithilfe von LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING, AT NEW und AT END OF.
solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_at_new_max DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_annual_data,
             year TYPE c LENGTH 4,
             revenue TYPE p DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_annual_data,
           tt_annual_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_annual_data WITH NON-UNIQUE SORTED KEY primary_key COMPONENTS year,
           tt_annual_max TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_annual_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_annual_max
      IMPORTING it_data TYPE tt_annual_data
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_annual_max) TYPE tt_annual_max.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_at_new_max IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_annual_max.
    DATA ls_max_revenue TYPE ty_annual_data.
    LOOP AT it_data ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_data>).
      AT NEW year.
        CLEAR ls_max_revenue.
      ENDAT.

      IF <fs_data>-revenue > ls_max_revenue-revenue.
        ls_max_revenue = <fs_data>.
      ENDIF.

      AT END OF year.
        APPEND ls_max_revenue TO rt_annual_max.
      ENDAT.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_fibonacci_start DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_reduce_fibonacci_start IMPLEMENTATION.

solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_custom_logic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_record,
             id TYPE i,
             start_date TYPE sy-datum,
             end_date TYPE sy-datum,
           END OF ty_record,
           tt_record TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_record WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS find_longest_duration
      IMPORTING it_records TYPE tt_record
      RETURNING VALUE(rs_longest) TYPE ty_record.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_custom_logic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_longest_duration.
    DATA lv_max_diff TYPE i VALUE 0.
    rs_longest = REDUCE ty_record( INIT longest = VALUE ty_record( ) 
                                 FOR <r> IN it_records 
                                 LET diff = <r>-end_date - <r>-start_date 
                                 IN NEXT 
                                   longest = COND #( WHEN diff > lv_max_diff THEN <r> ELSE longest ) 
                                   lv_max_diff = MAX( lv_max_diff, diff ) 
                                   ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
