             id TYPE i,
             name TYPE string,
           END OF ty_employee,
           tt_employee TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_employee WITH UNIQUE KEY id.
    METHODS get_employee_name
      IMPORTING it_employees TYPE tt_employee
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_name) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_assign_table_expr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_employee_name.
    ASSIGN it_employees[ id = 123 ] TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_employee>).
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_name = <fs_employee>-name.
    ELSE.
      rv_name = 'NOT FOUND'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Wähle alle Zeilen aus (it_data), bei denen der `STATUS` **nicht** gleich 'ERROR' ist, mithilfe von FOR mit WHERE und NOT-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_filter_not DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_log_item,
             status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_log_item,
           tt_log_item TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_log_item WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS filter_no_errors
      IMPORTING it_data TYPE tt_log_item
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_no_errors) TYPE tt_log_item.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_filter_not IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_no_errors.
    rt_no_errors = VALUE #( FOR <l> IN it_data WHERE ( status <> 'ERROR' ) ( <l> ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Zähle mithilfe von REDUCE, wie oft der `VALUE` größer als 100 in der Tabelle (it_numbers) ist, unter Verwendung einer Inline-Bedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_counter_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS count_greater_than_100
      IMPORTING it_numbers TYPE tt_numbers
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_count_gt100) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_counter_cond IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_greater_than_100.
    rv_count_gt100 = REDUCE i( INIT c = 0 
                              FOR num IN it_numbers 
                              NEXT c = c + COND #( WHEN num > 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Prüfe schnell, ob überhaupt ein Eintrag in der Tabelle (it_data) mit `DATE = sy-datum` existiert, mithilfe von LOOP AT ... TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS mit WHERE und BREAK.
solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_no_fields_where DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             date TYPE sy-datum,
           END OF ty_data,
           tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS check_for_today
      IMPORTING it_data TYPE tt_data
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_found_today) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_no_fields_where IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_for_today.
    rv_found_today = abap_false.
    LOOP AT it_data TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS WHERE date = sy-datum.
      rv_found_today = abap_true.
      BREAK.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstelle eine Tabelle (rt_indexed_items), die nur die ersten 5 Einträge von (it_items) enthält und den Index hinzufügt, mithilfe einer iterativen FOR-Schleife mit Index-Zählung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_index_limit DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item_in,
             id TYPE i,
           END OF ty_item_in,
           tt_item_in TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item_in WITH EMPTY KEY,
           BEGIN OF ty_item_out,
             id TYPE i,
             index TYPE i,
           END OF ty_item_out,
           tt_item_out TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item_out WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_first_five_indexed
      IMPORTING it_items TYPE tt_item_in
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_indexed_items) TYPE tt_item_out.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_index_limit IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_first_five_indexed.
    rt_indexed_items = VALUE #( FOR idx = 1 THEN idx + 1 UNTIL idx > 5 
                                FOR <l> IN it_items INDEX idx 
                                ( id = <l>-id index = idx ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstelle eine neue Tabelle (rt_squared) mit den Quadraten der Zahlen aus (it_numbers) mithilfe von REDUCE und dem BASE-Parameter.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_initial_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_squared_numbers
      IMPORTING it_numbers TYPE tt_numbers
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_squared) TYPE tt_numbers.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_initial_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_squared_numbers.
    rt_squared = REDUCE tt_numbers( INIT t = VALUE tt_numbers( ) 
                                   FOR num IN it_numbers 
                                   NEXT t = VALUE #( BASE t ( num ** 2 ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Finde den Namen des Kunden (`CUSTOMER_NAME`) aus einer Kundentabelle (it_customers - HASHED TABLE) für jeden Eintrag in der Bestellpositionstabelle (it_order_items), mithilfe von FOR, LET und Tabellenausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_table_expression_lookup DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_customer,
             id TYPE i,
             name TYPE string,
           END OF ty_customer,
           tt_customers TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_customer WITH UNIQUE KEY id,
           BEGIN OF ty_order_item_in,
             id TYPE i,
             customer_id TYPE i,
           END OF ty_order_item_in,
           tt_order_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_order_item_in WITH EMPTY KEY,
           BEGIN OF ty_resolved_item,
             id TYPE i,
             customer_name TYPE string,
           END OF ty_resolved_item,
           tt_resolved_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_resolved_item WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS resolve_customer_names
      IMPORTING it_order_items TYPE tt_order_items
                it_customers TYPE tt_customers
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_resolved_items) TYPE tt_resolved_items.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_table_expression_lookup IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD resolve_customer_names.
    rt_resolved_items = VALUE #( FOR <item> IN it_order_items 
      LET name = VALUE string( it_customers[ id = <item>-customer_id ]-name DEFAULT 'Unknown' ) 
      IN ( id = <item>-id customer_name = name ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Selektiere alle Einträge aus (it_data), deren `TYPE` gleich 'A' **UND** deren `AMOUNT` größer als 100 ist, mithilfe von FOR mit WHERE und logischem UND.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_filter_and DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_record,
             type TYPE c LENGTH 1,
             amount TYPE i,
           END OF ty_record,
           tt_record TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_record WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS filter_complex
      IMPORTING it_data TYPE tt_record
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered) TYPE tt_record.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_filter_and IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_complex.
    rt_filtered = VALUE #( FOR <r> IN it_data WHERE ( type = 'A' AND amount > 100 ) ( <r> ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechne das Produkt aller Zahlen in der Tabelle (it_numbers), beginnend mit 1, mithilfe von REDUCE.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_product DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS calculate_product
      IMPORTING it_numbers TYPE tt_numbers
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_product) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_product IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_product.
    rv_product = REDUCE i( INIT p = 1 FOR num IN it_numbers NEXT p = p * num ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstelle eine neue Tabelle (rt_modified), die alle Einträge aus (it_source) kopiert und das Feld `DESCRIPTION` auf 'CLEANED' setzt, wenn es leer ist, mithilfe von FOR und COND.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_cond_default DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             id TYPE i,
             description TYPE string,
           END OF ty_item,
           tt_item TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS clean_description
      IMPORTING it_source TYPE tt_item
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_modified) TYPE tt_item.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_cond_default IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD clean_description.
    rt_modified = VALUE #( FOR <l> IN it_source ( 
      id = <l>-id
      description = COND string( WHEN <l>-description IS INITIAL THEN 'CLEANED' ELSE <l>-description ) 
    ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lese den letzten Eintrag aus der Tabelle (it_data) in eine Struktur (rs_last_entry) mithilfe von READ TABLE ... INDEX.
solution:
CLASS zcl_read_table_last DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

             value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data,

      IMPORTING it_data TYPE tt_data
      RETURNING VALUE(rs_last_entry) TYPE ty_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_read_table_last IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_last_entry.
    READ TABLE it_data INTO rs_last_entry INDEX lines( it_data ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Finde den Index des ersten Eintrags in der Tabelle (it_data) mit `FLAG = 'Y'` und speichere ihn (rv_index), mithilfe von LOOP AT ... INTO.
solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_into_index_find DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flag_item,
             flag TYPE c LENGTH 1,

           tt_flag_item TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flag_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

      IMPORTING it_data TYPE tt_flag_item
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_index) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_into_index_find IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_first_index.
    rv_index = 0.
    LOOP AT it_data INTO DATA(ls_data) WHERE flag = 'Y'.
      rv_index = sy-tabix.
      BREAK.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Kopiere alle Einträge von `it_source` in `rt_target` und entferne dabei Duplikate (basierend auf der gesamten Zeile) in der Zieltabelle (HASHED TABLE) mithilfe von FOR.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_copy_deduplicate DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id TYPE i,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data,
           tt_source TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY,
           tt_target TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_data WITH UNIQUE DEFAULT KEY.

      IMPORTING it_source TYPE tt_source
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_target) TYPE tt_target.

CLASS zcl_for_copy_deduplicate IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD copy_unique.
    rt_target = VALUE #( FOR <l> IN it_source ( <l> ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Setze den Status aller Datensätze in (ct_data) auf 'PROCESSED' für die ersten 10 Einträge, in-place, mithilfe von LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING und UP TO.
solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_assign_up_to DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data,
           tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS process_first_ten
      CHANGING ct_data TYPE tt_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_assign_up_to IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_first_ten.
    LOOP AT ct_data ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_data>) UP TO 10 ROWS.
      <fs_data>-status = 'PROCESSED'.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppiere Einträge (it_data) nach `KEY` und füge alle zugehörigen `VALUE`-Strings zu einem einzelnen String zusammen (durch Leerzeichen getrennt), mithilfe von FOR GROUPS und REDUCE/CONCAT_LINES_OF.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_groups_concat DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             key TYPE i,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data,
           tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY,
           BEGIN OF ty_group_result,
             key TYPE i,
             concatenated_values TYPE string,
           END OF ty_group_result,
           tt_group_result TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_group_result WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS group_and_concatenate
      IMPORTING it_data TYPE tt_data
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_grouped) TYPE tt_group_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_groups_concat IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_and_concatenate.
    rt_grouped = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS <g> OF <l> IN it_data GROUP BY <l>-key ( 
      key = <g>-key
      concatenated_values = REDUCE string( INIT s = '' 
                                         FOR <gl> IN GROUP <g> 
                                         NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN <gl>-value ELSE s && ' ' && <gl>-value ) ) 
    ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechne die Summe des Quadrats aller geraden Zahlen in einer Tabelle (it_numbers), mithilfe von REDUCE mit WHERE-Klausel und mathematischer Operation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_square_even_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS sum_square_even
      IMPORTING it_numbers TYPE tt_numbers
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_square_even_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sum_square_even.
    rv_sum = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0 
                      FOR num IN it_numbers WHERE ( num MOD 2 = 0 ) 
                      NEXT s = s + ( num ** 2 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Aktualisiere den `STATUS` aller Artikel in der Tabelle (ct_data) auf 'INACTIVE', wenn das `EXPIRY_DATE` in der Vergangenheit liegt, mithilfe von LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL mit WHERE und `sy-datum`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_assign_expiry DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item_expiry,
             expiry_date TYPE sy-datum,
             status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_item_expiry,
           tt_item_expiry TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item_expiry WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS update_expired_status
      CHANGING ct_data TYPE tt_item_expiry.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_assign_expiry IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_expired_status.
    LOOP AT ct_data ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_data>) WHERE expiry_date < sy-datum.
      <fs_data>-status = 'INACTIVE'.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstelle eine Tabelle (rt_names) mit den Namen aller Mitarbeiter, deren Gehalt (salary) über 50000 liegt, aus der Eingabetabelle (it_employees), mithilfe von FOR mit WHERE.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_filter_salary DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_employee,
             id TYPE i,
             name TYPE string,
             salary TYPE p DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_employee,
           tt_employee TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_employee WITH EMPTY KEY,
           tt_names TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_high_earner_names
      IMPORTING it_employees TYPE tt_employee
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_names) TYPE tt_names.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_filter_salary IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_high_earner_names.
    rt_names = VALUE #( FOR <e> IN it_employees WHERE ( salary > 50000 ) ( <e>-name ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechne die Gesamtsumme aller Bestellwerte (amount) in der Tabelle (it_orders) mithilfe des REDUCE-Ausdrucks (Inline-Deklaration und p-Typ).
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_total_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_order,
             order_id TYPE i,
             amount TYPE p DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_order,
           tt_order TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_order WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS calculate_total
      IMPORTING it_orders TYPE tt_order
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_total) TYPE p DECIMALS 2.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_total_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total.
    rv_total = REDUCE p( INIT s = 0 FOR <o> IN it_orders NEXT s = s + <o>-amount ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erhöhe das Mengenfeld (quantity) aller Artikel in der Tabelle (ct_items) um 10% (Ganzzahl-Rundung) **in-place** mithilfe von LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL.
solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_assign_modify_percent DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             id TYPE i,
             quantity TYPE i,
           END OF ty_item,
           tt_item TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS increase_quantity
      CHANGING ct_items TYPE tt_item.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_assign_modify_percent IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD increase_quantity.
    LOOP AT ct_items ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_item>).
      <fs_item>-quantity = <fs_item>-quantity * '1.10'.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Flache eine Tabelle von Tabellen (it_nested_data), die `id` und eine interne Tabelle `sub_items` enthält, in eine flache Liste der Sub-Items ab, mithilfe eines **verschachtelten FOR-Ausdrucks**.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_nested_flatten DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             group_id TYPE i,
             sub_items TYPE tt_numbers,

Instructions: Finde das früheste Buchungsdatum (booking_date) in der Flugtabelle (it_flights) mithilfe von REDUCE und der MIN-Funktion.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_min_date DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             booking_date TYPE sy-datum,
           END OF ty_flight,
           tt_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS find_earliest_date
      IMPORTING it_flights TYPE tt_flight
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_min_date) TYPE sy-datum.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_min_date IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_earliest_date.
    rv_min_date = REDUCE sy-datum( INIT min_d = sy-datum FOR <f> IN it_flights NEXT min_d = MIN( min_d, <f>-booking_date ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lösche alle leeren Zeilen (initiale Werte) aus der veränderbaren Tabelle (ct_data) **in-place** mithilfe von LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL und DELETE.
solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_assign_delete_initial DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Gruppiere Produkte (it_products) nach `CATEGORY` und berechne die durchschnittliche `PRICE` jeder Kategorie in der Zieltabelle (rt_avg_price) mithilfe von FOR GROUPS und der Aggregatfunktion AVG.

Instructions: Erstelle eine durch Semikolon getrennte Liste aller IDs aus der Tabelle (it_ids), wobei 'ID: ' vorangestellt wird, mithilfe von REDUCE und COND für die Initialisierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_concat_id DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_ids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS create_id_list
      IMPORTING it_ids TYPE tt_ids
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_list) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_concat_id IMPLEMENTATION.

    rv_list = REDUCE string(

Instructions: Erstelle eine neue Tabelle (rt_transformed) aus (it_source), wobei das Feld `TYPE` auf 'X' gesetzt wird, wenn das Feld `STATUS` gleich 'OK' ist, ansonsten auf ' ' (Leerzeichen), mithilfe von FOR und COND.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_cond_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source,
             id TYPE i,
             status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_source,
           tt_source TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source WITH EMPTY KEY,
           BEGIN OF ty_target,
             id TYPE i,

CLASS zcl_for_cond_transform IMPLEMENTATION.

    ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Iteriere über eine nach `CUSTOMER` sortierte Tabelle (ct_sales) und setze das Feld `IS_FIRST` auf 'X' für den ersten Eintrag jedes Kunden, **in-place**, mithilfe von LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING und AT NEW.
solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_assign_at_new DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             customer TYPE c LENGTH 10,
             item TYPE i,
             is_first TYPE c LENGTH 1,
           END OF ty_sale,

CLASS zcl_loop_assign_at_new IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Berechne eine laufende Summe der Mengen (quantity) in der Tabelle (it_items) und speichere sie in einer neuen Spalte (`running_total`) in einer neuen Tabelle mithilfe von REDUCE.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_running_total DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item_in,
             id TYPE i,
             quantity TYPE i,
           END OF ty_item_in,
           tt_item_in TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item_in WITH EMPTY KEY,
           BEGIN OF ty_item_out,
             id TYPE i,
             quantity TYPE i,
             running_total TYPE i,
           END OF ty_item_out,
           tt_item_out TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item_out WITH EMPTY KEY.

      IMPORTING it_items TYPE tt_item_in
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_running) TYPE tt_item_out.

CLASS zcl_reduce_running_total IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_running_total.
    rt_running = REDUCE tt_item_out( 
      INIT rt = VALUE tt_item_out( ) total = 0 
      FOR <l> IN it_items 
      NEXT total = total + <l>-quantity 
           rt = VALUE #( BASE rt ( id = <l>-id quantity = <l>-quantity running_total = total ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_let_value_lookup DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_loop_assign_tabix_modify DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_reduce_average_positive DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_reduce_average_positive IMPLEMENTATION.

    rv_avg = REDUCE decfloat16( INIT s = 0.0 idx = 0

Instructions: Iteriere über eine nach `YEAR` sortierte Tabelle (it_data) und sammle in einer Zieltabelle die Zeile mit dem höchsten `REVENUE` für jedes Jahr, mithilfe von LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING, AT NEW und AT END OF (Manueller Gruppenwechsel).
solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_at_new_max DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_annual_data,
             year TYPE c LENGTH 4,
             revenue TYPE p DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_annual_data,
           tt_annual_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_annual_data WITH NON-UNIQUE SORTED KEY primary_key COMPONENTS year,
           tt_annual_max TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_annual_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_annual_max
      IMPORTING it_data TYPE tt_annual_data
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_annual_max) TYPE tt_annual_max.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_at_new_max IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_annual_max.
    DATA ls_max_revenue TYPE ty_annual_data.
    LOOP AT it_data ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_data>).
      AT NEW year.
        CLEAR ls_max_revenue.
      ENDAT.

      IF <fs_data>-revenue > ls_max_revenue-revenue.
        ls_max_revenue = <fs_data>.
      ENDIF.

      AT END OF year.
        APPEND ls_max_revenue TO rt_annual_max.
      ENDAT.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_fibonacci_start DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS generate_fibonacci
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_fib) TYPE tt_numbers.

CLASS zcl_reduce_fibonacci_start IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_fibonacci.
    rt_fib = REDUCE tt_numbers( 
      INIT t = VALUE tt_numbers( ( 1 ) ( 1 ) ) 
      FOR step = 3 UP TO 10 
      NEXT t = VALUE #( BASE t ( t[ step - 2 ] + t[ step - 1 ] ) ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_custom_logic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_record,
             id TYPE i,
             start_date TYPE sy-datum,
             end_date TYPE sy-datum,
           END OF ty_record,
           tt_record TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_record WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS find_longest_duration
      IMPORTING it_records TYPE tt_record
      RETURNING VALUE(rs_longest) TYPE ty_record.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_custom_logic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_longest_duration.
    DATA lv_max_diff TYPE i VALUE 0.
    rs_longest = REDUCE ty_record( INIT longest = VALUE ty_record( ) 
                                 FOR <r> IN it_records 
                                 LET diff = <r>-end_date - <r>-start_date 
                                 IN NEXT 
                                   longest = COND #( WHEN diff > lv_max_diff THEN <r> ELSE longest ) 
                                   lv_max_diff = MAX( lv_max_diff, diff ) 
                                   ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      RETURNING VALUE(rv_indexed_list) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_join_with_index IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD join_indexed.
    rv_indexed_list = REDUCE string( 
      INIT s = '' idx = 0 
      FOR str IN it_strings 
      NEXT idx = idx + 1 
           s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN |{ idx }: { str }| ELSE s && ', ' && |{ idx }: { str }| ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lese den `NAME` des Mitarbeiters mit `ID = 123` aus der Tabelle (it_employees) mithilfe des **Tabellenausdrucks** und Zuweisung an ein Field-Symbol.
solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_assign_table_expr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_employee,
             id TYPE i,
             name TYPE string,
           END OF ty_employee,
           tt_employee TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_employee WITH UNIQUE KEY id.
    METHODS get_employee_name
      IMPORTING it_employees TYPE tt_employee
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_name) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_assign_table_expr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_employee_name.
    ASSIGN it_employees[ id = 123 ] TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_employee>).
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_name = <fs_employee>-name.
    ELSE.
      rv_name = 'NOT FOUND'.

Instructions: Wähle alle Zeilen aus (it_data), bei denen der `STATUS` **nicht** gleich 'ERROR' ist, mithilfe von FOR mit WHERE und NOT-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_filter_not DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_log_item,
             status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_log_item,
           tt_log_item TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_log_item WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS filter_no_errors
      IMPORTING it_data TYPE tt_log_item
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_no_errors) TYPE tt_log_item.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_filter_not IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_no_errors.
    rt_no_errors = VALUE #( FOR <l> IN it_data WHERE ( status <> 'ERROR' ) ( <l> ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Zähle mithilfe von REDUCE, wie oft der `VALUE` größer als 100 in der Tabelle (it_numbers) ist, unter Verwendung einer Inline-Bedingung zum Zählen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_counter_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS count_greater_than_100
      IMPORTING it_numbers TYPE tt_numbers
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_count_gt100) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_counter_cond IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_greater_than_100.
    rv_count_gt100 = REDUCE i( INIT c = 0 
                              FOR num IN it_numbers 
                              NEXT c = c + COND #( WHEN num > 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Prüfe schnell, ob überhaupt ein Eintrag in der Tabelle (it_data) mit `DATE = sy-datum` existiert, mithilfe von LOOP AT ... TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS mit WHERE und BREAK (Früher Abbruch).
solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_no_fields_where DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             date TYPE sy-datum,
           END OF ty_data,
           tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS check_for_today
      IMPORTING it_data TYPE tt_data
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_found_today) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_no_fields_where IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_for_today.
    rv_found_today = abap_false.
    LOOP AT it_data TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS WHERE date = sy-datum.
      rv_found_today = abap_true.
      BREAK.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstelle eine Tabelle (rt_indexed_items), die nur die **ersten 5** Einträge von (it_items) enthält und den Index hinzufügt, mithilfe einer iterativen FOR-Schleife mit Index-Zählung und UNTIL-Bedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_index_limit DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item_in,
             id TYPE i,
           END OF ty_item_in,
           tt_item_in TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item_in WITH EMPTY KEY,
           BEGIN OF ty_item_out,
             id TYPE i,
             index TYPE i,
           END OF ty_item_out,
           tt_item_out TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item_out WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_first_five_indexed
      IMPORTING it_items TYPE tt_item_in
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_indexed_items) TYPE tt_item_out.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_index_limit IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_first_five_indexed.
    rt_indexed_items = VALUE #( FOR idx = 1 THEN idx + 1 UNTIL idx > 5 
                                FOR <l> IN it_items INDEX idx 
                                ( id = <l>-id index = idx ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstelle eine neue Tabelle (rt_squared) mit den **Quadraten** der Zahlen aus (it_numbers) mithilfe von REDUCE und dem BASE-Parameter zum Einfügen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_initial_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_squared_numbers
      IMPORTING it_numbers TYPE tt_numbers
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_squared) TYPE tt_numbers.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_initial_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_squared_numbers.
    rt_squared = REDUCE tt_numbers( INIT t = VALUE tt_numbers( ) 
                                   FOR num IN it_numbers 
                                   NEXT t = VALUE #( BASE t ( num ** 2 ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Finde den Namen des Kunden (`CUSTOMER_NAME`) aus einer Kundentabelle (it_customers - HASHED TABLE) für jeden Eintrag in der Bestellpositionstabelle (it_order_items), indem der **Tabellenausdruck** in FOR mit LET verwendet wird.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_table_expression_lookup DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_customer,
             id TYPE i,
             name TYPE string,
           END OF ty_customer,
           tt_customers TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_customer WITH UNIQUE KEY id,
           BEGIN OF ty_order_item_in,
             id TYPE i,
             customer_id TYPE i,
           END OF ty_order_item_in,
           tt_order_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_order_item_in WITH EMPTY KEY,
           BEGIN OF ty_resolved_item,
             id TYPE i,
             customer_name TYPE string,
           END OF ty_resolved_item,
           tt_resolved_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_resolved_item WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS resolve_customer_names
      IMPORTING it_order_items TYPE tt_order_items
                it_customers TYPE tt_customers
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_resolved_items) TYPE tt_resolved_items.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_table_expression_lookup IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD resolve_customer_names.
    rt_resolved_items = VALUE #( FOR <item> IN it_order_items 
      LET name = VALUE string( it_customers[ id = <item>-customer_id ]-name DEFAULT 'Unknown' ) 
      IN ( id = <item>-id customer_name = name ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Selektiere alle Einträge aus (it_data), deren `TYPE` gleich 'A' **UND** deren `AMOUNT` größer als 100 ist, mithilfe von FOR mit WHERE und logischem UND.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_filter_and DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_record,
             type TYPE c LENGTH 1,
             amount TYPE i,
           END OF ty_record,
           tt_record TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_record WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS filter_complex
      IMPORTING it_data TYPE tt_record
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered) TYPE tt_record.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_filter_and IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_complex.
    rt_filtered = VALUE #( FOR <r> IN it_data WHERE ( type = 'A' AND amount > 100 ) ( <r> ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechne das **Produkt** aller Zahlen in der Tabelle (it_numbers), beginnend mit 1, mithilfe von REDUCE.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_product DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS calculate_product
      IMPORTING it_numbers TYPE tt_numbers
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_product) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_product IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_product.
    rv_product = REDUCE i( INIT p = 1 FOR num IN it_numbers NEXT p = p * num ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstelle eine neue Tabelle (rt_modified), die alle Einträge aus (it_source) kopiert und das Feld `DESCRIPTION` auf 'CLEANED' setzt, wenn es initial (leer) ist, mithilfe von FOR und COND.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_cond_default DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             id TYPE i,
             description TYPE string,
           END OF ty_item,
           tt_item TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS clean_description
      IMPORTING it_source TYPE tt_item
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_modified) TYPE tt_item.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_cond_default IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD clean_description.
    rt_modified = VALUE #( FOR <l> IN it_source ( 
      id = <l>-id
      description = COND string( WHEN <l>-description IS INITIAL THEN 'CLEANED' ELSE <l>-description ) 
    ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lese den **letzten** Eintrag aus der Tabelle (it_data) in eine Struktur (rs_last_entry) mithilfe von READ TABLE ... INDEX unter Verwendung von LINES() zur Indexbestimmung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_read_table_last DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data,

    METHODS get_last_entry
      IMPORTING it_data TYPE tt_data
      RETURNING VALUE(rs_last_entry) TYPE ty_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_read_table_last IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_last_entry.
    READ TABLE it_data INTO rs_last_entry INDEX lines( it_data ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Finde den Index des ersten Eintrags in der Tabelle (it_data) mit `FLAG = 'Y'` und speichere ihn (rv_index), mithilfe von LOOP AT ... INTO mit WHERE und **BREAK**.
solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_into_index_find DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      IMPORTING it_data TYPE tt_flag_item
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_index) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_into_index_find IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_first_index.
    rv_index = 0.
    LOOP AT it_data INTO DATA(ls_data) WHERE flag = 'Y'.
      rv_index = sy-tabix.
      BREAK.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Kopiere alle Einträge von `it_source` in `rt_target` und entferne dabei **Duplikate** (basierend auf der gesamten Zeile), indem `rt_target` als HASHED TABLE mit UNIQUE DEFAULT KEY deklariert und FOR verwendet wird.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_copy_deduplicate DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id TYPE i,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data,
           tt_source TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY,
           tt_target TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_data WITH UNIQUE DEFAULT KEY.
    METHODS copy_unique
      IMPORTING it_source TYPE tt_source
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_target) TYPE tt_target.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_copy_deduplicate IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD copy_unique.
    rt_target = VALUE #( FOR <l> IN it_source ( <l> ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Setze den Status aller Datensätze in (ct_data) auf 'PROCESSED' für die **ersten 10** Einträge, **in-place**, mithilfe von LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING und UP TO.
solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_assign_up_to DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data,
           tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS process_first_ten
      CHANGING ct_data TYPE tt_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_assign_up_to IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_first_ten.
    LOOP AT ct_data ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_data>) UP TO 10 ROWS.
      <fs_data>-status = 'PROCESSED'.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppiere Einträge (it_data) nach `KEY` und füge alle zugehörigen `VALUE`-Strings zu einem einzelnen String zusammen (durch Leerzeichen getrennt), mithilfe von FOR GROUPS und REDUCE (String-Aggregation).
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_groups_concat DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             key TYPE i,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data,
           tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY,
           BEGIN OF ty_group_result,
             key TYPE i,
             concatenated_values TYPE string,
           END OF ty_group_result,
           tt_group_result TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_group_result WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS group_and_concatenate
      IMPORTING it_data TYPE tt_data
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_grouped) TYPE tt_group_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_groups_concat IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_and_concatenate.
    rt_grouped = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS <g> OF <l> IN it_data GROUP BY <l>-key ( 
      key = <g>-key
      concatenated_values = REDUCE string( INIT s = '' 
                                         FOR <gl> IN GROUP <g> 
                                         NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN <gl>-value ELSE s && ' ' && <gl>-value ) ) 
    ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechne die Summe des **Quadrats** aller **geraden** Zahlen in einer Tabelle (it_numbers), mithilfe von REDUCE mit WHERE-Klausel und mathematischer Operation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_square_even_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS sum_square_even
      IMPORTING it_numbers TYPE tt_numbers
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_square_even_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sum_square_even.
    rv_sum = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0 
                      FOR num IN it_numbers WHERE ( num MOD 2 = 0 ) 
                      NEXT s = s + ( num ** 2 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Aktualisiere den `STATUS` aller Artikel in der Tabelle (ct_data) auf 'INACTIVE', wenn das `EXPIRY_DATE` in der Vergangenheit liegt (kleiner als `sy-datum`), **in-place**, mithilfe von LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL mit WHERE.
solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_assign_expiry DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item_expiry,
             expiry_date TYPE sy-datum,
             status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_item_expiry,
           tt_item_expiry TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item_expiry WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS update_expired_status
      CHANGING ct_data TYPE tt_item_expiry.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_assign_expiry IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_expired_status.
    LOOP AT ct_data ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_data>) WHERE expiry_date < sy-datum.
      <fs_data>-status = 'INACTIVE'.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstelle eine Tabelle (rt_names) mit den Namen aller Mitarbeiter, deren Gehalt (salary) über 50000 liegt, aus der Eingabetabelle (it_employees), mithilfe von FOR mit WHERE.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_filter_salary DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_employee,
             id TYPE i,
             name TYPE string,
             salary TYPE p DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_employee,
           tt_employee TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_employee WITH EMPTY KEY,
           tt_names TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_high_earner_names
      IMPORTING it_employees TYPE tt_employee
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_names) TYPE tt_names.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_filter_salary IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_high_earner_names.
    rt_names = VALUE #( FOR <e> IN it_employees WHERE ( salary > 50000 ) ( <e>-name ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechne die Gesamtsumme aller Bestellwerte (amount) in der Tabelle (it_orders) mithilfe des REDUCE-Ausdrucks (Inline-Deklaration und p-Typ).
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_total_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_order,
             order_id TYPE i,
             amount TYPE p DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_order,
           tt_order TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_order WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS calculate_total
      IMPORTING it_orders TYPE tt_order
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_total) TYPE p DECIMALS 2.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_total_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total.
    rv_total = REDUCE p( INIT s = 0 FOR <o> IN it_orders NEXT s = s + <o>-amount ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erhöhe das Mengenfeld (quantity) aller Artikel in der Tabelle (ct_items) um 10% (Ganzzahl-Rundung) **in-place** mithilfe von LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL.
solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_assign_modify_percent DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             id TYPE i,
             quantity TYPE i,
           END OF ty_item,
           tt_item TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS increase_quantity
      CHANGING ct_items TYPE tt_item.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_assign_modify_percent IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD increase_quantity.
    LOOP AT ct_items ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_item>).
      <fs_item>-quantity = <fs_item>-quantity * '1.10'.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Flache eine Tabelle von Tabellen (it_nested_data), die `id` und eine interne Tabelle `sub_items` enthält, in eine flache Liste der Sub-Items ab, mithilfe eines **verschachtelten FOR-Ausdrucks**.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_nested_flatten DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_nested,
             group_id TYPE i,
             sub_items TYPE tt_numbers,
           END OF ty_nested,
           tt_nested TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_nested WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS flatten_list
      IMPORTING it_nested_data TYPE tt_nested
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flat) TYPE tt_numbers.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_nested_flatten IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD flatten_list.
    rt_flat = VALUE #( FOR outer IN it_nested_data FOR inner IN outer-sub_items ( inner ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Finde das früheste Buchungsdatum (booking_date) in der Flugtabelle (it_flights) mithilfe von REDUCE und der MIN-Funktion.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_min_date DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             booking_date TYPE sy-datum,
           END OF ty_flight,
           tt_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS find_earliest_date
      IMPORTING it_flights TYPE tt_flight
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_min_date) TYPE sy-datum.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_min_date IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_earliest_date.
    rv_min_date = REDUCE sy-datum( INIT min_d = sy-datum FOR <f> IN it_flights NEXT min_d = MIN( min_d, <f>-booking_date ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lösche alle leeren Zeilen (initiale Werte) aus der veränderbaren Tabelle (ct_data) **in-place** mithilfe von LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL und DELETE.
solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_assign_delete_initial DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

             key TYPE i,

           tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_loop_assign_delete_initial IMPLEMENTATION.

      ENDIF.

Instructions: Gruppiere Produkte (it_products) nach `CATEGORY` und berechne die durchschnittliche `PRICE` jeder Kategorie in der Zieltabelle (rt_avg_price) mithilfe von FOR GROUPS und der Aggregatfunktion AVG.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_groups_avg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC. PUBLIC SECTION. TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_product, category TYPE string, price TYPE p DECIMALS 2, END OF ty_product, tt_product TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_product WITH EMPTY KEY, BEGIN OF ty_avg_price, category TYPE string, avg_price TYPE p DECIMALS 2, END OF ty_avg_price, tt_avg_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_avg_price WITH EMPTY KEY. Instructions: Erstelle eine durch Semikolon getrennte Liste aller IDs aus der Tabelle (it_ids), wobei 'ID: ' vorangestellt wird, mithilfe von REDUCE und COND für die Initialisierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_concat_id DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_ids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS create_id_list
      IMPORTING it_ids TYPE tt_ids
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_list) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_concat_id IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_id_list.
    rv_list = REDUCE string(

Instructions: Erstelle eine neue Tabelle (rt_transformed) aus (it_source), wobei das Feld `TYPE` auf 'X' gesetzt wird, wenn das Feld `STATUS` gleich 'OK' ist, ansonsten auf ' ' (Leerzeichen), mithilfe von FOR und COND.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_cond_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source,
             id TYPE i,
             status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_source,
           tt_source TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source WITH EMPTY KEY,
           BEGIN OF ty_target,
             id TYPE i,
             type TYPE c LENGTH 1,
           END OF ty_target,

    METHODS transform_status
      IMPORTING it_source TYPE tt_source
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_transformed) TYPE tt_target.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_cond_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_status.
    rt_transformed = VALUE #( FOR <i> IN it_source ( 
      id = <i>-id 
      type = COND c( WHEN <i>-status = 'OK' THEN 'X' ELSE ' ' ) 
    ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Iteriere über eine nach `CUSTOMER` sortierte Tabelle (ct_sales) und setze das Feld `IS_FIRST` auf 'X' für den ersten Eintrag jedes Kunden, **in-place**, mithilfe von LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING und AT NEW.
solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_assign_at_new DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sale,
             customer TYPE c LENGTH 10,
             item TYPE i,

Instructions: Berechne eine laufende Summe der Mengen (quantity) in der Tabelle (it_items) und speichere sie in einer neuen Spalte (`running_total`) in einer neuen Tabelle mithilfe von REDUCE.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_running_total DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item_in,
             id TYPE i,
             quantity TYPE i,
           END OF ty_item_in,
           tt_item_in TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item_in WITH EMPTY KEY,
           BEGIN OF ty_item_out,
             id TYPE i,
             quantity TYPE i,
             running_total TYPE i,
           END OF ty_item_out,
           tt_item_out TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item_out WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS calculate_running_total
      IMPORTING it_items TYPE tt_item_in
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_running) TYPE tt_item_out.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_running_total IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_running_total.
    rt_running = REDUCE tt_item_out( 
      INIT rt = VALUE tt_item_out( ) total = 0 
      FOR <l> IN it_items 
      NEXT total = total + <l>-quantity 
           rt = VALUE #( BASE rt ( id = <l>-id quantity = <l>-quantity running_total = total ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_for_let_value_lookup DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

             item TYPE string,
             price TYPE p DECIMALS 2,

CLASS zcl_for_let_value_lookup IMPLEMENTATION.

      IN ( item = <l>-item price = p-price ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_loop_assign_tabix_modify DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Berechne den Durchschnitt der positiven Zahlen in der Tabelle (it_numbers) mithilfe von REDUCE, das Zähler und Summe verwaltet und das Ergebnis im FINAL-Abschnitt berechnet.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_average_positive DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS calculate_average_positive
      IMPORTING it_numbers TYPE tt_numbers
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_avg) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_average_positive IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_average_positive.
    rv_avg = REDUCE decfloat16( INIT s = 0.0 idx = 0 
                              FOR num IN it_numbers WHERE ( num > 0 ) 
                              NEXT s = s + num idx = idx + 1 
                              FINAL = COND #( WHEN idx > 0 THEN s / idx ELSE 0 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Iteriere über eine nach `YEAR` sortierte Tabelle (it_data) und sammle in einer Zieltabelle die Zeile mit dem höchsten `REVENUE` für jedes Jahr, mithilfe von LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING, AT NEW und AT END OF (Manueller Gruppenwechsel).
solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_at_new_max DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_annual_data,
             year TYPE c LENGTH 4,
             revenue TYPE p DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_annual_data,
           tt_annual_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_annual_data WITH NON-UNIQUE SORTED KEY primary_key COMPONENTS year,
           tt_annual_max TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_annual_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_annual_max
      IMPORTING it_data TYPE tt_annual_data
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_annual_max) TYPE tt_annual_max.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_at_new_max IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_annual_max.
    DATA ls_max_revenue TYPE ty_annual_data.
    LOOP AT it_data ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_data>).
      AT NEW year.
        CLEAR ls_max_revenue.
      ENDAT.

      IF <fs_data>-revenue > ls_max_revenue-revenue.
        ls_max_revenue = <fs_data>.
      ENDIF.

      AT END OF year.
        APPEND ls_max_revenue TO rt_annual_max.
      ENDAT.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Generiere die ersten 10 Elemente der Fibonacci-Folge (1, 1, 2, 3, 5, ...), beginnend mit 1 und 1, mithilfe von REDUCE zur Zustandsverwaltung (State Management) und dem **indexierten Zugriff**.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_fibonacci_start DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS generate_fibonacci
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_fib) TYPE tt_numbers.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_fibonacci_start IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_fibonacci.
    rt_fib = REDUCE tt_numbers( 
      INIT t = VALUE tt_numbers( ( 1 ) ( 1 ) ) 
      FOR step = 3 UP TO 10 
      NEXT t = VALUE #( BASE t ( t[ step - 2 ] + t[ step - 1 ] ) ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Finde den Eintrag in der Tabelle (it_records) mit der höchsten Differenz (in Tagen) zwischen `END_DATE` und `START_DATE` mithilfe von REDUCE und dem LET-Ausdruck für die lokale Berechnung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_custom_logic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_record,
             id TYPE i,
             start_date TYPE sy-datum,
             end_date TYPE sy-datum,
           END OF ty_record,
           tt_record TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_record WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS find_longest_duration
      IMPORTING it_records TYPE tt_record
      RETURNING VALUE(rs_longest) TYPE ty_record.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_custom_logic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_longest_duration.
    DATA lv_max_diff TYPE i VALUE 0.
    rs_longest = REDUCE ty_record( INIT longest = VALUE ty_record( ) 
                                 FOR <r> IN it_records 
                                 LET diff = <r>-end_date - <r>-start_date 
                                 IN NEXT 
                                   longest = COND #( WHEN diff > lv_max_diff THEN <r> ELSE longest ) 
                                   lv_max_diff = MAX( lv_max_diff, diff ) 
                                   ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

           BEGIN OF ty_data_out,
             id TYPE i,
             value TYPE i,
             double_value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data_out,
           tt_data_out TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data_out WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS calculate_double
      IMPORTING it_data TYPE tt_data_in
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_calc) TYPE tt_data_out.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_multi_map IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_double.
    rt_calc = VALUE #( FOR <d> IN it_data ( 
      id = <d>-id
      value = <d>-value
      double_value = <d>-value * 2
    ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Füge alle Strings (it_strings) mit dem **Index als Präfix** zusammen (z.B. '1: A, 2: B, ...') mithilfe von REDUCE und einem zusätzlichen Zähler-Initialisierungsparameter.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_join_with_index DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_strings TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS join_indexed
      IMPORTING it_strings TYPE tt_strings
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_indexed_list) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_join_with_index IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD join_indexed.
    rv_indexed_list = REDUCE string( 
      INIT s = '' idx = 0 
      FOR str IN it_strings 
      NEXT idx = idx + 1 
           s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN |{ idx }: { str }| ELSE s && ', ' && |{ idx }: { str }| ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lese den `NAME` des Mitarbeiters mit `ID = 123` aus der Tabelle (it_employees) mithilfe des **Tabellenausdrucks** und Zuweisung an ein Field-Symbol.
solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_assign_table_expr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_employee,
             id TYPE i,
             name TYPE string,
           END OF ty_employee,
           tt_employee TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_employee WITH UNIQUE KEY id.
    METHODS get_employee_name
      IMPORTING it_employees TYPE tt_employee
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_name) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_assign_table_expr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_employee_name.
    ASSIGN it_employees[ id = 123 ] TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_employee>).
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_name = <fs_employee>-name.
    ELSE.
      rv_name = 'NOT FOUND'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Wähle alle Zeilen aus (it_data), bei denen der `STATUS` **nicht** gleich 'ERROR' ist, mithilfe von FOR mit WHERE und NOT-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_filter_not DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_log_item,
             status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_log_item,
           tt_log_item TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_log_item WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS filter_no_errors
      IMPORTING it_data TYPE tt_log_item
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_no_errors) TYPE tt_log_item.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_filter_not IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_no_errors.
    rt_no_errors = VALUE #( FOR <l> IN it_data WHERE ( status <> 'ERROR' ) ( <l> ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Zähle mithilfe von REDUCE, wie oft der `VALUE` größer als 100 in der Tabelle (it_numbers) ist, unter Verwendung einer Inline-Bedingung zum Zählen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_counter_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS count_greater_than_100
      IMPORTING it_numbers TYPE tt_numbers
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_count_gt100) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_counter_cond IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_greater_than_100.
    rv_count_gt100 = REDUCE i( INIT c = 0 
                              FOR num IN it_numbers 
                              NEXT c = c + COND #( WHEN num > 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Prüfe schnell, ob überhaupt ein Eintrag in der Tabelle (it_data) mit `DATE = sy-datum` existiert, mithilfe von LOOP AT ... TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS mit WHERE und BREAK (Früher Abbruch).
solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_no_fields_where DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             date TYPE sy-datum,
           END OF ty_data,
           tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS check_for_today
      IMPORTING it_data TYPE tt_data
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_found_today) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_no_fields_where IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_for_today.
    rv_found_today = abap_false.
    LOOP AT it_data TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS WHERE date = sy-datum.
      rv_found_today = abap_true.
      BREAK.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstelle eine Tabelle (rt_indexed_items), die nur die **ersten 5** Einträge von (it_items) enthält und den Index hinzufügt, mithilfe einer iterativen FOR-Schleife mit Index-Zählung und UNTIL-Bedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_index_limit DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item_in,
             id TYPE i,
           END OF ty_item_in,
           tt_item_in TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item_in WITH EMPTY KEY,
           BEGIN OF ty_item_out,
             id TYPE i,
             index TYPE i,
           END OF ty_item_out,
           tt_item_out TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item_out WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_first_five_indexed
      IMPORTING it_items TYPE tt_item_in
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_indexed_items) TYPE tt_item_out.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_index_limit IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_first_five_indexed.
    rt_indexed_items = VALUE #( FOR idx = 1 THEN idx + 1 UNTIL idx > 5 
                                FOR <l> IN it_items INDEX idx 
                                ( id = <l>-id index = idx ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstelle eine neue Tabelle (rt_squared) mit den **Quadraten** der Zahlen aus (it_numbers) mithilfe von REDUCE und dem BASE-Parameter zum Einfügen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_initial_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_squared_numbers
      IMPORTING it_numbers TYPE tt_numbers
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_squared) TYPE tt_numbers.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_initial_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_squared_numbers.
    rt_squared = REDUCE tt_numbers( INIT t = VALUE tt_numbers( ) 
                                   FOR num IN it_numbers 
                                   NEXT t = VALUE #( BASE t ( num ** 2 ) ) ).n    rt_squared = VALUE #( FOR num IN it_numbers ( num ** 2 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Finde den Namen des Kunden (`CUSTOMER_NAME`) aus einer Kundentabelle (it_customers - HASHED TABLE) für jeden Eintrag in der Bestellpositionstabelle (it_order_items), indem der **Tabellenausdruck** in FOR mit LET verwendet wird.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_table_expression_lookup DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_customer,
             id TYPE i,
             name TYPE string,
           END OF ty_customer,
           tt_customers TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_customer WITH UNIQUE KEY id,
           BEGIN OF ty_order_item_in,
             id TYPE i,
             customer_id TYPE i,
           END OF ty_order_item_in,
           tt_order_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_order_item_in WITH EMPTY KEY,
           BEGIN OF ty_resolved_item,
             id TYPE i,
             customer_name TYPE string,
           END OF ty_resolved_item,
           tt_resolved_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_resolved_item WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS resolve_customer_names
      IMPORTING it_order_items TYPE tt_order_items
                it_customers TYPE tt_customers
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_resolved_items) TYPE tt_resolved_items.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_table_expression_lookup IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD resolve_customer_names.
    rt_resolved_items = VALUE #( FOR <item> IN it_order_items 
      LET name = VALUE string( it_customers[ id = <item>-customer_id ]-name DEFAULT 'Unknown' ) 
      IN ( id = <item>-id customer_name = name ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Selektiere alle Einträge aus (it_data), deren `TYPE` gleich 'A' **UND** deren `AMOUNT` größer als 100 ist, mithilfe von FOR mit WHERE und logischem UND.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_filter_and DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_record,
             type TYPE c LENGTH 1,
             amount TYPE i,
           END OF ty_record,
           tt_record TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_record WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS filter_complex
      IMPORTING it_data TYPE tt_record
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered) TYPE tt_record.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_filter_and IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_complex.
    rt_filtered = VALUE #( FOR <r> IN it_data WHERE ( type = 'A' AND amount > 100 ) ( <r> ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechne das **Produkt** aller Zahlen in der Tabelle (it_numbers), beginnend mit 1, mithilfe von REDUCE.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_product DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS calculate_product
      IMPORTING it_numbers TYPE tt_numbers
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_product) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_product IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_product.
    rv_product = REDUCE i( INIT p = 1 FOR num IN it_numbers NEXT p = p * num ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstelle eine neue Tabelle (rt_modified), die alle Einträge aus (it_source) kopiert und das Feld `DESCRIPTION` auf 'CLEANED' setzt, wenn es initial (leer) ist, mithilfe von FOR und COND.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_cond_default DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             id TYPE i,
             description TYPE string,
           END OF ty_item,
           tt_item TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS clean_description
      IMPORTING it_source TYPE tt_item
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_modified) TYPE tt_item.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_cond_default IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD clean_description.
    rt_modified = VALUE #( FOR <l> IN it_source ( 
      id = <l>-id
      description = COND string( WHEN <l>-description IS INITIAL THEN 'CLEANED' ELSE <l>-description ) 
    ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lese den **letzten** Eintrag aus der Tabelle (it_data) in eine Struktur (rs_last_entry) mithilfe von READ TABLE ... INDEX unter Verwendung von LINES() zur Indexbestimmung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_read_table_last DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data,
           tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_last_entry
      IMPORTING it_data TYPE tt_data
      RETURNING VALUE(rs_last_entry) TYPE ty_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_read_table_last IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_last_entry.
    READ TABLE it_data INTO rs_last_entry INDEX lines( it_data ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Finde den Index des ersten Eintrags in der Tabelle (it_data) mit `FLAG = 'Y'` und speichere ihn (rv_index), mithilfe von LOOP AT ... INTO mit WHERE und **BREAK**.
solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_into_index_find DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      IMPORTING it_data TYPE tt_flag_item
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_index) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_into_index_find IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_first_index.
    rv_index = 0.
    LOOP AT it_data INTO DATA(ls_data) WHERE flag = 'Y'.
      rv_index = sy-tabix.
      BREAK.
    ENDLOOP.

Instructions: Kopiere alle Einträge von `it_source` in `rt_target` und entferne dabei **Duplikate** (basierend auf der gesamten Zeile), indem `rt_target` als HASHED TABLE mit UNIQUE DEFAULT KEY deklariert und FOR verwendet wird.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_copy_deduplicate DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id TYPE i,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data,
           tt_source TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY,
           tt_target TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_data WITH UNIQUE DEFAULT KEY.
    METHODS copy_unique
      IMPORTING it_source TYPE tt_source
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_target) TYPE tt_target.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_copy_deduplicate IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD copy_unique.
    rt_target = VALUE #( FOR <l> IN it_source ( <l> ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Setze den Status aller Datensätze in (ct_data) auf 'PROCESSED' für die **ersten 10** Einträge, **in-place**, mithilfe von LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING und UP TO.
solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_assign_up_to DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data,
           tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS process_first_ten
      CHANGING ct_data TYPE tt_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_assign_up_to IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_first_ten.
    LOOP AT ct_data ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_data>) UP TO 10 ROWS.
      <fs_data>-status = 'PROCESSED'.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppiere Einträge (it_data) nach `KEY` und füge alle zugehörigen `VALUE`-Strings zu einem einzelnen String zusammen (durch Leerzeichen getrennt), mithilfe von FOR GROUPS und REDUCE (String-Aggregation).
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_groups_concat DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             key TYPE i,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data,
           tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY,
           BEGIN OF ty_group_result,
             key TYPE i,
             concatenated_values TYPE string,
           END OF ty_group_result,
           tt_group_result TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_group_result WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS group_and_concatenate
      IMPORTING it_data TYPE tt_data
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_grouped) TYPE tt_group_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_groups_concat IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_and_concatenate.
    rt_grouped = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS <g> OF <l> IN it_data GROUP BY <l>-key ( 
      key = <g>-key
      concatenated_values = REDUCE string( INIT s = '' 
                                         FOR <gl> IN GROUP <g> 
                                         NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN <gl>-value ELSE s && ' ' && <gl>-value ) ) 
    ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechne die Summe des **Quadrats** aller **geraden** Zahlen in einer Tabelle (it_numbers), mithilfe von REDUCE mit WHERE-Klausel und mathematischer Operation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_square_even_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS sum_square_even
      IMPORTING it_numbers TYPE tt_numbers
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_square_even_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sum_square_even.
    rv_sum = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0 
                      FOR num IN it_numbers WHERE ( num MOD 2 = 0 ) 
                      NEXT s = s + ( num ** 2 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Aktualisiere den `STATUS` aller Artikel in der Tabelle (ct_data) auf 'INACTIVE', wenn das `EXPIRY_DATE` in der Vergangenheit liegt (kleiner als `sy-datum`), **in-place**, mithilfe von LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL mit WHERE.
solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_assign_expiry DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item_expiry,
             expiry_date TYPE sy-datum,
             status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_item_expiry,
           tt_item_expiry TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item_expiry WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS update_expired_status
      CHANGING ct_data TYPE tt_item_expiry.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_assign_expiry IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_expired_status.
    LOOP AT ct_data ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_data>) WHERE expiry_date < sy-datum.
      <fs_data>-status = 'INACTIVE'.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstelle eine Tabelle (rt_names) mit den Namen aller Mitarbeiter, deren Gehalt (salary) über 50000 liegt, aus der Eingabetabelle (it_employees), mithilfe von FOR mit WHERE.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_filter_salary DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

             id TYPE i,
             name TYPE string,
             salary TYPE p DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_employee,
           tt_employee TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_employee WITH EMPTY KEY,
           tt_names TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_high_earner_names
      IMPORTING it_employees TYPE tt_employee
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_names) TYPE tt_names.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_filter_salary IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_high_earner_names.
    rt_names = VALUE #( FOR <e> IN it_employees WHERE ( salary > 50000 ) ( <e>-name ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechne die Gesamtsumme aller Bestellwerte (amount) in der Tabelle (it_orders) mithilfe des REDUCE-Ausdrucks (Inline-Deklaration und p-Typ).
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_total_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_order,
             order_id TYPE i,
             amount TYPE p DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_order,
           tt_order TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_order WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS calculate_total
      IMPORTING it_orders TYPE tt_order
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_total) TYPE p DECIMALS 2.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_total_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total.
    rv_total = REDUCE p( INIT s = 0 FOR <o> IN it_orders NEXT s = s + <o>-amount ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erhöhe das Mengenfeld (quantity) aller Artikel in der Tabelle (ct_items) um 10% (Ganzzahl-Rundung) **in-place** mithilfe von LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL.
solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_assign_modify_percent DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             id TYPE i,
             quantity TYPE i,
           END OF ty_item,
           tt_item TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS increase_quantity
      CHANGING ct_items TYPE tt_item.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_assign_modify_percent IMPLEMENTATION.

ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Flache eine Tabelle von Tabellen (it_nested_data), die `id` und eine interne Tabelle `sub_items` enthält, in eine flache Liste der Sub-Items ab, mithilfe eines **verschachtelten FOR-Ausdrucks**.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_nested_flatten DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    TYPES tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.

             group_id TYPE i,
             sub_items TYPE tt_numbers,
           END OF ty_nested,

    METHODS flatten_list
      IMPORTING it_nested_data TYPE tt_nested
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flat) TYPE tt_numbers.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_nested_flatten IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Finde das früheste Buchungsdatum (booking_date) in der Flugtabelle (it_flights) mithilfe von REDUCE und der MIN-Funktion.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_min_date DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             booking_date TYPE sy-datum,
           END OF ty_flight,
           tt_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS find_earliest_date
      IMPORTING it_flights TYPE tt_flight
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_min_date) TYPE sy-datum.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_min_date IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_earliest_date.
    rv_min_date = REDUCE sy-datum( INIT min_d = sy-datum FOR <f> IN it_flights NEXT min_d = MIN( min_d, <f>-booking_date ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lösche alle leeren Zeilen (initiale Werte) aus der veränderbaren Tabelle (ct_data) **in-place** mithilfe von LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL und DELETE.
solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_assign_delete_initial DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Gruppiere Produkte (it_products) nach `CATEGORY` und berechne die durchschnittliche `PRICE` jeder Kategorie in der Zieltabelle (rt_avg_price) mithilfe von FOR GROUPS und der Aggregatfunktion AVG.

Instructions: Erstelle eine durch Semikolon getrennte Liste aller IDs aus der Tabelle (it_ids), wobei 'ID: ' vorangestellt wird, mithilfe von REDUCE und COND für die Initialisierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_concat_id DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Erstelle eine neue Tabelle (rt_transformed) aus (it_source), wobei das Feld `TYPE` auf 'X' gesetzt wird, wenn das Feld `STATUS` gleich 'OK' ist, ansonsten auf ' ' (Leerzeichen), mithilfe von FOR und COND.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_cond_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source,
             id TYPE i,

Instructions: Berechne eine laufende Summe der Mengen (quantity) in der Tabelle (it_items) und speichere sie in einer neuen Spalte (`running_total`) in einer neuen Tabelle mithilfe von REDUCE.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_running_total DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item_in,
             id TYPE i,
             quantity TYPE i,
           END OF ty_item_in,
           tt_item_in TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item_in WITH EMPTY KEY,
           BEGIN OF ty_item_out,
             id TYPE i,
             quantity TYPE i,
             running_total TYPE i,
           END OF ty_item_out,
           tt_item_out TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item_out WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS calculate_running_total
      IMPORTING it_items TYPE tt_item_in
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_running) TYPE tt_item_out.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_running_total IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_running_total.
    rt_running = REDUCE tt_item_out( 
      INIT rt = VALUE tt_item_out( ) total = 0 
      FOR <l> IN it_items 
      NEXT total = total + <l>-quantity 
           rt = VALUE #( BASE rt ( id = <l>-id quantity = <l>-quantity running_total = total ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_for_let_value_lookup DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item_in,
             item TYPE string,
             price TYPE p DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_item_in,

                it_prices TYPE tt_item_prices

CLASS zcl_for_let_value_lookup IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_prices.
    FINAL(ls_default) = VALUE ty_item_in( price = 0 ).
    rt_mapped = VALUE #( FOR <l> IN it_source

      IN ( item = <l>-item price = p-price ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ändere nur jeden zweiten Eintrag in der Tabelle (ct_data) **in-place**, beginnend mit dem ersten Eintrag (Index 1), mithilfe von LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING und sy-tabix (Modulo-Operation).
solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_assign_tabix_modify DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id TYPE i,

      CHANGING ct_data TYPE tt_data.

CLASS zcl_loop_assign_tabix_modify IMPLEMENTATION.

    LOOP AT ct_data ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_line>).

Instructions: Berechne den Durchschnitt der positiven Zahlen in der Tabelle (it_numbers) mithilfe von REDUCE, das Zähler und Summe verwaltet und das Ergebnis im FINAL-Abschnitt berechnet.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_average_positive DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.

      IMPORTING it_numbers TYPE tt_numbers
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_avg) TYPE decfloat16.

CLASS zcl_reduce_average_positive IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_average_positive.
    rv_avg = REDUCE decfloat16( INIT s = 0.0 idx = 0 
                              FOR num IN it_numbers WHERE ( num > 0 ) 
                              NEXT s = s + num idx = idx + 1 
                              FINAL = COND #( WHEN idx > 0 THEN s / idx ELSE 0 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Iteriere über eine nach `YEAR` sortierte Tabelle (it_data) und sammle in einer Zieltabelle die Zeile mit dem höchsten `REVENUE` für jedes Jahr, mithilfe von LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING, AT NEW und AT END OF (Manueller Gruppenwechsel).
solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_at_new_max DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_annual_data,
             year TYPE c LENGTH 4,
             revenue TYPE p DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_annual_data,
           tt_annual_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_annual_data WITH NON-UNIQUE SORTED KEY primary_key COMPONENTS year,
           tt_annual_max TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_annual_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_annual_max
      IMPORTING it_data TYPE tt_annual_data
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_annual_max) TYPE tt_annual_max.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_at_new_max IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_annual_max.
    DATA ls_max_revenue TYPE ty_annual_data.
    LOOP AT it_data ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_data>).
      AT NEW year.
        CLEAR ls_max_revenue.
      ENDAT.

      IF <fs_data>-revenue > ls_max_revenue-revenue.
        ls_max_revenue = <fs_data>.
      ENDIF.

      AT END OF year.
        APPEND ls_max_revenue TO rt_annual_max.
      ENDAT.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Generiere die ersten 10 Elemente der Fibonacci-Folge (1, 1, 2, 3, 5, ...), beginnend mit 1 und 1, mithilfe von REDUCE zur Zustandsverwaltung (State Management) und dem **indexierten Zugriff**.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_fibonacci_start DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS generate_fibonacci
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_fib) TYPE tt_numbers.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_fibonacci_start IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_fibonacci.
    rt_fib = REDUCE tt_numbers( 
      INIT t = VALUE tt_numbers( ( 1 ) ( 1 ) ) 
      FOR step = 3 UP TO 10 
      NEXT t = VALUE #( BASE t ( t[ step - 2 ] + t[ step - 1 ] ) ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Finde den Eintrag in der Tabelle (it_records) mit der höchsten Differenz (in Tagen) zwischen `END_DATE` und `START_DATE` mithilfe von REDUCE und dem LET-Ausdruck für die lokale Berechnung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_custom_logic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_record,
             id TYPE i,
             start_date TYPE sy-datum,
             end_date TYPE sy-datum,
           END OF ty_record,
           tt_record TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_record WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS find_longest_duration
      IMPORTING it_records TYPE tt_record
      RETURNING VALUE(rs_longest) TYPE ty_record.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_custom_logic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_longest_duration.
    DATA lv_max_diff TYPE i VALUE 0.
    rs_longest = REDUCE ty_record( INIT longest = VALUE ty_record( ) 
                                 FOR <r> IN it_records 
                                 LET diff = <r>-end_date - <r>-start_date 
                                 IN NEXT 
                                   longest = COND #( WHEN diff > lv_max_diff THEN <r> ELSE longest ) 
                                   lv_max_diff = MAX( lv_max_diff, diff ) 
                                   ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
