CLASS zcl_loop_assign_mod_del DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id TYPE i,
             status TYPE string,
             delete_flag TYPE c LENGTH 1,
           END OF ty_data,
           tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS process_and_delete
      CHANGING ct_data TYPE tt_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_assign_mod_del IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_and_delete.
    LOOP AT ct_data ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_data>).
      <fs_data>-status = 'OLD'.
      IF <fs_data>-delete_flag = 'X'.
        DELETE ct_data.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstelle eine neue Tabelle (rt_calc) aus (it_data), die die Original-ID, den `VALUE` und den `VALUE` * 2 als `DOUBLE_VALUE` enthält (Multi-Map), mithilfe von FOR.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_multi_map DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data_in,
             id TYPE i,
             value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data_in,
           tt_data_in TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data_in WITH EMPTY KEY,
           BEGIN OF ty_data_out,
             id TYPE i,
             value TYPE i,
             double_value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data_out,
           tt_data_out TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data_out WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS calculate_double
      IMPORTING it_data TYPE tt_data_in
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_calc) TYPE tt_data_out.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_multi_map IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_double.
    rt_calc = VALUE #( FOR <d> IN it_data ( 
      id = <d>-id
      value = <d>-value
      double_value = <d>-value * 2
    ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Füge alle Strings (it_strings) mit dem **Index als Präfix** zusammen (z.B. '1: A, 2: B, ...') mithilfe von REDUCE und einem zusätzlichen Zähler-Initialisierungsparameter.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_join_with_index DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_strings TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS join_indexed
      IMPORTING it_strings TYPE tt_strings
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_indexed_list) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_join_with_index IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD join_indexed.
    rv_indexed_list = REDUCE string( 
      INIT s = '' idx = 0 
      FOR str IN it_strings 
      NEXT idx = idx + 1 
           s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN |{ idx }: { str }| ELSE s && ', ' && |{ idx }: { str }| ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lese den `NAME` des Mitarbeiters mit `ID = 123` aus der Tabelle (it_employees) mithilfe des **Tabellenausdrucks** und Zuweisung an ein Field-Symbol.
solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_assign_table_expr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_employee,
             id TYPE i,
             name TYPE string,
           END OF ty_employee,
           tt_employee TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_employee WITH UNIQUE KEY id.
    METHODS get_employee_name
      IMPORTING it_employees TYPE tt_employee
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_name) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_assign_table_expr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_employee_name.
    ASSIGN it_employees[ id = 123 ] TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_employee>).
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_name = <fs_employee>-name.
    ELSE.
      rv_name = 'NOT FOUND'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Wähle alle Zeilen aus (it_data), bei denen der `STATUS` **nicht** gleich 'ERROR' ist, mithilfe von FOR mit WHERE und NOT-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_filter_not DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_log_item,
             status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_log_item,
           tt_log_item TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_log_item WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS filter_no_errors
      IMPORTING it_data TYPE tt_log_item
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_no_errors) TYPE tt_log_item.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_filter_not IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_no_errors.
    rt_no_errors = VALUE #( FOR <l> IN it_data WHERE ( status <> 'ERROR' ) ( <l> ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Zähle mithilfe von REDUCE, wie oft der `VALUE` größer als 100 in der Tabelle (it_numbers) ist, unter Verwendung einer Inline-Bedingung zum Zählen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_counter_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS count_greater_than_100
      IMPORTING it_numbers TYPE tt_numbers
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_count_gt100) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_counter_cond IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_greater_than_100.
    rv_count_gt100 = REDUCE i( INIT c = 0 
                              FOR num IN it_numbers 
                              NEXT c = c + COND #( WHEN num > 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Prüfe schnell, ob überhaupt ein Eintrag in der Tabelle (it_data) mit `DATE = sy-datum` existiert, mithilfe von LOOP AT ... TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS mit WHERE und BREAK (Früher Abbruch).
solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_no_fields_where DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             date TYPE sy-datum,
           END OF ty_data,
           tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS check_for_today
      IMPORTING it_data TYPE tt_data
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_found_today) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_no_fields_where IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_for_today.
    rv_found_today = abap_false.
    LOOP AT it_data TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS WHERE date = sy-datum.
      rv_found_today = abap_true.
      BREAK.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstelle eine Tabelle (rt_indexed_items), die nur die **ersten 5** Einträge von (it_items) enthält und den Index hinzufügt, mithilfe einer iterativen FOR-Schleife mit Index-Zählung und UNTIL-Bedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_index_limit DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item_in,
             id TYPE i,
           END OF ty_item_in,
           tt_item_in TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item_in WITH EMPTY KEY,
           BEGIN OF ty_item_out,
             id TYPE i,
             index TYPE i,
           END OF ty_item_out,
           tt_item_out TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item_out WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_first_five_indexed
      IMPORTING it_items TYPE tt_item_in
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_indexed_items) TYPE tt_item_out.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_index_limit IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_first_five_indexed.
    rt_indexed_items = VALUE #( FOR idx = 1 THEN idx + 1 UNTIL idx > 5 
                                FOR <l> IN it_items INDEX idx 
                                ( id = <l>-id index = idx ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstelle eine neue Tabelle (rt_squared) mit den **Quadraten** der Zahlen aus (it_numbers) mithilfe von FOR (als sauberere Alternative zu REDUCE BASE für diese Transformation).
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_squared_values DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_squared_numbers
      IMPORTING it_numbers TYPE tt_numbers
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_squared) TYPE tt_numbers.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_squared_values IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_squared_numbers.
    rt_squared = VALUE #( FOR num IN it_numbers ( num ** 2 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Finde den Namen des Kunden (`CUSTOMER_NAME`) aus einer Kundentabelle (it_customers - HASHED TABLE) für jeden Eintrag in der Bestellpositionstabelle (it_order_items), indem der **Tabellenausdruck** in FOR mit LET verwendet wird.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_table_expression_lookup DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_customer,
             id TYPE i,
             name TYPE string,
           END OF ty_customer,
           tt_customers TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_customer WITH UNIQUE KEY id,
           BEGIN OF ty_order_item_in,
             id TYPE i,
             customer_id TYPE i,
           END OF ty_order_item_in,
           tt_order_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_order_item_in WITH EMPTY KEY,
           BEGIN OF ty_resolved_item,
             id TYPE i,
             customer_name TYPE string,
           END OF ty_resolved_item,
           tt_resolved_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_resolved_item WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS resolve_customer_names
      IMPORTING it_order_items TYPE tt_order_items
                it_customers TYPE tt_customers
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_resolved_items) TYPE tt_resolved_items.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_table_expression_lookup IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD resolve_customer_names.
    rt_resolved_items = VALUE #( FOR <item> IN it_order_items 
      LET name = VALUE string( it_customers[ id = <item>-customer_id ]-name DEFAULT 'Unknown' ) 
      IN ( id = <item>-id customer_name = name ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Selektiere alle Einträge aus (it_data), deren `TYPE` gleich 'A' **UND** deren `AMOUNT` größer als 100 ist, mithilfe von FOR mit WHERE und logischem UND.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_filter_and DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_record,
             type TYPE c LENGTH 1,
             amount TYPE i,
           END OF ty_record,
           tt_record TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_record WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS filter_complex
      IMPORTING it_data TYPE tt_record
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered) TYPE tt_record.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_filter_and IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_complex.
    rt_filtered = VALUE #( FOR <r> IN it_data WHERE ( type = 'A' AND amount > 100 ) ( <r> ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechne das **Produkt** aller Zahlen in der Tabelle (it_numbers), beginnend mit 1, mithilfe von REDUCE.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_product DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS calculate_product
      IMPORTING it_numbers TYPE tt_numbers
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_product) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_product IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_product.
    rv_product = REDUCE i( INIT p = 1 FOR num IN it_numbers NEXT p = p * num ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstelle eine neue Tabelle (rt_modified), die alle Einträge aus (it_source) kopiert und das Feld `DESCRIPTION` auf 'CLEANED' setzt, wenn es initial (leer) ist, mithilfe von FOR und COND.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_cond_default DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             id TYPE i,
             description TYPE string,
           END OF ty_item,
           tt_item TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS clean_description
      IMPORTING it_source TYPE tt_item
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_modified) TYPE tt_item.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_cond_default IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD clean_description.
    rt_modified = VALUE #( FOR <l> IN it_source ( 
      id = <l>-id
      description = COND string( WHEN <l>-description IS INITIAL THEN 'CLEANED' ELSE <l>-description ) 
    ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lese den **letzten** Eintrag aus der Tabelle (it_data) in eine Struktur (rs_last_entry) mithilfe von READ TABLE ... INDEX unter Verwendung von LINES() zur Indexbestimmung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_read_table_last DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data,
           tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_last_entry
      IMPORTING it_data TYPE tt_data
      RETURNING VALUE(rs_last_entry) TYPE ty_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_read_table_last IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_last_entry.
    READ TABLE it_data INTO rs_last_entry INDEX lines( it_data ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Finde den Index des ersten Eintrags in der Tabelle (it_data) mit `FLAG = 'Y'` und speichere ihn (rv_index), mithilfe von LOOP AT ... INTO mit WHERE und **BREAK**.
solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_into_index_find DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flag_item,
             flag TYPE c LENGTH 1,
           END OF ty_flag_item,
           tt_flag_item TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flag_item WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS find_first_index
      IMPORTING it_data TYPE tt_flag_item
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_index) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_into_index_find IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_first_index.
    rv_index = 0.
    LOOP AT it_data INTO DATA(ls_data) WHERE flag = 'Y'.
      rv_index = sy-tabix.
      BREAK.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Kopiere alle Einträge von `it_source` in `rt_target` und entferne dabei **Duplikate** (basierend auf der gesamten Zeile), indem `rt_target` als HASHED TABLE mit UNIQUE DEFAULT KEY deklariert und FOR verwendet wird.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_copy_deduplicate DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id TYPE i,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data,
           tt_source TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY,
           tt_target TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_data WITH UNIQUE DEFAULT KEY.
    METHODS copy_unique
      IMPORTING it_source TYPE tt_source
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_target) TYPE tt_target.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_copy_deduplicate IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD copy_unique.
    rt_target = VALUE #( FOR <l> IN it_source ( <l> ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Setze den Status aller Datensätze in (ct_data) auf 'PROCESSED' für die **ersten 10** Einträge, **in-place**, mithilfe von LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING und UP TO.
solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_assign_up_to DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data,
           tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS process_first_ten
      CHANGING ct_data TYPE tt_data.
ENDCLASS.

    LOOP AT ct_data ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_data>) UP TO 10 ROWS.
      <fs_data>-status = 'PROCESSED'.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Gruppiere Einträge (it_data) nach `KEY` und füge alle zugehörigen `VALUE`-Strings zu einem einzelnen String zusammen (durch Leerzeichen getrennt), mithilfe von FOR GROUPS und REDUCE (String-Aggregation).
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_groups_concat DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             key TYPE i,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data,
           tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY,
           BEGIN OF ty_group_result,
             key TYPE i,
             concatenated_values TYPE string,
           END OF ty_group_result,
           tt_group_result TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_group_result WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS group_and_concatenate
      IMPORTING it_data TYPE tt_data
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_grouped) TYPE tt_group_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_groups_concat IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_and_concatenate.
    rt_grouped = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS <g> OF <l> IN it_data GROUP BY <l>-key ( 
      key = <g>-key
      concatenated_values = REDUCE string( INIT s = '' 
                                         FOR <gl> IN GROUP <g> 
                                         NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN <gl>-value ELSE s && ' ' && <gl>-value ) ) 
    ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechne die Summe des **Quadrats** aller **geraden** Zahlen in einer Tabelle (it_numbers), mithilfe von REDUCE mit WHERE-Klausel und mathematischer Operation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_square_even_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS sum_square_even
      IMPORTING it_numbers TYPE tt_numbers
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_square_even_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sum_square_even.
    rv_sum = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0 
                      FOR num IN it_numbers WHERE ( num MOD 2 = 0 ) 
                      NEXT s = s + ( num ** 2 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Aktualisiere den `STATUS` aller Artikel in der Tabelle (ct_data) auf 'INACTIVE', wenn das `EXPIRY_DATE` in der Vergangenheit liegt (kleiner als `sy-datum`), **in-place**, mithilfe von LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL mit WHERE.
solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_assign_expiry DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item_expiry,
             expiry_date TYPE sy-datum,
             status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_item_expiry,
           tt_item_expiry TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item_expiry WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS update_expired_status
      CHANGING ct_data TYPE tt_item_expiry.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_assign_expiry IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_expired_status.
    LOOP AT ct_data ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_data>) WHERE expiry_date < sy-datum.
      <fs_data>-status = 'INACTIVE'.

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstelle eine neue Tabelle (rt_normalized), die die `ID` und den `VALUE` enthält, wobei `VALUE` auf den Absolutwert gesetzt wird, mithilfe von FOR und der ABS-Funktion.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_abs_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id TYPE i,
             value TYPE i,

           tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_absolute_values

      RETURNING VALUE(rt_normalized) TYPE tt_data.

Instructions: Berechne die maximale Bestellmenge (MAX(quantity)) in der Tabelle (it_orders) mithilfe von REDUCE und der MAX-Funktion.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_max_quantity DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_order_item,
             quantity TYPE i,
           END OF ty_order_item,
           tt_order_item TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_order_item WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS find_max_quantity
      IMPORTING it_orders TYPE tt_order_item
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_max_qty) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_max_quantity IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_max_quantity.
    rv_max_qty = REDUCE i( INIT max_q = 0 FOR <o> IN it_orders NEXT max_q = MAX( max_q, <o>-quantity ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtere die Tabelle (it_items) auf Zeilen, deren `AMOUNT` größer als 100 ist und die `CURRENCY` auf 'EUR' setzen, mithilfe von FOR mit WHERE und Field-Assignment.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_filter_and_set DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item_in,
             amount TYPE p DECIMALS 2,
             currency TYPE c LENGTH 3,

           tt_item_in TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item_in WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS filter_and_set_currency
      IMPORTING it_items TYPE tt_item_in
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered) TYPE tt_item_in.

CLASS zcl_for_filter_and_set IMPLEMENTATION.

    ) ).

Instructions: Setze den Wert des Feldes `VALUE` in der Tabelle (ct_data) auf den Wert des Feldes `TEMP_VALUE` und lösche danach `TEMP_VALUE`, **in-place**, mithilfe von LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING.
solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_assign_swap DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             value TYPE string,
             temp_value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data,
           tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS swap_and_clear
      CHANGING ct_data TYPE tt_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_assign_swap IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD swap_and_clear.
    LOOP AT ct_data ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_data>).
      <fs_data>-value = <fs_data>-temp_value.
      CLEAR <fs_data>-temp_value.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Prüfe, ob der Eingabestring (iv_input) eine gültige E-Mail-Adresse enthält, mithilfe von `CL_ABAP_REGEX` und `MATCH`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_email_match DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_email_validity
      IMPORTING iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_email_match IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_email_validity.
    DATA(lv_pattern) = '^\w+([\.-]?\w+)*@\w+([\.-]?\w+)*(\.\w{2,3})+$'.
    rv_is_valid = cl_abap_regex=>match( pattern = lv_pattern text = iv_input ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Extrahiere alle im String (iv_input) gefundenen Zahlenfolgen (`\d+`) und gib sie als Liste (rt_numbers) zurück, mithilfe von `FIND_ALL`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_extract_numbers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_matches TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS extract_all_numbers
      IMPORTING iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_numbers) TYPE tt_matches.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_extract_numbers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_all_numbers.
    DATA(lv_pattern) = '\d+'.
    DATA(lo_regex) = cl_abap_regex=>create_for_pattern( pattern = lv_pattern ).
    DATA(lt_matches) = lo_regex->find_all( text = iv_input ).

    rt_numbers = VALUE #( FOR match IN lt_matches ( substring( iv_input, match-offset, match-length ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ersetze alle doppelten oder mehrfachen Leerzeichen (`\s{2,}`) im String (cv_input) durch ein einzelnes Leerzeichen, mithilfe von `REPLACE_ALL`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_replace_spaces DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS clean_multiple_spaces
      CHANGING cv_input TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_replace_spaces IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD clean_multiple_spaces.
    DATA(lv_pattern) = '\s{2,}'.
    DATA(lv_replacement) = ' '.
    cv_input = cl_abap_regex=>replace_all( pattern = lv_pattern text = cv_input replacement = lv_replacement ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Trenne einen CSV-String (iv_input), der durch Kommas getrennt ist, in einzelne Komponenten (rt_parts), mithilfe von `CL_ABAP_REGEX` und `SPLIT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_split_csv DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_parts TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS split_csv_by_comma
      IMPORTING iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_parts) TYPE tt_parts.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_split_csv IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD split_csv_by_comma.

Instructions: Ersetze alle führenden **und** nachfolgenden Nullen bei einem Dezimalwert (z.B. `01.200` zu `1.2`), mithilfe von Gruppenrückverweisen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_normalize_decimal DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS normalize_decimal
      CHANGING cv_text TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_normalize_decimal IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD normalize_decimal.
    " Entferne führende Nullen: 01.2 -> 1.2
    cv_text = cl_abap_regex=>replace_all( pattern = '\b0+(\d+)\.' text = cv_text replacement = '$1.' ).
    " Entferne nachfolgende Nullen (nach Punkt): 1.200 -> 1.2
    cv_text = cl_abap_regex=>replace_all( pattern = '\.(\d*?)0+\b' text = cv_text replacement = '.$1' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_normalize_decimal DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS normalize_decimal
      CHANGING cv_text TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_normalize_decimal IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD normalize_decimal.
    " Entferne führende Nullen: 01.2 -> 1.2
    cv_text = cl_abap_regex=>replace_all( pattern = '\b0+(\d+)\.' text = cv_text replacement = '$1.' ).
    " Entferne nachfolgende Nullen (nach Punkt): 1.200 -> 1.2
    cv_text = cl_abap_regex=>replace_all( pattern = '\.(\d*?)0+\b' text = cv_text replacement = '.$1' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      RETURNING VALUE(rt_content) TYPE tt_matches.

CLASS zcl_regex_extract_quotes IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_quoted_text.
    DATA(lv_pattern) = '"([^"]*)"'.

    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( text = iv_input ).

    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Entferne alle Zeilenumbrüche (`\r\n`, `\n`, `\r`) aus einem mehrzeiligen Text (cv_text), um ihn zu einer einzelnen Zeile zu machen, mithilfe von `REPLACE_ALL`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_remove_linebreaks DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS flatten_text
      CHANGING cv_text TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_remove_linebreaks IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD flatten_text.
    DATA(lv_pattern) = '[\r\n]'.
    DATA(lv_replacement) = ' '.
    cv_text = cl_abap_regex=>replace_all( pattern = lv_pattern text = cv_text replacement = lv_replacement ).
    " Entferne zusätzliche Leerzeichen, die durch Ersetzung entstehen können
    cv_text = cl_abap_regex=>replace_all( pattern = '\s{2,}' text = cv_text replacement = ' ' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_leetspeak IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Ersetze alle führenden **und** nachfolgenden Nullen bei einem Dezimalwert (z.B. `01.200` zu `1.2`), mithilfe von Gruppenrückverweisen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_normalize_decimal DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS normalize_decimal
      CHANGING cv_text TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_normalize_decimal IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD normalize_decimal.
    " Entferne führende Nullen: 01.2 -> 1.2
    cv_text = cl_abap_regex=>replace_all( pattern = '\b0+(\d+)\.' text = cv_text replacement = '$1.' ).
    " Entferne nachfolgende Nullen (nach Punkt): 1.200 -> 1.2
    cv_text = cl_abap_regex=>replace_all( pattern = '\.(\d*?)0+\b' text = cv_text replacement = '.$1' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_normalize_decimal IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD normalize_decimal.
    " Entferne führende Nullen: 01.2 -> 1.2
    cv_text = cl_abap_regex=>replace_all( pattern = '\b0+(\d+)\.' text = cv_text replacement = '$1.' ).

CLASS zcl_regex_find_roman_pairs DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_matches TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS find_roman_pairs
      IMPORTING iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_pairs) TYPE tt_matches.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_find_roman_pairs IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_roman_pairs.
    DATA(lv_pattern) = '(IV|IX|XL|XC|CD|CM)'.
    DATA(lo_regex) = cl_abap_regex=>create_for_pattern( pattern = lv_pattern options = cl_abap_regex=>case_insensitive ).
    DATA(lt_matches) = lo_regex->find_all( text = iv_text ).

    rt_pairs = VALUE #( FOR match IN lt_matches ( substring( iv_text, match-offset, match-length ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Finde alle Zahlen, denen ein '$' vorangestellt ist, und extrahiere nur die Zahl (als Gruppe).
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_extract_currency_val DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_matches TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS find_dollar_values
      IMPORTING iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_values) TYPE tt_matches.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_extract_currency_val IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_dollar_values.
    DATA(lv_pattern) = '\$(\d+(?:\.\d{2})?)'.
    DATA(lo_regex) = cl_abap_regex=>create_for_pattern( pattern = lv_pattern ).
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( text = iv_text ).

    DO.
      IF lo_matcher->find( ) = abap_false. EXIT. ENDIF.
      APPEND lo_matcher->get_submatch( 1 ) TO rt_values.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verwende `COND`, um festzustellen, ob ein Index (`i_index`) der erste, der letzte oder ein mittlerer Eintrag einer Tabelle (`it_table`) ist.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cond_list_index DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS check_index_position
      IMPORTING it_table TYPE tt_data
                i_index TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_position) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_list_index IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_index_position.
    DATA(lv_lines) = lines( it_table ).
    rv_position = COND string(
      WHEN lv_lines = 0 THEN 'Tabelle leer'
      WHEN i_index = 1 THEN 'Erster Eintrag'
      WHEN i_index = lv_lines THEN 'Letzter Eintrag'
      WHEN i_index > 1 AND i_index < lv_lines THEN 'Mittlerer Eintrag'
      ELSE 'Index außerhalb des Bereichs'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verwende `CASE` in einer Methode zur einfachen Befehlsverteilung (Dispatcher), um basierend auf einem String-Befehl ('USER', 'PRODUCT', 'REPORT') eine simulierte Aktion zu protokollieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_case_method_dispatcher DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS dispatch_command
      IMPORTING iv_command TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_log) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_case_method_dispatcher IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD dispatch_command.
    DATA(lv_command_uc) = to_upper( iv_command ).
    CASE lv_command_uc.
      WHEN 'USER'.
        rv_log = 'Dispatching: User-Verwaltung gestartet'.
      WHEN 'PRODUCT'.
        rv_log = 'Dispatching: Produktkatalog aktualisiert'.
      WHEN 'REPORT'.
        rv_log = 'Dispatching: Hintergrundbericht gestartet'.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_log = 'Fehler: Unbekannter Befehl'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verwende `COND` zur Implementierung einer ternären Logik, um das Maximum von zwei Zahlen (`i_num1`, `i_num2`) zurückzugeben.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cond_ternary_max DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_max_number
      IMPORTING i_num1 TYPE i
                i_num2 TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_max) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_ternary_max IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_number.
    rv_max = COND i(
      WHEN i_num1 > i_num2 THEN i_num1
      ELSE i_num2
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verwende `COND`, um einen String (`iv_input`) basierend auf der Länge (max. 50 Zeichen) entweder unberührt zurückzugeben oder ihn zu kürzen und '...' anzuhängen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cond_truncate_text DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS truncate_text
      IMPORTING iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_truncate_text IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lv_max_length) = 50.

Instructions: Verwende `CASE` mit Vergleichsoperatoren (`<`, `THRU`, `OTHERS`) zur Bestimmung des Lagerbestandsstatus: 'Kritisch' (< 10), 'Niedrig' (10-50), 'Normal' (> 50).
solution:

      RETURNING VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.

Instructions: Verwende `COND`, um zu entscheiden, ob eine Operation addiert (Flag 'A') oder multipliziert (Flag 'M') wird (`i_num1` und `i_num2`).
solution:
CLASS zcl_cond_op_switch DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_based_on_flag
      IMPORTING i_num1 TYPE i
                i_num2 TYPE i
                iv_operation_flag TYPE char1
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_op_switch IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_based_on_flag.
    rv_result = COND i(
      WHEN iv_operation_flag = 'A' THEN i_num1 + i_num2
      WHEN iv_operation_flag = 'M' THEN i_num1 * i_num2
      ELSE 0
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verwende `COND`, um zu prüfen, ob eine eingegebene Jahreszahl (`i_year`) ein Schaltjahr ist (mod 4 = 0 und (mod 100 <> 0 oder mod 400 = 0)).
solution:
CLASS zcl_cond_leap_year_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_leap_year
      IMPORTING i_year TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_is_leap) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_leap_year_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_leap_year.
    rv_is_leap = COND abap_bool(
      WHEN i_year MOD 4 = 0 AND ( i_year MOD 100 <> 0 OR i_year MOD 400 = 0 ) THEN abap_true
      ELSE abap_false
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Verwende `CASE`, um Dateierweiterungen (`iv_extension`) in ihre MIME-Typen umzuwandeln (PDF, XLSX, TXT).
solution:
CLASS zcl_case_mime_type DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_mime_type
      IMPORTING iv_extension TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_mime) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_case_mime_type IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_mime_type.
    DATA(lv_ext_lc) = to_lower( iv_extension ).
    CASE lv_ext_lc.
      WHEN 'pdf'.
        rv_mime = 'application/pdf'.
      WHEN 'xlsx' OR 'xls'.
        rv_mime = 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet'.
      WHEN 'txt'.
        rv_mime = 'text/plain'.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_mime = 'application/octet-stream'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verwende `COND`, um einen String (`rv_output`) aus zwei Komponenten (`iv_part1`, `iv_part2`) zusammenzusetzen, wobei `iv_part2` durch 'N/A' ersetzt wird, wenn es initial ist.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cond_string_concat DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_combined_string
      IMPORTING iv_part1 TYPE string
                iv_part2 TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_string_concat IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_combined_string.
    DATA(lv_part2_final) = COND string(
      WHEN iv_part2 IS INITIAL THEN 'N/A'
      ELSE iv_part2
    ).
    rv_output = |{ iv_part1 } - { lv_part2_final }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verwende `CASE` und `THRU`, um die Höhe einer Verkehrsstrafgebühr (`rv_fine`) basierend auf der Geschwindigkeitsüberschreitung (`iv_overspeed`) zu bestimmen (1-10: 50, 11-20: 150, > 20: 300).
solution:
CLASS zcl_case_traffic_fine DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_fine
      IMPORTING iv_overspeed TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_fine) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_case_traffic_fine IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_fine.
    CASE iv_overspeed.
      WHEN 1 THRU 10.
        rv_fine = 50.
      WHEN 11 THRU 20.
        rv_fine = 150.
      WHEN > 20.
        rv_fine = 300.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_fine = 0.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verwende `COND`, um einen Eingabestring (`iv_input`) entweder in Großbuchstaben (`UPPER`) oder Kleinbuchstaben (`LOWER`) umzuwandeln, abhängig von einem Flag (`iv_case_flag`).
solution:
CLASS zcl_cond_text_case DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_text_case
      IMPORTING iv_input TYPE string
                iv_case_flag TYPE char1 " 'U' for Upper, 'L' for Lower
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_text_case IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_text_case.
    rv_output = COND string(
      WHEN iv_case_flag = 'U' THEN to_upper( iv_input )
      WHEN iv_case_flag = 'L' THEN to_lower( iv_input )
      ELSE iv_input
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Bestimme mit `CASE`, ob eine Transaktion (`iv_tcode`) als 'Online' (beginnt mit /N) oder 'Dialog' (beginnt mit /O) kategorisiert wird.
solution:
CLASS zcl_case_tcode_type DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Verwende `COND`, um basierend auf einem Kennzeichen (`iv_net_amount`) zu entscheiden, ob ein gegebener Betrag der Netto- oder Bruttobetrag ist (Berechne den Bruttobetrag bei Netto, angenommen 19% MwSt).
solution:
CLASS zcl_cond_vat_calculation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_gross_amount
      IMPORTING i_amount TYPE p DECIMALS 2
                iv_is_net_amount TYPE abap_bool
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_gross_amount) TYPE p DECIMALS 2.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_vat_calculation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_gross_amount.
    rv_gross_amount = COND #( 
      WHEN iv_is_net_amount = abap_true THEN i_amount * '1.19'
      ELSE i_amount
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verwende `CASE`, um HTTP-Statuscodes (200, 404, 500) ihren Beschreibungen zuzuordnen ('OK', 'Not Found', 'Internal Server Error').
solution:
CLASS zcl_case_http_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_status_description
      IMPORTING iv_status_code TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_description) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_case_http_status IMPLEMENTATION.

    CASE iv_status_code.
      WHEN 200.
        rv_description = 'OK (Erfolgreich)'.

Instructions: Verwende `COND`, um basierend auf einem Flag (`iv_format_flag`) ein Datum (`iv_date`) entweder im deutschen (`DD.MM.YYYY`) oder amerikanischen (`MM/DD/YYYY`) Format zurückzugeben.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cond_date_format DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS format_date
      IMPORTING iv_date TYPE sy-datum
                iv_format_flag TYPE char1 " 'D' for German, 'U' for US
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_formatted_date) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_date_format IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_date.
    rv_formatted_date = COND string(
      WHEN iv_format_flag = 'D' THEN |{ iv_date+6(2) }.{ iv_date+4(2) }.{ iv_date(4) }|
      WHEN iv_format_flag = 'U' THEN |{ iv_date+4(2) }/{ iv_date+6(2) }/{ iv_date(4) }|
      ELSE iv_date
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Bestimme mit `CASE` die Beschreibung von Zahlungsbedingungen (`iv_payment_term`) für gängige Codes (0001: Sofort, 0002: 14 Tage).

Instructions: Verwende `COND`, um den erforderlichen Objektsperrmodus (`rv_lock_mode`) basierend auf der Operation (`iv_operation`) zuzuweisen (READ: Shared 'S', WRITE/DELETE: Exclusive 'E').
solution:
CLASS zcl_cond_lock_mode DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_required_lock_mode
      IMPORTING iv_operation TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_lock_mode) TYPE char1.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_lock_mode IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_required_lock_mode.
    DATA(lv_op_uc) = to_upper( iv_operation ).
    rv_lock_mode = COND char1(
      WHEN lv_op_uc = 'READ' THEN 'S'
      WHEN lv_op_uc = 'WRITE' OR lv_op_uc = 'DELETE' THEN 'E'

    ).

Instructions: Bestimme mit `CASE` die Verkaufsregion (`rv_region`) basierend auf dem Verkaufsbüro-Code (`iv_sales_office`) (z.B. 1000/1100: Nord, 2000/2100: Süd).
solution:
CLASS zcl_case_sales_region DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      IMPORTING iv_sales_office TYPE char4
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_region) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_case_sales_region IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sales_region.
    CASE iv_sales_office.

ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verwende `COND`, um die Potenz von 2 zu berechnen (2^i_power) für kleine, nicht-negative ganzzahlige Potenzen (0: 1, 1: 2, 2: 4, 3: 8).
solution:
CLASS zcl_cond_power_of_2 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_power_of_2
      IMPORTING i_power TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_power_of_2 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_power_of_2.
    rv_result = COND i(
      WHEN i_power = 0 THEN 1
      WHEN i_power = 1 THEN 2
      WHEN i_power = 2 THEN 4
      WHEN i_power = 3 THEN 8
      ELSE 0
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Bestimme mit `CASE` die Komplexität einer Benutzerrolle (`iv_role_id`) (1-10: Einfach, 11-20: Mittel, > 20: Komplex).

Instructions: Verwende `COND` in einer Methode, um den dritten Eintrag einer internen Tabelle (`it_data`) zurückzugeben, falls dieser existiert, andernfalls den Wert 'N/A'.

CLASS zcl_cond_list_item_select DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Verwende `CASE` und `WHEN` mit Vergleichsoperatoren (`<`, `>`) in einer Methode, um zu prüfen, ob die Ausführungszeit (`iv_runtime_sec`) 'Gering' (< 1s), 'Mittel' (1-10s) oder 'Hoch' (> 10s) ist.

CLASS zcl_case_runtime_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_case_runtime_check IMPLEMENTATION.

      WHEN OTHERS.

Instructions: Verwende `COND`, um eine Fehlermeldung (`rv_error`) auszugeben, wenn ein Datensatz (`i_count`) nicht gefunden wurde (i_count = 0).
solution:
CLASS zcl_cond_error_msg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_error_msg IMPLEMENTATION.

    ).

ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Bestimme mit `CASE` die Lohnartengruppe (`rv_group`) basierend auf der Lohnart (`iv_wage_type`) (Lohnarten, die mit '1' beginnen: Grundlohn, '2': Bonus).

Instructions: Verwende `COND` zur Berechnung des Gesamtrabattes: 10% bei `i_amount` > 1000 UND `i_customer_type` = 'VIP', sonst 0%.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cond_complex_discount DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_complex_discount
      IMPORTING i_amount TYPE p DECIMALS 2
                i_customer_type TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_discount) TYPE p DECIMALS 2.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_complex_discount IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_complex_discount.

      WHEN i_amount > 1000 AND to_upper( i_customer_type ) = 'VIP' THEN i_amount * '0.10'

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Verwende `CASE` auf einer Zeichenkette, um zu prüfen, ob sie nur numerische Zeichen (`CP '0123456789'`) oder andere Zeichen enthält, und eine entsprechende Meldung zurückzugeben.

Instructions: Bestimme die Flugallianz (`rv_alliance`) basierend auf dem Fluglinien-Code (`iv_carrid`) aus SFLIGHT (LH/LX/OS: Star Alliance, BA/IB: Oneworld, AA/DL: SkyTeam, OTHERS: Unabhängig).

Instructions: Verwende `COND`, um die Auslastungskategorie (`rv_category`) eines Fluges zu bestimmen: 'Leer' (0%), 'Niedrig' (1-49%), 'Mittel' (50-80%), 'Hoch' (> 80%).
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_occupancy DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_occupancy_category
      IMPORTING i_seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc
                i_seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_category) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_occupancy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_occupancy_category.
    DATA(lv_rate) = COND p DECIMALS 2(
      WHEN i_seatsmax > 0 THEN ( i_seatsocc / i_seatsmax ) * 100
      ELSE 0
    ).

    rv_category = COND string(
      WHEN lv_rate = 0 THEN 'Leer'
      WHEN lv_rate < 50 THEN 'Niedrig'
      WHEN lv_rate <= 80 THEN 'Mittel'
      ELSE 'Hoch'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verwende `CASE` und `WHEN` mit Vergleichsoperatoren (`<`, `>`) auf dem Flugpreis (`iv_price`), um diesen als 'Budget', 'Standard' oder 'Premium' zu klassifizieren (Budget < 500, Premium > 1500).

Instructions: Bestimme mit `CASE` die Hauptwährung (`rv_main_currency`) für gängige Fluggesellschaften (LH/LX: EUR, AA/UA: USD, JL: JPY, OTHERS: Lokale Währung).

Instructions: Verwende `COND`, um die Anzahl der freien Economy-Sitze (`rv_free_economy`) zu berechnen, falls die Kapazität bekannt ist (`i_seatsmaxy`), sonst 0.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_free_seats DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_free_economy_seats
      IMPORTING i_seatsmaxy TYPE sflight-seatsmaxy
                i_seatsoccy TYPE sflight-seatsoccy
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_free_economy) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_free_seats IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_free_economy_seats.
    rv_free_economy = COND i(
      WHEN i_seatsmaxy > 0 THEN i_seatsmaxy - i_seatsoccy
      ELSE 0
    ).
    rv_free_economy = COND i(
      WHEN rv_free_economy < 0 THEN 0
      ELSE rv_free_economy
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Bestimme mit `CASE` die Flugzeugkategorie (`rv_category`) basierend auf dem Flugzeugtyp (`iv_planetype`) (747*: Jumbo Jet, A380: Super Jumbo, OTHERS: Narrow/Medium Body).

Instructions: Verwende `COND` in einer Methode, um das Flugticket zu verbieten (`rv_is_forbidden`), wenn es in JPY ist und der Preis über 100.000 liegt.

Instructions: Klassifiziere den Flug (`iv_connid`) mit `CASE` als 'Kontinental' (4-stellig, beginnt mit 0), 'Interkontinental' (4-stellig, beginnt nicht mit 0) oder 'Regional' (andere Länge).
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_flight_type DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_type
      IMPORTING iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_type) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_flight_type IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_type.
    DATA(lv_connid_str) = CONV string( iv_connid ).

    CASE strlen( lv_connid_str ).
      WHEN 4.
        CASE lv_connid_str(1).
          WHEN '0'.
            rv_type = 'Kontinental'.
          WHEN OTHERS.
            rv_type = 'Interkontinental'.
        ENDCASE.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_type = 'Regional/Charter'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verwende `COND`, um einen Warnhinweis (`rv_warning`) auszugeben, wenn die Raucherplätze (`i_smokers`) 10 überschreiten, ansonsten 'Keine Warnung'.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_smoker_warning DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Bestimme mit `CASE` die Flug-Saison (`rv_season`) basierend auf dem Monat des Flugdatums (`iv_fldate`): April-Oktober ist 'Sommer', November-März ist 'Winter'.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_season DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      IMPORTING iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_season) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_season IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_season.
    DATA(lv_month) = iv_fldate+4(2).

    CASE lv_month.
      WHEN '04' THRU '10'.
        rv_season = 'Sommer'.
      WHEN '11' OR '12' OR '01' THRU '03'.
        rv_season = 'Winter'.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_season = 'Ungültiges Datum'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verwende `COND`, um festzustellen, welche Buchungsklasse (`rv_max_booked_class`) am stärksten gebucht ist (F, C oder Y). Berücksichtige, dass der Wert 0 bedeuten kann, dass die Klasse nicht existiert.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_most_booked DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_most_booked_class
      IMPORTING i_seatsoccf TYPE sflight-seatsoccf
                i_seatsoccc TYPE sflight-seatsoccc
                i_seatsoccy TYPE sflight-seatsoccy
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_max_booked_class) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_most_booked IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_most_booked_class.
    DATA(lv_max_occ) = max( val1 = i_seatsoccf val2 = i_seatsoccc val3 = i_seatsoccy ).

    rv_max_booked_class = COND string(
      WHEN lv_max_occ = 0 THEN 'Keine Buchungen'
      WHEN lv_max_occ = i_seatsoccf THEN 'First Class'
      WHEN lv_max_occ = i_seatsoccc THEN 'Business Class'
      WHEN lv_max_occ = i_seatsoccy THEN 'Economy Class'
      ELSE 'Unbekannt'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lv_connid_str) = CONV string( iv_connid ).

        rv_ticket_type = 'Standardstrecke'.

      WHEN OTHERS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_currency_format DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Bestimme mit `CASE` die Preisentwicklungsrichtung (`rv_trend`) für den Flug: Preis ist kleiner als 500 und Währung ist USD ('Steigend'), Preis ist über 1000 und Währung ist EUR ('Fallend'), ansonsten 'Neutral'.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_price_trend DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_price_trend
      IMPORTING i_price TYPE sflight-price
                iv_currency TYPE sflight-currency
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_trend) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_price_trend IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_price_trend.
    DATA(lv_combined) = iv_currency && CONV string( i_price ).

    CASE abap_true.

Instructions: Verwende `COND`, um eine Standardflugnummer (`rv_connid_default`) zuzuweisen, wenn die eingegebene Flugnummer (`iv_connid`) initial ist, sonst die eingegebene Nummer.

Instructions: Bestimme mit `CASE` die Service-Level-Klasse (`rv_service_class`) für Flüge: Flugnummern unter 200 sind 'Ultra Low Cost', 200-800 'Basic', über 800 'Full Service'.

  METHOD get_service_level.
    DATA(lv_connid_int) = CONV i( iv_connid ).

Instructions: Verwende `COND`, um zu prüfen, ob die Auslastung der Economy-Klasse (`i_seatsoccy` / `i_seatsmaxy`) über 90% liegt, und entsprechend 'Hohe Eco-Auslastung' zurückzugeben.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_eco_load_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    METHODS check_high_economy_load
      IMPORTING i_seatsoccy TYPE sflight-seatsoccy
                i_seatsmaxy TYPE sflight-seatsmaxy
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_eco_load_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_high_economy_load.
    DATA(lv_load_rate) = COND p DECIMALS 2(

      ELSE 0
    ).

    rv_message = COND string(
      WHEN lv_load_rate > 90 THEN 'Hohe Eco-Auslastung'
      ELSE 'Normale Eco-Auslastung'
    ).

Instructions: Bestimme mit `CASE` die Marketing-Preisgruppe (`rv_price_group`) basierend auf dem Preis (`iv_price`) und der Währung (`iv_currency`): z.B. Preis > 5000 EUR oder Preis > 6000 USD ist 'Ultra Luxury'.

Instructions: Verwende `COND`, um das Flugdatum (`iv_fldate`) um 30 Tage vorzuverlegen (`rv_rebook_date`), wenn das Flugdatum in der Vergangenheit liegt.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_rebook_logic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Bestimme mit `CASE` die Kundenfokus-Kategorie (`rv_customer_focus`) basierend auf der Anzahl der Industriekunden (`i_numindc`): 0-10: 'Privatkunden', 11-50: 'Geschäftskunden', > 50: 'Industriekunden'.

Instructions: Bestimme mit `CASE` die Flugzeugwartungskategorie (`rv_maintenance`) basierend auf dem Flugzeugtyp (`iv_planetype`) (747/A380: 'Schwer', 737/A320: 'Mittel', OTHERS: 'Leicht').

Instructions: Bestimme mit `CASE` die Flugverkehrsregion (`rv_region`) basierend auf dem ersten Buchstaben der Fluggesellschaft (`iv_carrid`): A-F: 'Nordamerika', G-M: 'Europa', N-Z: 'Asien/Pazifik'.

Instructions: Verwende `COND`, um die Auslastungskategorie (`rv_category`) eines Fluges zu bestimmen: 'Leer' (0%), 'Niedrig' (1-49%), 'Mittel' (50-80%), 'Hoch' (> 80%).
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_occupancy DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_sflight_occupancy IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Verwende `COND`, um die Anzahl der freien Economy-Sitze (`rv_free_economy`) zu berechnen, falls die Kapazität bekannt ist (`i_seatsmaxy`), sonst 0.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_free_seats DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_free_economy_seats
      IMPORTING i_seatsmaxy TYPE sflight-seatsmaxy
                i_seatsoccy TYPE sflight-seatsoccy
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_free_economy) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_free_seats IMPLEMENTATION.

      ELSE lv_potential_free

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Klassifiziere den Flug (`iv_connid`) mit `CASE` als 'Kontinental' (4-stellig, beginnt mit 0), 'Interkontinental' (4-stellig, beginnt nicht mit 0) oder 'Regional' (andere Länge).
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_flight_type DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      IMPORTING iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid

Instructions: Bestimme mit `CASE` die Flug-Saison (`rv_season`) basierend auf dem Monat des Flugdatums (`iv_fldate`): April-Oktober ist 'Sommer', November-März ist 'Winter'.

Instructions: Verwende `COND`, um festzustellen, welche Buchungsklasse (`rv_max_booked_class`) am stärksten gebucht ist (F, C oder Y). Berücksichtige, dass der Wert 0 bedeuten kann, dass die Klasse nicht existiert.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_most_booked DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      IMPORTING i_seatsoccf TYPE sflight-seatsoccf

                i_seatsoccy TYPE sflight-seatsoccy
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_max_booked_class) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_sflight_most_booked IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lv_max_occ) = max( val1 = i_seatsoccf val2 = i_seatsoccc val3 = i_seatsoccy ).

      WHEN lv_max_occ = i_seatsoccc THEN 'Business Class'
      WHEN lv_max_occ = i_seatsoccy THEN 'Economy Class'

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_utils DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      IMPORTING i_text TYPE string

CLASS zcl_string_utils IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_palindrome.
    DATA(lv_clean_text) = to_upper( replace( val = i_text regex = '[^A-Z0-9]' with = '' occ = 0 ) ).

CLASS zcl_table_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_max
      IMPORTING it_numbers TYPE tt_numbers
      RETURNING VALUE(r_max) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max.
    r_max = REDUCE i( INIT m = 0 FOR num IN it_numbers WHERE ( num IS NOT INITIAL ) NEXT m = nmax( val1 = m val2 = num ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstelle eine Methode, die prüft, ob ein gegebenes Jahr ein Schaltjahr ist (divisible by 4, but not by 100 unless divisible by 400).
solution:
CLASS zcl_date_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_leap_year
      IMPORTING i_year TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(r_is_leap) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_leap_year.
    r_is_leap = xsdbool(
      ( i_year MOD 4 = 0 AND i_year MOD 100 <> 0 ) OR
      ( i_year MOD 400 = 0 )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_table_processor IMPLEMENTATION.

CLASS zcl_math_utils DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Erstelle eine Methode, die die ersten N Zahlen der Fibonacci-Folge als interne Tabelle zurückgibt.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_utils DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS fibonacci
      IMPORTING i_n TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(r_sequence) TYPE tt_numbers.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_utils IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD fibonacci.
    IF i_n <= 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_a) = 0.
    DATA(lv_b) = 1.

    APPEND lv_a TO r_sequence.

    IF i_n = 1.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    APPEND lv_b TO r_sequence.

    DO i_n - 2 TIMES.
      DATA(lv_temp) = lv_a + lv_b.
      APPEND lv_temp TO r_sequence.
      lv_a = lv_b.
      lv_b = lv_temp.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstelle eine Methode, die prüft, ob eine gegebene Zahl eine Primzahl ist (nur durch 1 und sich selbst teilbar).
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_utils DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_prime
      IMPORTING i_number TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(r_is_prime) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_utils IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_prime.
    IF i_number <= 1.
      r_is_prime = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_limit) = floor( sqrt( i_number ) ).

    DO lv_limit TIMES.
      DATA(lv_divisor) = sy-index + 1.
      IF i_number MOD lv_divisor = 0.
        r_is_prime = abap_false.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.

    r_is_prime = abap_true.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lo_math->is_prime( 7 ) msg = '7 muss Primzahl sein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lo_math->is_prime( 13 ) msg = '13 muss Primzahl sein' ).

CLASS zcl_file_utils DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_file_utils IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_file_info.
    DATA(lv_last_dot) = find( val = i_path sub = '.' case = abap_false occ = -1 ).

    ENDIF.

    rs_file_info-name = i_path( lv_last_dot ).
    rs_file_info-extension = i_path+lv_last_dot+1( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstelle eine Methode, die den Durchschnitt (Mittelwert) einer internen Tabelle von Dezimalzahlen berechnet. Behandle Division durch Null.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_amounts TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF p DECIMALS 2 WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_average
      IMPORTING it_amounts TYPE tt_amounts
      RETURNING VALUE(r_average) TYPE p DECIMALS 2.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average.
    DATA(lv_count) = lines( it_amounts ).
    IF lv_count = 0.
      r_average = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_sum) = REDUCE p DECIMALS 2( INIT s = 0 FOR amount IN it_amounts NEXT s = s + amount ).
    r_average = lv_sum / lv_count.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_utils DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_age
      IMPORTING i_birth_date TYPE d
      RETURNING VALUE(r_age) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_utils IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_age.
    DATA(lv_current_date) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_age) = lv_current_date(4) - i_birth_date(4).

    IF lv_current_date+4(4) < i_birth_date+4(4).
      lv_age = lv_age - 1.
    ENDIF.

    r_age = lv_age.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_sorter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_numbers TYPE SORTED TABLE OF i WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.
    METHODS merge_sorted_tables
      IMPORTING it_a TYPE tt_numbers
                it_b TYPE tt_numbers
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_merged) TYPE tt_numbers.

CLASS zcl_table_sorter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD merge_sorted_tables.
    rt_merged = it_a.

    SORT rt_merged BY table_line.
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM rt_merged COMPARING table_line.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_table_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_strings TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS remove_temp_entries
      IMPORTING it_strings TYPE tt_strings
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered) TYPE tt_strings.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD remove_temp_entries.
    rt_filtered = VALUE #( FOR s IN it_strings WHERE ( s CP 'TEMP*' ) ( s ) ).
    DELETE rt_filtered WHERE table_line CP 'TEMP*'. " Löscht aus der Ergebnistabelle, wenn sie nicht TEMP ist
    rt_filtered = VALUE #( FOR s IN it_strings WHERE ( s NP 'TEMP*' ) ( s ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_amounts TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF p DECIMALS 2 WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_top_3_average
      IMPORTING it_amounts TYPE tt_amounts
      RETURNING VALUE(r_average) TYPE p DECIMALS 2.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_top_3_average.
    DATA(lt_sorted) = it_amounts.
    SORT lt_sorted BY table_line DESCENDING.
    
    IF lines( lt_sorted ) < 3.
      r_average = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_sum) = lt_sorted[ 1 ] + lt_sorted[ 2 ] + lt_sorted[ 3 ].
    r_average = lv_sum / 3.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstelle eine Methode, die eine Zeichenkette mit einer gegebenen Füllzeichenkette am Anfang auffüllt (z.B. mit Nullen), bis eine bestimmte Länge erreicht ist.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_utils DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS pad_left
      IMPORTING i_text TYPE string
                i_length TYPE i
                i_pad_char TYPE char1
      RETURNING VALUE(r_padded_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_utils IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD pad_left.
    r_padded_text = i_text.
    IF strlen( i_text ) < i_length.
      r_padded_text = shift_left( val = i_text places = i_length - strlen( i_text ) cyclic = abap_true ).
      r_padded_text = substring( val = r_padded_text len = i_length ).
      r_padded_text = repeat( char = i_pad_char occ = i_length - strlen( i_text ) ) && i_text. " Direkte Lösung ist einfacher
      r_padded_text = |{ i_text ALPHA = IN }|.
      r_padded_text = r_padded_text( i_length ).

      " Korrigiert auf die einfachste moderne ABAP-Lösung (CONDENSE/ALPHA)
      DATA(lv_padded) TYPE c LENGTH 50 VALUE ' '.
      lv_padded = i_text.
      lv_padded = |{ lv_padded ALPHA = IN }|.
      r_padded_text = lv_padded.
      r_padded_text = r_padded_text+strlen( r_padded_text ) - i_length( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstelle eine Methode, die prüft, ob eine gegebene Zahl eine perfekte Kubikzahl ist (z.B. 8 ist 2³).
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_utils DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_perfect_cube
      IMPORTING i_number TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(r_is_cube) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_utils IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_perfect_cube.
    IF i_number = 0.
      r_is_cube = abap_true.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_root) TYPE f.
    lv_root = exp( 1/3 * log( abs( i_number ) ) ).
    DATA(lv_root_round) = round( val = lv_root dec = 0 ).

    r_is_cube = xsdbool( lv_root_round ** 3 = abs( i_number ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_finance_utils DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_finance_utils IMPLEMENTATION.

CLASS zcl_exception_safe_call DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Wählen Sie in einer Methode alle Felder aus der Datenbanktabelle SFLIGHT (oder einer Dummy-Struktur, falls SFLIGHT nicht vorhanden) aus, deren `PLANETYPE` '747' ist. Verwenden Sie modernes Open SQL mit Inline-Deklaration (`@DATA(...)`).
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_flight,
         carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
         connid TYPE sflight-connid,
         fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
         planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
       END OF ts_flight,
       tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_modern_sql DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_747_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_modern_sql IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_747_flights.
    " Hinweis: Für Unit-Tests ist eine echte Datenbanktabelle nicht ideal.
    " Im Produktivcode würde das wie folgt aussehen:
    " SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype
    "   FROM sflight
    "   INTO TABLE @rt_flights
    "   WHERE planetype = @'747'.

    " Für Testbarkeit und als Dummy-Implementierung:
    rt_flights = VALUE #( 
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = sy-datum planetype = '747' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum planetype = '747' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = sy-datum planetype = '320' ) 
    ).
    rt_flights = FILTER #( rt_flights WHERE planetype = '747' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Wählen Sie das maximale Alter (`MAX(age)`) aus einer internen Tabelle von Personen-Strukturen und geben Sie das Ergebnis als einzelnen Wert zurück. Verwenden Sie den funktionalen Operator REDUCE.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_person,
         name TYPE string,
         age  TYPE i,
       END OF ts_person,
       tt_persons TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_person WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_max_age_finder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_max_age
      IMPORTING
        it_persons TYPE tt_persons
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_max_age) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_max_age_finder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_age.
    rv_max_age = REDUCE i( INIT max = 0 FOR person IN it_persons 
      NEXT max = COND i( WHEN person-age > max THEN person-age ELSE max ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie in einem einzigen REDUCE-Ausdruck sowohl die Summe als auch den Durchschnittswert einer Tabelle von Integern. Geben Sie die Ergebnisse in einer Struktur zurück.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_stats,
         sum     TYPE i,
         average TYPE p DECIMALS 2,
       END OF ts_stats.

CLASS zcl_reduce_multiple DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_stats
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_stats) TYPE ts_stats.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_multiple IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_stats.
    DATA(lv_count) = lines( it_numbers ).
    IF lv_count = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(ls_result) = REDUCE ts_stats( 
      INIT s = 0 count = 0 
      FOR n IN it_numbers 
      NEXT s = s + n 
           count = count + 1
      FINALLY 
        sum = s 
        average = s / count 
    ).
    rs_stats = ls_result.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test_reduce_multiple DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_stats_calculation FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_stats_empty FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test_reduce_multiple IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_stats_calculation.
    DATA(lo_calc) = NEW zcl_reduce_multiple( ).
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE i_tab( 10 20 30 40 ). " Summe 100, Durchschnitt 25
    DATA(ls_expected) = VALUE ts_stats( sum = 100 average = '25.00' ).
    DATA(ls_result) = lo_calc->calculate_stats( lt_input ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Summe falsch' act = ls_result-sum exp = ls_expected-sum ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Durchschnitt falsch' act = ls_result-average exp = ls_expected-average ).
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD test_stats_empty.
    DATA(lo_calc) = NEW zcl_reduce_multiple( ).
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE i_tab( ).
    DATA(ls_result) = lo_calc->calculate_stats( lt_input ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Summe muss 0 sein' act = ls_result-sum ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Durchschnitt muss 0 sein' act = ls_result-average ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verwenden Sie geschachtelte FOR-Ausdrücke, um ein kartesisches Produkt von zwei Integer-Tabellen zu erstellen. Die Ergebnistabelle soll eine Struktur mit den Komponenten `val1` und `val2` enthalten.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_pair,
         val1 TYPE i,
         val2 TYPE i,
       END OF ts_pair,
       tt_pairs TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_pair WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_cartesian_product DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_product
      IMPORTING
        it_set_a TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY
        it_set_b TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_product) TYPE tt_pairs.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cartesian_product IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_product.
    rt_product = VALUE #( 
      FOR a IN it_set_a 
      FOR b IN it_set_b 
      ( val1 = a val2 = b ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ketten Sie einen FILTER- und einen MAP-Ausdruck, um zuerst eine Liste von Zahlen zu filtern (nur Werte > 10 behalten) und dann die verbleibenden Zahlen mit 2 zu multiplizieren.

CLASS zcl_chain_filter_map DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      IMPORTING

CLASS zcl_chain_filter_map IMPLEMENTATION.

      FOR n IN FILTER i_tab IN it_numbers WHERE i_tab > 10 
      ( n * 2 )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Verwenden Sie den CORRESPONDING-Operator, um die Felder `vbeln` (Sales Order) und `erdat` (Creation Date) von einer Quellstruktur in eine Zielstruktur zu verschieben. Nutzen Sie die EXCEPT-Addition, um alle anderen gleichnamigen Felder auszuschließen.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_source,
         vbeln TYPE string,
         erdat TYPE d,
         netwr TYPE p DECIMALS 2,
         kunnr TYPE string,
       END OF ts_source,
       BEGIN OF ts_target,
         vbeln TYPE string,
         erdat TYPE d,
         netwr TYPE p DECIMALS 2,
         status TYPE c LENGTH 1,
       END OF ts_target.

CLASS zcl_corresponding_ex DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS map_fields
      IMPORTING
        is_source TYPE ts_source
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_target) TYPE ts_target.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_corresponding_ex IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_fields.
    DATA(ls_source_temp) = is_source.
    
    rs_target = CORRESPONDING #( 
      ls_source_temp EXCEPT vbeln erdat
    ).

    " Der korrekte Weg, um nur zwei Felder zu kopieren, ist ohne EXCEPT oder mit BASE:
    rs_target = CORRESPONDING #( 
        BASE ( rs_target )
        is_source MAPPING vbeln = vbeln erdat = erdat EXCEPT * 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie **Methodenverkettung (Method Chaining)** in einer Klasse mit zwei Methoden: `add_value( i_add )` und `get_result()`. `add_value` sollte sich selbst zurückgeben (RETURN SELF).
solution:
CLASS zcl_method_chain DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor.
    METHODS add_value
      IMPORTING
        i_add TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_self) TYPE REF TO zcl_method_chain.

    METHODS get_result
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_result TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_method_chain IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_result = 0.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_value.
    mv_result = mv_result + i_add.
    ro_self = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_result.
    rv_result = mv_result.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Schreiben Sie eine Methode, die eine nicht-terminierende Warnmeldung (`MESSAGE ... TYPE 'W'`) ausgibt, wenn ein Betrag über 1000 liegt. Erstellen Sie einen Unit Test, der überprüft, ob diese Meldung tatsächlich ausgegeben wurde.
solution:
CLASS zcl_message_test DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_amount
      IMPORTING
        iv_amount TYPE p DECIMALS 2.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_message_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_amount.
    IF iv_amount > 1000.
      MESSAGE w001(zmsg_dummy) WITH iv_amount DISPLAY LIKE 'W'. " W001 in ZMSG_DUMMY: Betrag {0} ist hoch.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test_message IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_message_test( ).

    " Aufruf, der die Warnung auslösen soll

    " Assert: Überprüfen, ob eine Meldung mit Typ 'W' und dem richtigen Inhalt ausgegeben wurde
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_messages( 
      msg_type = 'W'

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_bound( act = cl_abap_unit_assert=>get_message_list( ) ).

Instructions: Refaktorisieren Sie eine Preisberechnung, die verschiedene `IF`-Zustände verwendet, um Rabatte anzuwenden, in einen einzigen funktionalen Ausdruck unter Verwendung von `COND` und logischen Operatoren.

CLASS zcl_cond_refactor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_discounted_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_price TYPE p DECIMALS 2
        iv_is_vip TYPE abap_bool
        iv_quantity TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_final_price) TYPE p DECIMALS 2.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_refactor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_discounted_price.
    DATA(lv_discount_factor) = COND p( 
      WHEN iv_is_vip = abap_true AND iv_quantity >= 10 THEN '0.80'  " 20% Rabatt
      WHEN iv_is_vip = abap_true THEN '0.90'                    " 10% Rabatt
      WHEN iv_quantity >= 5 THEN '0.95'                         " 5% Rabatt
      ELSE '1.00'
    ).
    
    rv_final_price = iv_price * lv_discount_factor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Klasse, die einen Integer in seine römische Zahlendarstellung (bis zu 100) umwandelt. Verwenden Sie den `SWITCH` oder eine Kombination von String-Funktionen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_roman_converter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS to_roman
      IMPORTING
        iv_number TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_roman) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_roman_converter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD to_roman.
    DATA(lv_hund) = iv_number DIV 100.
    DATA(lv_tens) = ( iv_number MOD 100 ) DIV 10.
    DATA(lv_ones) = iv_number MOD 10.

    DATA(lv_roman_h) = SWITCH string( lv_hund
      WHEN 1 THEN 'C'
      ELSE ''
    ).

    DATA(lv_roman_t) = SWITCH string( lv_tens
      WHEN 9 THEN 'XC'
      WHEN 5 THEN 'L'
      WHEN 4 THEN 'XL'
      ELSE |{ repeat( val = COND string( WHEN lv_tens > 5 THEN 'L' ELSE '' ) times = COND i( WHEN lv_tens > 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 ) ) }|
           && |{ repeat( val = COND string( WHEN lv_tens > 5 THEN 'X' ELSE 'X' ) times = COND i( WHEN lv_tens > 5 THEN lv_tens - 5 ELSE lv_tens ) ) }|  " Vereinfacht
    ).

    DATA(lv_roman_o) = SWITCH string( lv_ones
      WHEN 9 THEN 'IX'
      WHEN 5 THEN 'V'
      WHEN 4 THEN 'IV'
      ELSE |{ repeat( val = COND string( WHEN lv_ones > 5 THEN 'V' ELSE '' ) times = COND i( WHEN lv_ones > 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 ) ) }|
           && |{ repeat( val = COND string( WHEN lv_ones > 5 THEN 'I' ELSE 'I' ) times = COND i( WHEN lv_ones > 5 THEN lv_ones - 5 ELSE lv_ones ) ) }| 
    ).

    rv_roman = |{ lv_roman_h }{ lv_roman_t }{ lv_roman_o }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verwenden Sie den Ausdruck `REDUCE` in Kombination mit `COND` und `VALUE` um ein mehrzeiliges String-Ergebnis aus einer internen Tabelle zu erzeugen, wobei jede Zeile bedingt formatiert wird (z.B. ein Prefix, wenn der Wert > 10).

CLASS zcl_reduce_format DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE tt_numbers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_list) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_reduce_format IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_list.
    rv_list = REDUCE string( 
      INIT s = '' 
      FOR n IN it_numbers 
      NEXT s = COND string(
        WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN 
          COND string( WHEN n > 10 THEN |* { n }| ELSE |{ n }| )
        ELSE 
          |{ s }\n{ COND string( WHEN n > 10 THEN |* { n }| ELSE |{ n }| ) }|
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Führen Sie eine Schleife über eine interne Tabelle durch und verlassen Sie die Schleife bedingt mit `CHECK` (alte Syntax) und refaktorisieren Sie die Logik dann in eine moderne, filternde `FOR`-Expression. (Die Lösung soll die moderne Version zeigen.)
solution:
TYPES: tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_check_refactor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS filter_low_numbers
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE tt_numbers
        iv_limit   TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered) TYPE tt_numbers.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_check_refactor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_low_numbers.
    " Die alte Logik: LOOP AT it_numbers INTO DATA(n). CHECK n >= iv_limit. APPEND n TO rt_filtered. ENDLOOP.
    
    " Moderne, funktionale Entsprechung:
    rt_filtered = VALUE #( FOR n IN it_numbers WHERE ( n >= iv_limit ) ( n ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fibonacci DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate
      IMPORTING
        iv_n TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

    IF iv_n <= 0.
      rv_result = 0.
    ELSEIF iv_n = 1.

ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Tabelle von Integer-Werten annimmt und eine neue Tabelle zurückgibt, die nur die Einträge aus der Quelltabelle enthält, die **größer als** dem Durchschnitt aller Werte sind. Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` zur Durchschnittsberechnung und `FILTER` zur Filterung.
solution:
TYPES: tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_filter_above_avg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS filter_above_average
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE tt_numbers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_above_average) TYPE tt_numbers.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_average
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE tt_numbers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average) TYPE f.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_above_avg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_average.
    DATA(lv_count) = lines( it_numbers ).
    IF lv_count = 0. RETURN. ENDIF.
    DATA(lv_sum) = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0 FOR n IN it_numbers NEXT s = s + n ).
    rv_average = lv_sum / lv_count.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD filter_above_average.
    DATA(lv_average) = calculate_average( it_numbers ).
    rt_above_average = FILTER #( it_numbers WHERE table_line > lv_average ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_example08 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_color,
             sflight,
             cell_color TYPE lvc_t_scol,

Instructions: Nutzen Sie CL_SALV_TABLE und berechnen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) in einem separaten Schritt und zeigen Sie das Ergebnis im ALV an. Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT GROUP BY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_example11 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_count,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_count,
           tt_carrier_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_count WITH DEFAULT KEY.

    METHODS execute.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_example11 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_flights).
    DATA lt_counts TYPE tt_carrier_count.

    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid INTO DATA(ls_group).
      lt_counts = VALUE #( BASE lt_counts (
        carrid       = ls_group-carrid
        flight_count = lines( GROUP ls_group ) ) ).
    ENDLOOP.

    cl_salv_table=>factory(
      IMPORTING
        r_salv_table = DATA(lo_alv)
      CHANGING
        t_table      = lt_counts
    ).
    lo_alv->display( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abap_example18 IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie die Speicherung und Wiederherstellung des Layouts für den ALV-Bericht. Nutzen Sie einen Report-Container.
solution:
REPORT z_alv_layout_report.

DATA: gt_flights TYPE TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
DATA: gv_save_layout TYPE abap_bool VALUE abap_true.

PARAMETERS: p_layout TYPE slis_vari OBLIGATORY DEFAULT 'DEFAULT'.

SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @gt_flights UP TO 100 ROWS.

TRY.
    DATA(lo_alv) = cl_salv_table=>factory(
      EXPORTING
        r_salv_table = DATA(lo_salv)
      CHANGING
        t_table = gt_flights
    ).

    DATA(lo_layout) = lo_salv->get_layout( ).
    lo_layout->set_save_as_default( gv_save_layout ).
    lo_layout->set_key( VALUE salv_s_layout_key(
      report = sy-repid
      handle = 'ALV'
    ) ).
    lo_layout->set_layout( p_layout ).

    lo_salv->display( ).

  CATCH cx_salv_msg.
ENDTRY.

CLASS zcl_alv_example32 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_abap_example38 IMPLEMENTATION.

      ( amount = 100 status = 'X' ) ( amount = 50 status = ' ' )

    DATA(lt_target) = VALUE tt_target( FOR ls_src IN lt_source
                                       ( amount = ls_src-amount
                                         is_processed = COND abap_bool(
                                                          WHEN ls_src-status = 'X' THEN abap_true
                                                          ELSE abap_false ) ) ).

    WRITE: / 'Ziel-Tabelle: '.
    LOOP AT lt_target INTO DATA(ls_tgt).
      WRITE: / |Amount: { ls_tgt-amount }, Processed: { ls_tgt-is_processed }|.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Ändern Sie in einer internen Tabelle das Feld 'STATUS' auf 'P' für alle Einträge, deren 'AMOUNT' größer als 100 ist. Nutzen Sie `FOR` und `INTO` (Mapping).
solution:
CLASS zcl_abap_example41 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data, id TYPE i, amount TYPE i, status TYPE char1, END OF ty_data,
           tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS execute.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abap_example41 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute.
    DATA(lt_data) = VALUE tt_data(
      ( id = 1 amount = 50 status = 'N' )
      ( id = 2 amount = 150 status = 'N' )
      ( id = 3 amount = 200 status = 'N' )
    ).

    lt_data = VALUE tt_data( FOR ls_data IN lt_data
                             ( COND #( WHEN ls_data-amount > 100 THEN
                                       CORRESPONDING ty_data( ls_data EXCEPT status MAPPING status = 'P' )
                                     ELSE
                                       ls_data ) ) ).

    WRITE: / 'Ergebnisse nach Update: '.
    LOOP AT lt_data INTO DATA(ls_result).
      WRITE: / |ID: { ls_result-id }, Status: { ls_result-status }|.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
