Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die die Zeilen des ALV farblich hervorhebt: grün für Flüge mit 'SEATSOCC' > 300, sonst rot. Prüfen Sie die Farblogik mit `COND`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_example11 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_color,
             sflight,
             cell_color TYPE lvc_t_scol,
           END OF ty_flight_color,
           tt_flight_color TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_color WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS execute.
    METHODS get_colored_flights
      IMPORTING iv_seatsocc TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_flight_color.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_example11 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_colored_flights.
    DATA ls_sflight TYPE sflight.
    ls_sflight-seatsocc = iv_seatsocc.

    rs_flight = VALUE #( sflight = ls_sflight
        cell_color = VALUE lvc_t_scol(
          ( fname = 'SEATSOCC'
            color = COND #( WHEN iv_seatsocc > 300
                              THEN 'C510' " Grün
                              ELSE 'C610' " Rot
                           ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD execute.
    DATA(lt_data) = VALUE tt_flight_color(
      ( get_colored_flights( 400 ) ) ( get_colored_flights( 100 ) ) ).
    cl_salv_table=>factory( IMPORTING r_salv_table = DATA(lo_alv) CHANGING t_table = lt_data ).
    lo_alv->get_columns( )->get_column( 'CELL_COLOR' )->set_technical( abap_true ).
    lo_alv->display( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_color_logic FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_color_logic.
    DATA(lo_example) = NEW zcl_alv_example11( ).
    DATA(ls_green) = lo_example->get_colored_flights( 450 ).
    DATA(ls_red) = lo_example->get_colored_flights( 250 ).

    DATA(lv_green_color) = ls_green-cell_color[ 1 ]-color.
    DATA(lv_red_color) = ls_red-cell_color[ 1 ]-color.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(

CLASS zcl_abap_example13 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS combine_words
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_combined) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_abap_example13 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD combine_words.
    DATA(lt_words) = VALUE string_table(
      ( 'Modern' ) ( 'ABAP' ) ( 'Code' ) ( 'Optimization' )

    rv_combined = REDUCE string(
      INIT result = ''
      FOR lv_word IN lt_words

CLASS zcl_abap_example14 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item, price TYPE p DECIMALS 2, END OF ty_item,
           tt_item TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS calculate_total
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_total) TYPE p DECIMALS 2.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abap_example14 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total.
    DATA(lt_items) = VALUE tt_item(
      ( price = '10.50' )
      ( price = '20.00' )
      ( price = '5.25' )

    rv_total = REDUCE p DECIMALS 2(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR ls_item IN lt_items
      NEXT sum = sum + ls_item-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_example21 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      WHEN iv_free_seats < 50 THEN icon_led_red

    ).

  METHOD execute.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE sflight_tab( FOR i = 1 UP TO 5 (

solution:
CLASS zcl_abap_example26 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data, id TYPE i, END OF ty_data,
           tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS remove_duplicates
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_unique) TYPE tt_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abap_example26 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD remove_duplicates.
    DATA(lt_with_dups) = VALUE tt_data(
      ( id = 1 ) ( id = 2 ) ( id = 1 ) ( id = 3 ) ( id = 2 ) ( id = 4 )
    ).

      IMPORTING iv_id TYPE i

CLASS zcl_abap_example28 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_line_exists.
    DATA(lt_data) = VALUE tt_data(

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Ändern Sie in einer internen Tabelle das Feld 'STATUS' auf 'P' für alle Einträge, deren 'AMOUNT' größer als 100 ist. Nutzen Sie `FOR` und `COND` für das Mapping. Prüfen Sie die Aktualisierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_abap_example36 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data, id TYPE i, amount TYPE i, status TYPE char1, END OF ty_data,
           tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS update_status
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_data) TYPE tt_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abap_example36 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_status.
    DATA(lt_data) = VALUE tt_data(
      ( id = 1 amount = 50 status = 'N' )
      ( id = 2 amount = 150 status = 'N' )
      ( id = 3 amount = 200 status = 'N' )
    ).

    rt_data = VALUE tt_data( FOR ls_data IN lt_data
                             ( COND #( WHEN ls_data-amount > 100 THEN
                                       CORRESPONDING ty_data( ls_data EXCEPT status MAPPING status = 'P' )
                                     ELSE
                                       ls_data ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Addieren Sie alle geraden Zahlen in einer internen Tabelle (Typ I) unter Verwendung des `REDUCE` Ausdrucks mit einer Inline-`COND`-Bedingung.

CLASS zcl_abap_reduce01 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_sum
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abap_reduce01 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sum.
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY(
      ( 1 ) ( 2 ) ( 3 ) ( 4 ) ( 5 ) ( 6 )
    ).

    rv_sum = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR lv_num IN lt_numbers
      NEXT sum = sum + COND #( WHEN lv_num MOD 2 = 0 THEN lv_num ELSE 0 ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_abap_reduce03 IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lt_prices) = VALUE tt_price(

CLASS zcl_abap_substring05 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      IMPORTING iv_input TYPE string

CLASS zcl_abap_substring05 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_middle_part.
    DATA(lv_first_semi) = find(
      val = iv_input
      sub = ';'
      off = 0
    ).

    DATA(lv_second_semi) = find(
      val = iv_input
      sub = ';'
      off = lv_first_semi + 1

      rv_output = substring(
        val = iv_input
        off = lv_first_semi + 1
        len = lv_second_semi - lv_first_semi - 1

    ELSE.
      rv_output = 'Separator not found'.

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Lösen Sie einen String an allen nicht-alphanumerischen Zeichen (außer Leerzeichen) auf und geben Sie die Segmente in einer Tabelle zurück. Nutzen Sie `REPLACE REGEX` gefolgt von `SPLIT`.

CLASS zcl_abap_regex09 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS tokenize_string
      IMPORTING iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_tokens) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abap_regex09 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD tokenize_string.
    " Alle nicht-alphanumerischen Zeichen (außer Leerzeichen) durch einheitliches Trennzeichen '|' ersetzen
    DATA(lv_processed) = replace_regex(
      val = iv_input
      regex = `[^a-zA-Z0-9\s]`
      with = '|'
    ).
    " Den String anhand des Trennzeichens splitten
    SPLIT lv_processed AT '|' INTO TABLE rt_tokens.

    " Leere Token entfernen, die durch aufeinanderfolgende Trennzeichen entstehen können
    DELETE rt_tokens WHERE table_line IS INITIAL.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abap_reduce10 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_transformed_sum
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abap_reduce10 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_transformed_sum.
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY(
      ( 1 ) ( 5 ) ( 10 ) ( 20 ) 
    ).

    " Filter: Nur Zahlen > 5 behalten (10, 20)
    " Transformation: (10 * 10) + (20 * 10) = 100 + 200 = 300
    rv_sum = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR lv_num IN lt_numbers WHERE ( lv_num > 5 )
      NEXT sum = sum + ( lv_num * 10 )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Hash-Tabelle aus einer Standardtabelle, gruppiert nach dem ersten Buchstaben des Wertes, mithilfe des `REDUCE` Ausdrucks.

CLASS zcl_abap_reduce13 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item, value TYPE string, END OF ty_item,
           tt_standard TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY,
           BEGIN OF ty_group, key TYPE char1, values TYPE string_table, END OF ty_group,
           tt_hash TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_group WITH UNIQUE KEY key.
    METHODS group_by_first_char
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_hash) TYPE tt_hash.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abap_reduce13 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_by_first_char.
    DATA(lt_items) = VALUE tt_standard(
      ( 'Apple' ) ( 'Banana' ) ( 'Apricot' ) ( 'Cherry' )
    ).

    rt_hash = REDUCE tt_hash(
      INIT groups = VALUE tt_hash( )
      FOR ls_item IN lt_items
      NEXT groups = VALUE tt_hash( groups
                      ( key = substring( ls_item-value, 0, 1 )
                        values = VALUE string_table( groups[ key = substring( ls_item-value, 0, 1 ) ]-values
                                                     ( ls_item-value ) ) )
                      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      msg = 'Expected 3 groups (A, B, C).'

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(

CLASS zcl_abap_reduce20 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS find_index_of_max
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_index) TYPE i.

CLASS zcl_abap_reduce20 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_index_of_max.
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY(
      ( 10 ) ( 50 ) ( 20 ) ( 80 ) ( 30 )
    ).

    rv_index = REDUCE i(
      INIT max_val = 0 index = 0 current_index = 0
      FOR lv_num IN lt_numbers
      NEXT current_index = current_index + 1
           max_val = COND #( WHEN lv_num > max_val THEN lv_num ELSE max_val )
           index = COND #( WHEN lv_num > max_val THEN current_index ELSE index )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abap_regex23 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      IMPORTING iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_numbers) TYPE string_table.

CLASS zcl_abap_regex23 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_phone_numbers.
    DATA(lv_pattern) = `\d{3}-\d{3}`.
    DATA(lv_text) = iv_input.

    FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX lv_pattern IN lv_text MATCH OFFSET AND LENGTH

      FOR ls_match IN lt_matches

          len = ls_match-length
        ) )
    ).

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie den Teilstring, der sich zwischen den Zeichen '/' und ':' befindet (z.B. '/DATA:VALUE' -> 'DATA') mithilfe von `find` und `substring`.

CLASS zcl_abap_substring34 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_between_delimiters
      IMPORTING iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abap_substring34 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_between_delimiters.
    DATA(lv_start) = find( val = iv_input sub = '/' ).
    DATA(lv_end) = find( val = iv_input sub = ':' ).

    IF lv_start <> -1 AND lv_end <> -1 AND lv_end > lv_start.
      rv_output = substring(
        val = iv_input
        off = lv_start + 1
        len = lv_end - lv_start - 1
      ).
    ELSE.
      rv_output = 'Not found'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abap_for35 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    METHODS filter_and_transform
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_transformed) TYPE tt_i.

CLASS zcl_abap_for35 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_and_transform.
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE tt_i(
      ( 10 ) ( -5 ) ( 20 ) ( -3 ) ( 5 )

    rt_transformed = VALUE tt_i(

CLASS zcl_abap_reduce01 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_sum
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.

CLASS zcl_abap_reduce01 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sum.
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY(
      ( 1 ) ( 2 ) ( 3 ) ( 4 ) ( 5 ) ( 6 )

    rv_sum = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0

      INIT result = VALUE tt_key_value( )
      FOR ls_item IN lt_data

    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_abap_regex48 IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lv_pattern) = `\d+`.

Instructions:
Sorting an array is a fundamental operation in programming that organizes data in a specified order (ascending or descending). Sorting algorithms vary in efficiency, and choosing the right one can greatly affect performance.

Instructions
Your task is to implement a simple bubble sort algorithm to sort an array of integers in ascending order.

Some examples:

Sort the array [5, 2, 9, 1, 5, 6], which should return [1, 2, 5, 5, 6, 9].
Sort the array [3, 0, 2, 5, -1, 4, 1], which should return [-1, 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5].
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorting DEFINITION PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS bubble_sort
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sorted) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorting IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD bubble_sort.
    DATA: lv_temp TYPE i,
          lv_len TYPE i.
    lv_len = lines( it_numbers ).
    LOOP AT it_numbers INTO DATA(lv_current).
      LOOP AT it_numbers INTO DATA(lv_next) FROM sy-index + 1.
        IF lv_current > lv_next.
          lv_temp = lv_current.
          lv_current = lv_next.
          lv_next = lv_temp.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND lv_current TO rt_sorted.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

Instructions:
Calculating the Fibonacci sequence is a common algorithmic task. The Fibonacci sequence is a series of numbers where each number is the sum of the two preceding ones, usually starting with 0 and 1.

Instructions
Your task is to compute the nth Fibonacci number.

Some examples:

Calculate the 5th Fibonacci number, which should return 5.
Calculate the 10th Fibonacci number, which should return 55.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fibonacci DEFINITION PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_fibonacci
      IMPORTING
        input TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(result) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fibonacci IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD calculate_fibonacci.
    DATA: lv_a TYPE i VALUE 0,
          lv_b TYPE i VALUE 1,
          lv_temp TYPE i.
    IF input = 0.
      result = lv_a.
      RETURN.
    ELSEIF input = 1.
      result = lv_b.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.
    LOOP AT 2 TO input.
      lv_temp = lv_b.
      lv_b = lv_a + lv_b.
      lv_a = lv_temp.
    ENDLOOP.
    result = lv_b.
  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

Table B: Customer ID: 1, Address: '123 Main St'.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_join DEFINITION PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS join_customer_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_join IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD join_customer_data.
    DATA: lt_customers TYPE TABLE OF string,
          lt_addresses TYPE TABLE OF string,
          lt_combined TYPE TABLE OF string.

    APPEND VALUE #( '1', 'Alice' ) TO lt_customers.
    APPEND VALUE #( '1', '123 Main St' ) TO lt_addresses.

    LOOP AT lt_customers INTO DATA(customer).
      READ TABLE lt_addresses INTO DATA(address) WITH KEY customer_id = customer-id.
      APPEND VALUE #( customer-id = customer-id name = customer-name address = address ) TO lt_combined.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

          lt_result TYPE TABLE OF ty_combined,
          ls_result TYPE ty_combined.

CLASS zcl_opensql_example1 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute.
    DATA: lt_records TYPE TABLE OF your_table,
          lv_output  TYPE string.

    SELECT * FROM your_table INTO TABLE lt_records.

CLASS zcl_logical_expression_example5 DEFINITION.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS execute.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_logical_expression_example5 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute.
    DATA: lv_condition1 TYPE abap_bool VALUE abap_true,
          lv_condition2 TYPE abap_bool VALUE abap_false,
          lv_condition3 TYPE abap_bool VALUE abap_true,

Instructions: Calculate the factorial of numbers using a WHILE loop.
solution:
CLASS zcl_internal_table_example74 DEFINITION.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS execute.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_internal_table_example74 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute.
    DATA: lt_numbers TYPE TABLE OF i,
          lv_factorial TYPE i VALUE 1,
          lv_number TYPE i.

    APPEND 3 TO lt_numbers.
    APPEND 4 TO lt_numbers.

    LOOP AT lt_numbers INTO lv_number.
      DATA(lv_temp) = lv_number.
      WHILE lv_temp > 1.
        lv_factorial = lv_factorial * lv_temp.
        lv_temp = lv_temp - 1.
      ENDWHILE.
      WRITE: / 'Factorial of', lv_number, 'is', lv_factorial.
      lv_factorial = 1.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_internal_table_example75 DEFINITION.

    METHODS execute.

CLASS zcl_internal_table_example75 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute.
    DATA: lt_scores TYPE TABLE OF i,
          lv_median TYPE f,
          lv_index TYPE i,
          lv_size TYPE i.

    APPEND 70 TO lt_scores.
    APPEND 80 TO lt_scores.
    APPEND 90 TO lt_scores.

    SORT lt_scores.
    lv_size = lines( lt_scores ).
    IF lv_size MOD 2 = 0.
      lv_median = ( lt_scores[ lv_size / 2 ] + lt_scores[ lv_size / 2 + 1 ] ) / 2.
    ELSE.
      lv_median = lt_scores[ (lv_size + 1) / 2 ].
    ENDIF.
    WRITE: / 'Median score is:', lv_median.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_oo_example19 DEFINITION.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS add_score IMPORTING iv_score TYPE i,
             calculate_average RETURNING VALUE(rv_average) TYPE f.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA: lt_scores TYPE TABLE OF i,
          lv_total TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_oo_example19 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_score.
    APPEND iv_score TO lt_scores.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD calculate_average.
    LOOP AT lt_scores INTO DATA(lv_score).
      lv_total = lv_total + lv_score.
    ENDLOOP.
    rv_average = lv_total / lines( lt_scores ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    lo_example->add_score( 90 ).
    lo_example->add_score( 95 ).
    DATA(lv_average) = lo_example->calculate_average( ).

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_invalid_input DEFINITION INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_t100_message.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_message TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_invalid_input IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    super->constructor( iv_message ).
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_input_handler DEFINITION.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS handle_input IMPORTING iv_input TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_input_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD handle_input.
    IF iv_input IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_invalid_input
        EXPORTING
          iv_message = 'Input cannot be empty!'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS zcl_input_handler_test DEFINITION.
  FINAL
  FOR TESTING
  RISK LEVEL HARMLESS.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA(lo_handler) TYPE REF TO zcl_input_handler.
  METHODS setup.
  METHODS test_invalid_input FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_input_handler_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD setup.
    lo_handler = NEW zcl_input_handler( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_input.
    TRY.
        lo_handler->handle_input( '' ).
      CATCH zcx_invalid_input INTO DATA(lx_invalid).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lx_invalid->get_text( ) exp = 'Input cannot be empty!').
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_account DEFINITION.

  PRIVATE SECTION.

  METHOD withdraw.
    IF mv_balance < iv_amount.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_insufficient_funds

    ELSE.
      mv_balance = mv_balance - iv_amount.

Instructions: Use a FOR loop to sum even numbers in an internal table.

CLASS zcl_internal_table_example1 DEFINITION.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS execute.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_internal_table_example1 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute.
    DATA: lt_numbers TYPE TABLE OF i,
          lv_sum TYPE i VALUE 0.

    APPEND 1 TO lt_numbers.
    APPEND 2 TO lt_numbers.
    APPEND 3 TO lt_numbers.
    APPEND 4 TO lt_numbers.
    APPEND 5 TO lt_numbers.

    LOOP AT lt_numbers INTO DATA(lv_number).
      IF lv_number MOD 2 = 0.
        lv_sum = lv_sum + lv_number.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    WRITE: / 'Sum of even numbers:', lv_sum.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Use a WHILE loop to calculate the factorial of a number stored in an internal table.
solution:
CLASS zcl_internal_table_example2 DEFINITION.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS execute.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_internal_table_example2 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute.
    DATA: lt_numbers TYPE TABLE OF i,
          lv_factorial TYPE i,
          lv_index TYPE i.

    APPEND 5 TO lt_numbers.

    LOOP AT lt_numbers INTO DATA(lv_number).
      lv_index = 1.
      lv_factorial = 1.
      WHILE lv_index <= lv_number.
        lv_factorial = lv_factorial * lv_index.
        lv_index = lv_index + 1.
      ENDWHILE.
      WRITE: / 'Factorial of', lv_number, 'is', lv_factorial.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie eine Tabelle von Verkäufen nach Produkt-ID (`PRODUCT_ID`) und zählen Sie die Anzahl der Verkäufe pro Produkt. Nutzen Sie `FOR GROUPS OF` und `COUNT(*) IN GROUP`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_abap_group01 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sale, product_id TYPE char10, amount TYPE p DECIMALS 2, END OF ty_sale,
           tt_sales TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sale WITH EMPTY KEY,
           BEGIN OF ty_result, product_id TYPE char10, count TYPE i, END OF ty_result,
           tt_result TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_result WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS group_and_count
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abap_group01 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_and_count.
    DATA(lt_sales) = VALUE tt_sales(
      ( product_id = 'P001' amount = '10.00' ) ( product_id = 'P002' amount = '20.00' )
      ( product_id = 'P001' amount = '15.00' ) ( product_id = 'P003' amount = '5.00' )
      ( product_id = 'P002' amount = '25.00' ) ( product_id = 'P001' amount = '30.00' )
    ).

    rt_result = VALUE tt_result(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_group IN lt_sales
      GROUP BY ( product_id = ls_group-product_id )
      ( product_id = ls_group-product_id
        count = COUNT( * ) IN GROUP )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie eine Tabelle von Mitarbeitern nach Land (`COUNTRY`) und berechnen Sie die Summe der Gehälter (`SALARY`) pro Land. Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` innerhalb der Gruppe.

CLASS zcl_abap_group02 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_employee, country TYPE char2, salary TYPE p DECIMALS 2, END OF ty_employee,
           tt_employees TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_employee WITH EMPTY KEY,
           BEGIN OF ty_result, country TYPE char2, total_salary TYPE p DECIMALS 2, END OF ty_result,
           tt_result TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_result WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS group_and_sum_salary
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abap_group02 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_and_sum_salary.
    DATA(lt_employees) = VALUE tt_employees(
      ( country = 'DE' salary = '50000.00' ) ( country = 'US' salary = '70000.00' )
      ( country = 'DE' salary = '60000.00' ) ( country = 'FR' salary = '45000.00' )
    ).

    rt_result = VALUE tt_result(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_group IN lt_employees
      GROUP BY ( country = ls_group-country )
      ( country = ls_group-country
        total_salary = REDUCE p DECIMALS 2(
                         INIT sum = 0
                         FOR ls_member IN GROUP ls_group
                         NEXT sum = sum + ls_member-salary )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abap_group03 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_transaction, date TYPE d, id TYPE i, END OF ty_transaction,

CLASS zcl_abap_group03 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_with_having.
    DATA(lt_transactions) = VALUE tt_transactions(
      FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 WHILE i <= 15
      ( date = '20230101' id = i )
      FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 WHILE i <= 5
      ( date = '20230102' id = i )
      FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 WHILE i <= 12
      ( date = '20230103' id = i )
    ).

    rt_result = VALUE tt_result(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_group IN lt_transactions
      GROUP BY ( date = ls_group-date )
      HAVING COUNT( * ) IN GROUP > 10
      ( date = ls_group-date
        count = COUNT( * ) IN GROUP )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie eine Tabelle von Wörtern nach der Wortlänge (`STRLEN`) und verketten Sie alle Wörter jeder Gruppe zu einem kommagetrennten String. Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` zur Verkettung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_abap_group04 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_word_len, length TYPE i, words TYPE string, END OF ty_word_len,
           tt_result TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_word_len WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS group_by_length
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abap_group04 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_by_length.
    DATA(lt_words) = VALUE string_table(
      ( 'ABAP' ) ( 'Code' ) ( 'Modern' ) ( 'SAP' ) ( 'Expr' )
    ).

    rt_result = VALUE tt_result(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_group IN lt_words
      GROUP BY ( len = strlen( ls_group ) )
      ( length = strlen( ls_group )
        words = REDUCE string(
                  INIT result = ''
                  FOR lv_word IN GROUP ls_group
                  NEXT result = COND #( WHEN result IS INITIAL THEN lv_word ELSE |{ result }, { lv_word }| ) )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abap_group11 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_by_sign_avg.
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY(
      ( 10 ) ( -20 ) ( 30 ) ( -40 ) ( 50 )

CLASS zcl_abap_group15 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_names TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY,
           BEGIN OF ty_result, initial TYPE char1, names TYPE string, END OF ty_result,
           tt_result TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_result WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS group_and_limit_members
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abap_group15 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_and_limit_members.
    DATA(lt_names) = VALUE tt_names(
      ( 'Apple' ) ( 'Apricot' ) ( 'Avocado' ) ( 'Banana' ) ( 'Berry' )
    ).

    rt_result = VALUE tt_result(
      FOR GROUPS OF lv_group IN lt_names
      GROUP BY ( initial = substring( lv_group, 0, 1 ) )
      ( initial = KEY initial OF GROUP lv_group
        names = REDUCE string(
                  INIT result = '' index = 0
                  FOR lv_word IN GROUP lv_group
                  NEXT index = index + 1
                  NEXT result = COND #( WHEN index <= 2 AND result IS INITIAL THEN lv_word
                                        WHEN index <= 2 THEN |{ result } & { lv_word }|
                                        ELSE result ) )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    ).

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie eine Tabelle von Dezimalzahlen (Typ P) nach dem Ganzzahlteil der Zahl und berechnen Sie die Summe der Dezimalstellen jeder Zahl pro Gruppe. Verwenden Sie `TRUNC` und `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_abap_group21 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_num, value TYPE p DECIMALS 2, END OF ty_num,
           tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_num WITH EMPTY KEY,
           BEGIN OF ty_result, integer_part TYPE p DECIMALS 0, total_fraction TYPE p DECIMALS 2, END OF ty_result,
           tt_result TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_result WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS group_by_integer_part
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abap_group21 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_by_integer_part.
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE tt_numbers(
      ( value = '10.50' ) ( value = '20.25' ) ( value = '10.15' ) ( value = '20.75' )
    ).

    rt_result = VALUE tt_result(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_group IN lt_numbers
      GROUP BY ( integer_part = trunc( ls_group-value ) )
      ( integer_part = KEY integer_part OF GROUP ls_group
        total_fraction = REDUCE p DECIMALS 2(
                           INIT total = 0
                           FOR ls_member IN GROUP ls_group
                           NEXT total = total + ( ls_member-value - trunc( ls_member-value ) ) )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = 2 act = lines( lt_result ) ).
    " 10: (0.50 + 0.15) = 0.65
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = '0.65' act = lt_result[ integer_part = 10 ]-total_fraction ).
    " 20: (0.25 + 0.75) = 1.00
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = '1.00' act = lt_result[ integer_part = 20 ]-total_fraction ).

CLASS zcl_abap_group22 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_transaction, date TYPE d, value TYPE i, END OF ty_transaction,
           tt_transactions TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_transaction WITH EMPTY KEY,

CLASS zcl_abap_group22 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_by_month_having.
    DATA(lt_transactions) = VALUE tt_transactions(
      ( date = '20230101' value = 1 ) ( date = '20230105' value = 2 ) " 2 members
      ( date = '20230201' value = 3 )                                  " 1 member
      ( date = '20230301' value = 4 ) ( date = '20230310' value = 5 ) " 2 members
    ).

    rt_result = VALUE tt_result(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_group IN lt_transactions
      GROUP BY ( year_month = |{ ls_group-date(4) }{ ls_group-date+4(2) }| )
      HAVING COUNT( * ) IN GROUP >= 2
      ( year_month = KEY year_month OF GROUP ls_group
        values = VALUE tt_values(
                   FOR ls_member IN GROUP ls_group
                   ( ls_member-value ) )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_abap_group23 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data, country TYPE char2, name TYPE string, END OF ty_data,
           tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS group_and_format
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_abap_group23 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_and_format.
    DATA(lt_data) = VALUE tt_data(
      ( country = 'DE' name = 'A' ) ( country = 'US' name = 'B' )
      ( country = 'DE' name = 'C' ) ( country = 'US' name = 'D' ) ( country = 'US' name = 'E' )
      ( country = 'FR' name = 'F' ) 
    ).

    rv_output = REDUCE string(
      INIT result = ''
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_group IN lt_data
      GROUP BY ( country = ls_group-country )
      NEXT result = COND #( WHEN result IS INITIAL THEN |{ ls_group-country } ({ COUNT( * ) IN GROUP })|
                            ELSE |{ result }, { ls_group-country } ({ COUNT( * ) IN GROUP })| )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie eine Tabelle von Mitarbeitern nach Abteilung (`DEPT`) und finden Sie mit `REDUCE` den Mitarbeiter mit dem höchsten Gehalt (`SALARY`) in jeder Abteilung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_abap_group24 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_employee, dept TYPE char4, name TYPE string, salary TYPE p DECIMALS 2, END OF ty_employee,
           tt_employees TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_employee WITH EMPTY KEY,
           BEGIN OF ty_result, dept TYPE char4, top_earner_name TYPE string, top_earner_salary TYPE p DECIMALS 2, END OF ty_result,
           tt_result TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_result WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS group_top_earner
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abap_group24 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_top_earner.
    DATA(lt_employees) = VALUE tt_employees(
      ( dept = 'HR' name = 'Anna' salary = '60000.00' ) ( dept = 'IT' name = 'Ben' salary = '100000.00' )
      ( dept = 'HR' name = 'Max' salary = '75000.00' ) ( dept = 'IT' name = 'Chris' salary = '90000.00' )
    ).

    rt_result = VALUE tt_result(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_group IN lt_employees
      GROUP BY ( dept = ls_group-dept )
      ( dept = ls_group-dept
        top_earner_name = REDUCE string(
                            INIT top_name = '' top_salary = 0 TYPE p DECIMALS 2
                            FOR ls_member IN GROUP ls_group
                            NEXT top_name = COND #( WHEN ls_member-salary > top_salary THEN ls_member-name ELSE top_name )
                            NEXT top_salary = COND #( WHEN ls_member-salary > top_salary THEN ls_member-salary ELSE top_salary ) )
        top_earner_salary = REDUCE p DECIMALS 2(
                            INIT top_salary = 0
                            FOR ls_member IN GROUP ls_group
                            NEXT top_salary = COND #( WHEN ls_member-salary > top_salary THEN ls_member-salary ELSE top_salary ) )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie eine Tabelle von IDs (`GUID`) nach dem ersten Hex-Zeichen und ermitteln Sie die minimale und maximale ID pro Gruppe (mit `REDUCE`).
solution:
CLASS zcl_abap_group27 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_guids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF char32 WITH EMPTY KEY,
           BEGIN OF ty_result, char1 TYPE char1, min_guid TYPE char32, max_guid TYPE char32, END OF ty_result,
           tt_result TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_result WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS group_by_first_char_min_max
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abap_group27 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_by_first_char_min_max.
    DATA(lt_guids) = VALUE tt_guids(
      ( 'A111...' ) ( 'B222...' ) ( 'A999...' ) ( 'B100...' ) ( 'C000...' )
    ).

    rt_result = VALUE tt_result(
      FOR GROUPS OF lv_group IN lt_guids
      GROUP BY ( char1 = lv_group(1) )
      ( char1 = KEY char1 OF GROUP lv_group
        min_guid = REDUCE char32(
                     INIT min = 'ZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZ'
                     FOR member IN GROUP lv_group
                     NEXT min = COND #( WHEN member < min THEN member ELSE min ) )
        max_guid = REDUCE char32(
                     INIT max = '00000000000000000000000000000000'
                     FOR member IN GROUP lv_group
                     NEXT max = COND #( WHEN member > max THEN member ELSE max ) )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lt_data) = VALUE tt_data(

      ( flag = abap_true value = 'C' )

    DELETE lt_data WHERE flag = lv_empty_group_flag.

    rt_result = VALUE tt_result(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_group IN lt_data
      GROUP BY ( flag = ls_group-flag )
      " Die Bedingung NEXT wird hier nicht direkt benötigt, da die leere Gruppe durch DELETE entfernt wurde.
      " Sie dient als Beispiel, wenn die Filterung im FOR erfolgen würde.
      ( flag = KEY flag OF GROUP ls_group

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie eine Tabelle von Zahlen nach dem Rest bei Division durch 5 (`MOD`) und finden Sie mit `REDUCE` die Summe und den Durchschnitt (`AVG`) pro Gruppe. Nutzen Sie `LET` für die Durchschnittsberechnung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_abap_group33 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_result, modulo TYPE i, sum TYPE i, average TYPE f, END OF ty_result,
           tt_result TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_result WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS group_by_mod_avg
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abap_group33 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_by_mod_avg.
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY(
      ( 1 ) ( 6 ) ( 11 ) ( 2 ) ( 7 )
    ).

    rt_result = VALUE tt_result(
      FOR GROUPS OF lv_group IN lt_numbers
      GROUP BY ( modulo = lv_group MOD 5 )
      ( modulo = KEY modulo OF GROUP lv_group
        sum = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0 FOR member IN GROUP lv_group NEXT s = s + member )
        average = LET count = COUNT( * ) IN GROUP
                      sum_val = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0 FOR member IN GROUP lv_group NEXT s = s + member )
                  IN sum_val / count
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_by_mod_avg FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_by_mod_avg.
    DATA(lo_example) = NEW zcl_abap_group33( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_example->group_by_mod_avg( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = 2 act = lines( lt_result ) ).
    " Modulo 1: 1, 6, 11 (Summe 18, Count 3, Avg 6)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = 18 act = lt_result[ modulo = 1 ]-sum ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = 6.0 act = lt_result[ modulo = 1 ]-average ).
    " Modulo 2: 2, 7 (Summe 9, Count 2, Avg 4.5)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = 9 act = lt_result[ modulo = 2 ]-sum ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = 4.5 act = lt_result[ modulo = 2 ]-average ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Nutzen Sie den COND-Ausdruck, um zu prüfen, ob eine Zahl positiv, negativ oder null ist.

CLASS zcl_cond_sign DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    METHODS check_sign IMPORTING iv_num TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(rv_text) TYPE string.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe einer Spalte 'amount' in einer internen Tabelle mit REDUCE.

solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    METHODS get_sum IMPORTING it_data TYPE tt_data RETURNING VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.

CLASS zcl_str_regex_split DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS split_regex IMPORTING iv_val TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rt_res) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_regex_split IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD split_regex.
    SPLIT iv_val AT ',' INTO TABLE rt_res. "Placeholder, true regex split needs class
    " Modern ABAP doesn't have functional REGEX split built-in simply like other langs yet without classes.
    " Using standard split for demo simplicity or cl_abap_regex.
    FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX '\w+' IN iv_val RESULTS DATA(res).

CLASS zcl_grp_avg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_in, grp TYPE c, val TYPE i, END OF ty_in,
           tt_in TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_in WITH EMPTY KEY,

           tt_res TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_res WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS group_avg IMPORTING it_in TYPE tt_in RETURNING VALUE(rt_res) TYPE tt_res.

CLASS zcl_grp_avg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_avg.
    rt_res = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS <g> OF <wa> IN it_in GROUP BY <wa>-grp

CLASS zcl_itab_move DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_int TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS move_first_to_last CHANGING ct_data TYPE tt_int.

CLASS zcl_itab_move IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Kombinieren Sie zwei Tabellen, wobei Einträge aus Tabelle 2 Einträge aus Tabelle 1 überschreiben (Merge/Upsert Logik).
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_upsert DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_kv, k TYPE i, v TYPE string, END OF ty_kv,
           tt_kv TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_kv WITH UNIQUE KEY k.
    METHODS upsert IMPORTING it_base TYPE tt_kv it_new TYPE tt_kv RETURNING VALUE(rt_res) TYPE tt_kv.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_upsert IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD upsert.
    rt_res = it_base.
    LOOP AT it_new INTO DATA(ls_new).
      " Using secondary key or assumption of sorted for simplicity update
      READ TABLE rt_res ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs>) WITH TABLE KEY k = ls_new-k.
      IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs>-v = ls_new-v. ELSE. INSERT ls_new INTO TABLE rt_res. ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_upsert FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_upsert.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_upsert( ).
    DATA(lt_b) = VALUE zcl_itab_upsert=>tt_kv( ( k = 1 v = 'A' ) ).
    DATA(lt_n) = VALUE zcl_itab_upsert=>tt_kv( ( k = 1 v = 'B' ) ( k = 2 v = 'C' ) ).
    DATA(lt_res) = lo_cut->upsert( it_base = lt_b it_new = lt_n ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_res[ k = 1 ]-v exp = 'B' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_res ) exp = 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Merge-Logik erfordert oft explizites Looping oder komplexe `REDUCE` Konstrukte.

Instructions: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` um den Index des maximalen Elements zu finden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_max_idx DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_int TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_max_idx IMPORTING it_in TYPE tt_int RETURNING VALUE(rv_idx) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_max_idx IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_idx.
    rv_idx = REDUCE i( INIT idx = 0 max = -1 i = 1
                       FOR val IN it_in
                       NEXT idx = COND #( WHEN val > max THEN i ELSE idx )
                            max = COND #( WHEN val > max THEN val ELSE max )
                            i   = i + 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Komplexe Logik in `REDUCE` ermöglicht 'Single Pass' Algorithmen.
